jobs.title: All Programs - Energy Advisor II
jobs.description: Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI\-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech\-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution. POSITION SUMMARY This position is responsible for providing our services directly to homeowners, landlords, building owners and other utility customers. You will provide expert advice and coordination for our programs while recommending specific modifications to electric and/or gas systems; you will also convince prospective clients of the improved efficiency that our services will bring. This role combines field work with office time (typically 3 field days to 2 office days per week). This position will provide energy advice and coordination services for customers—including trade partner facilitation—and will identify opportunities regarding energy efficiency and introduce the various prescriptive and custom incentive measures that pertain to the customer segment. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES This list of duties and responsibilities is not all\-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time. * Direct installation of energy saving products as directed by program management * Adhering to the safety requirements of the organization and the utility client * Promote the energy efficiency program to customers, trade allies and program stakeholders within your assigned territory * Understand and implement the company’s Sales Process, including but not limited to: * Make outbound calls to existing customers to meet assigned energy saving targets * Initiate new business with new customers through business\-to\-business efforts * Manage field time effectively with customer, Trade Ally and program stakeholder visits * Develop and deliver presentations to create awareness about the program * Respond to customer inquiries and concerns by phone, electronically or in person to move projects towards completion * Work with utility customers to provide energy efficiency and the business activities of its customers * Identify and provide documentation of on\-site opportunities and written summary reports for energy efficiency to customers and client/Program Manager, provide follow\-up to as required * Discuss technical elements of energy consuming equipment\-i.e., lighting, HVAC, hot water system, building and pipe insulation, and air sealing * Enter data into spreadsheets and database to determine energy savings and to manage current projects which may also include collaborating with Energy Engineers as required * Maintain professional appearance and behavior appropriate for a representative of our organization and the utility * Build quick rapport with customers. Quickly initiate conversations with customers on site and virtually regarding energy usage at the facility * Be able to work in a team atmosphere, and willing to collaborate on continuous improvement of operations year after year * When required, provide written summary reports directly to the customer, and summary reports to the client/Program Manager * Assist Program Manager in the training of new team members * Lead presentations promoting energy efficiency programs for targeted groups * Assist customers through the rebate application process * Install energy efficiency products in tenant units and building common areas * All other duties as assigned POSITION REQUIREMENTS Education and Experience * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university or equivalent experience. Technical school degree combined with demonstrated experience in electric/gas utility field will be considered. Equivalent work experience may be considered. * 3 – 5 years of experience in the electric or natural gas utility industry, facilities management, HVAC design or sales, commercial and industrial lighting, conservation and energy management, or related experience * Previous experience managing staff performing proactive customer outreach activities * 2 – 3 years of experience in energy efficiency and/or energy modeling * Previous customer service, sales, or marketing experience Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities * Must be self\-motivated, organized and have ability to prioritize workload * Must be flexible to handle a wide variety and work at a fast pace * Ability to adapt to changing environment in the program when required * Proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook * Strong data entry skills in entering information in tracking systems/databases * Ability to communicate effectively, both verbally and in writing with customers, clients and employees * Ability to analyze and interpret data and solve practical problems * Knowledge of mathematical concepts such as fractions, percentages and ratios * Committed to diversity and inclusion * Reliable transportation Licenses \& Certifications * Valid driver’s license Travel Requirements * Willingness to travel less than 50% PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORK ENVIRONMENT * Required to sit, stand, walk; talk and hear; and ability to touch and handle tools and/or controls * Ability to lift up to 40 pounds * Noise Level is typically moderate * Employee could be exposed to fumes and/or airborne particles and risk of potential shock **Note:** Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. The above information describes the general duties and requirements necessary to perform the principle functions of the position. This shall not be construed as a detailed description of all the duties and requirements that may be necessary in this position. An Equal Opportunity Employer **Safety \-Sensitive Role Addendum:** Because many roles at Franklin Energy involve regulatory compliance, safety responsibilities, or professional licensing requirements, it is critical that interview responses reflect the candidate’s direct knowledge and experience. Misrepresentation of technical or safety qualifications may result in immediate removal from consideration. **Notice Regarding Automated Tools:** We may use automated or AI\-assisted tools as part of our candidate evaluation process to assess job\-related skills and qualifications. These tools are intended to support fair and consistent review and do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions. All evaluations are conducted in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **About Arena Intelligence** ============================ Arena is the platform for evaluating how AI models perform in the real world. Founded by researchers from UC Berkeley's SkyLab, we're on a mission to measure and advance the frontier of AI for real\-world use, and to build the foundation for everyone to understand, shape, and benefit from it. Tens of millions of people use Arena each month to evaluate how frontier systems handle the work they actually do. The preferences they share power the most transparent, rigorous, and human\-centered evaluations in AI. Leading AI labs, enterprises, and independent researchers rely on our work and open datasets to understand how models behave in real workflows: agentic coding, creative generation, professional productivity, and beyond. We go beyond leaderboards and decompose what human experience reveals about AI, so models advance toward the work people actually do. We're a team of researchers, academics, builders, and creatives from UC Berkeley, Google, Stanford, and DeepMind. We seek truth, move fast, and value craftsmanship, curiosity, and impact over hierarchy. We're building a company where thoughtful, curious people from all backgrounds can do their best work together, in an office culture that radiates excellence, energy, and focus. ### **About the Role** This role has two core parts, both centered around working closely with the best AI labs in the world. First, you’ll partner directly with our lab customers to integrate their models, run and deliver evals, and act as their go\-to person at Arena Intelligence. You’ll plug into their research roadmap, understand where they’re headed, and help them get real value from our data. Along the way, you’ll spot gaps, surface new opportunities, and help shape what we build next. Second, you’ll roll up your sleeves and build. You’ll take on specific customer engineering asks and ship solutions that push the frontier of what our platform can do. Some of what you build may eventually scale into our Data or Applied ML stack — but it starts with solving real, high\-impact problems for cutting\-edge AI teams. ### **You’ll** * Own 5–15 active model lab relationships as the day\-to\-day point of contact * Partner directly with researchers and product teams to integrate models, run evals, and deliver high\-quality results * Drive consistent delivery across onboarding, data \+ product releases, co\-launches, and unblock unexpected issues fast * Be the “owner” of a key process improvement or automation (e.g., model onboarding flow, customer data insights, delivery tooling) * Translate customer feedback and research direction into concrete product ideas and engineering work * Work across the stack to ship pragmatic solutions that push the frontier for our customers * Help expand strategic accounts through trust, execution, and sharp technical judgment ### **You’ll have** * 4\+ years of software engineering experience with strong fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, system design) * Production experience in **TypeScript** and modern web frameworks * Hands\-on experience integrating LLM provider APIs, including streaming responses * Comfort moving across frontend and backend — you’re willing to dig in wherever the problem is * Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and CI/CD workflows * Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to operate in ambiguity * Clear, concise communication skills — you can explain complex technical ideas to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders * A customer\-first mindset and a genuine desire to work closely with multiple stakeholders **What we offer** ================= * We offer competitive compensation and equity aligned to the markets where our team members are based. The base salary range will depend on the candidate’s permanent work location. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits, including medical, dental, vision, and additional support programs. * The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge AI with a small, mission\-driven team * A culture that values transparency, trust, and community impact Come help build the space where anyone can explore and help shape the future of AI. Arena Intelligence *provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.* Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

and platform enhancements. * Stay informed on emerging data technologies and trends, sharing insights to help identify opportunities for innovation and improved data use. * Help implement scalable and jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About Prudentia Sciences** ---------------------------- Prudentia Sciences is an AI\-powered technology platform transforming how biopharma, biotech, and life sciences investors approach portfolio management, due diligence, and value/risk simulation. Our platform accelerates investment in breakthrough therapies by: * **Empowering biopharma** to accelerate drug pipelines, maximize ROI, and achieve clinical and commercial success for greater patient impact * **Enabling strategic positioning** of asset value during portfolio planning and dealmaking * **Equipping investors** with data\-driven insights to optimize capital allocation in drug asset transactions Backed by GV (Google Ventures), SignalFire, McKesson, Iaso Ventures, and Virtue, we're on a mission to unlock the full potential of pharmaceutical R\&D by empowering decision\-makers with real\-time, data\-driven insights. **The Opportunity** ------------------- We're seeking a hands\-on DevOps Engineer to build and own the infrastructure, deployment, and reliability foundation of our platform as we scale. This is a rare opportunity to join a high\-impact technology company in a major growth stage, where you'll ensure our pharma and biopharma customers can depend on a secure, highly available platform to run their most sensitive due diligence and valuation workflows. Our platform is quickly seeing exceptional demand in its sector, and is backed by top\-tier life science investors who have an informed perspective on where AI can have a profound impact in the industry. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Infrastructure as Code:** Design, build, and maintain our cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) using infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi) to keep environments reproducible, auditable, and scalable. * **CI/CD Pipelines:** Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support fast, reliable, and safe deployments across the platform's frontend, backend, and ML orchestration services. * **Observability \& Monitoring:** Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting (Grafana) to give the team real\-time visibility into system health and quickly surface issues before they impact customers. * **Reliability \& Incident Response:** Drive reliability engineering practices. Uptime targets, SLOs/SLAs, incident response processes, on\-call rotations, and driving accountability for PIRs. Our clients demand high availability for time\-sensitive deal and scientific data. * **Security \& Compliance:** Implement and enforce best practices for secure infrastructure, including network security, secrets management, access controls, and data protection. * **Cost \& Performance Optimization:** Monitor and optimize cloud spend and system performance, balancing cost efficiency with the reliability and scalability the platform requires. You should know an AWS bill like the back of your hand and be able to offer suggestions on how best to optimize it. * **Database \& Data Infrastructure Support:** Partner with engineering to manage and scale data infrastructure (e.g., Postgres, DynamoDB, Pipelines), including backups, disaster recovery, and performance tuning. * **Developer Experience:** Build tooling and self\-service workflows that make it easy for engineers to deploy, test, and debug their services, reducing friction across the development lifecycle. * **Collaboration \& Product Thinking:** Work cross\-functionally with software and ML engineers, product leads, and domain experts to translate scaling and reliability needs into concrete infrastructure investments. **Who You Are** --------------- **Core Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Proven experience designing, deploying, and operating production infrastructure in the cloud (AWS), including networking, compute, storage, and IAM. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Hands\-on experience with IaC tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar) to manage infrastructure in a repeatable, version\-controlled way. * **CI/CD \& Automation:** Expertise building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automating build, test, and deployment workflows. We are a github shop. * **Observability:** Experience implementing monitoring, logging, and alerting systems, and using them to drive down MTTR/MTTD. Automated DORA metric tracking too. * **Database \& Data Flow:** Comfort working with both relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MongoDB, DynamoDB), including backup, replication, and performance considerations. * **Security \& Compliance Awareness:** Familiarity with best practices for secure infrastructure, secrets management, and compliance (especially valuable in healthcare, life sciences, or enterprise environments). * **Scripting \& Automation:** Proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for building automation and internal tooling. * **Collaboration \& Product Mindset:** Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to work closely with software engineers, ML engineers, and product managers to deliver a reliable, scalable platform. **Soft Skills** * Strong problem\-solving skills and an analytical mindset. * Passion for continuous learning, rapid prototyping, and iterating based on system and user needs. * Autonomous, self\-starter attitude with a strong sense of ownership. * Excellent communication skills. You should feel comfortable presenting on security architecture to a client’s security team. * Collaborative team player with a desire to build things that truly matter. **Bonus** * Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or biopharma sectors is nice, but not required. More important is a willingness to dive into the field and a curiosity to learn about life sciences and the drug development process, and how deal making revolves around it. **What We Offer** ----------------- * **Impact:** Your work directly enables breakthrough therapies to reach patients faster * **Ownership:** Build and lead the platform as a foundational engineering leader * **Growth:** Shape our product experience during a critical scaling phase * **Compensation:** Competitive salary and equity * **Team:** Collaborative, mission\-driven colleagues passionate about transforming biopharma **Location** ------------ This role is hybrid, requiring being onsite 2 days per week (Tuesday/Thursday) in one of our U.S. hubs: Boston, New York City, or San Francisco. Compensation Range: $180K \- $200K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **About Noble Machines** ======================== Noble Machines builds multipurpose robots to support human workers in the world's toughest jobs—turning dangerous work from a necessity into a choice. Our work demands reliability, robustness, and readiness for the unexpected—on time, every time. We're assembling a mission\-driven team focused on delivering real impact in heavy industry, from construction and mining to energy. If you're driven to build rugged, reliable products that solve real\-world problems, we'd love to talk. **About the Role** ================== Noble Machines is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to be the critical link between our robotics platform and the customers putting it to work in the field—construction sites, mines, and energy facilities where the work is hardest and the stakes are highest. You'll deploy, integrate, and support our robots on\-site, troubleshoot issues that span software, hardware, and networking in real time, and feed what you learn in the field directly back into product and engineering. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role for someone who is just as comfortable configuring a system as they are climbing onto equipment or debugging from a jobsite trailer. **What You'll Do** ================== * Lead on\-site deployment, installation, and integration of Noble Machines' robots at customer sites across construction, mining, and energy * Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers during deployment, resolving hardware, software, autonomy, and networking issues in real time under field conditions * Partner with engineering, autonomy, and hardware teams to translate field learnings, edge cases, and customer feedback into concrete product requirements and improvements * Design and refine scalable deployment processes, tooling, and documentation as Noble Machines' customer base grows * Own technical outcomes end\-to\-end—from pre\-deployment planning and site readiness through go\-live, training, and ongoing support * Provide hands\-on training to customer operators and site personnel on safe, effective robot operation * Conduct root\-cause analysis on field incidents and drive fixes across hardware, firmware, and software * Travel regularly to customer sites, including remote and industrial environments, to support deployments and maintain uptime **What You'll Bring** ===================== * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 3\+ years of experience solving problems at the intersection of hardware, software, and networking, ideally in unstructured or field environments * Proficiency in Python and/or C\+\+, with the ability to read, debug, and modify code across the stack * Comfort working hands\-on with physical systems—wiring, sensors, mechanical troubleshooting—in addition to software * Strong ownership mentality and the ability to work independently on ambiguous, high\-stakes problems with shifting requirements * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build trust with customers in high\-pressure field environments * Willingness to travel frequently to industrial and remote job sites, including construction sites, mines, and energy facilities * Ability to perform physical tasks associated with fieldwork (e.g., lifting equipment, working outdoors in varied conditions, wearing required PPE) **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience deploying robotics, autonomy, or hardware products in heavy industry (construction, mining, oil \& gas, utilities) * Familiarity with ROS/ROS2, autonomy stacks, or robot fleet management systems * Linux systems administration, networking, and on\-prem/edge deployment experience * Background in defense, automotive, or industrial robotics * Relevant safety certifications (OSHA 10/30, MSHA, or similar) **California Pay Transparency Statement** ----------------------------------------- Pay Transparency \& Compensation: In accordance with California's Pay Transparency Act (SB 1162\), the expected base salary range for this position located in Sunnyvale, CA is $140,000 – $195,000 per year. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, technical skills, and specialized expertise. Base salary is just one component of Noble Machines' total rewards package, which may also include equity options, comprehensive healthcare benefits, retirement plan contributions, and performance\-based incentives. **Equal Opportunity Employer** ------------------------------ Noble Machines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. Every customer we sign runs live workflows that have to keep working, and there are more of them every month. That's why we're hiring you. The Role This is an engineering role that lives where the product meets the customer. You'll stand up new customer workflows alongside our sales team, keep the live ones healthy, and own the systems that make both of those faster every month. Here's how we work, and it's the most important thing to understand about this job: **we do the work manually first, then we automate it.** When a workflow needs fixing, you fix it. Then you ask the real question, which is how to make that fix faster next time, or unnecessary, or something the customer can do for themselves. We expect you to keep scaling yourself, handling more and more by building systems behind you. The person who does well here is constitutionally incapable of doing the same manual thing twice without trying to automate it. You'll also own our QA product. An agent reviews production runs against each workflow's requirements and flags the ones that fall short. You'll review its verdicts, accept or reject what it files, and then make the agent better at its job. That loop is this role in miniature: do the judgment work yourself, then teach the system to do more of it. To be clear about what this isn't: it's not a support queue in the help desk sense, it's not a pre\-sales demo role, and it's not a consultant embedded at a customer site. You'll write and review real code every week, from our office, with the rest of the team. What You'll Do * Build out new customer workflows with the account executive who owns the account. They stay in the lead and bring you what the customer needs; you make it real. We want this as close to real time as possible, and making it faster is part of your job, not a nice\-to\-have * Support live customer workflows: fix what breaks, then remove the reason it broke * Own our QA product, from reviewing what the agent flags to making the agent sharper * Own how workflow changes get published: make sure deployments do what they're supposed to, catch the changes that shouldn't ship, and roll back cleanly when something is wrong * Watch for patterns. A workflow that keeps needing the same fix is telling you something upstream is wrong, and chasing that down is worth more than closing the ticket * Build the tooling, checks, and guardrails that make everything above take less time every month * Learn our customers' industry well enough to argue with how they describe their own process What We're Looking For **Must have:** * Real professional software engineering experience. You'll write and review production code every week, and defend the business logic you wrote. * Strong TypeScript, or strong experience in a comparable typed language plus the appetite to get to strong TypeScript quickly. * The ability to read unfamiliar code fast. Much of what you touch was written by someone else, or by an agent. * An instinct to automate your own work. This is the single most important trait for this role. Doing the manual version first is the job; leaving it manual is not. * Genuine interest in complicated real\-world processes. Prior authorization rules, billing codes, payer\-by\-payer exceptions that exist for reasons nobody ever wrote down. If a twenty\-step workflow that nobody has documented sounds tedious rather than interesting, this will be a frustrating job. * A customer\-centered instinct. The account executive owns the customer relationship and stays in the lead, so you won't be on every call. But every judgment call you make comes down to what this looks like to the person whose order it is. * Comfort in a company of four to six people, where the job is whatever it takes and you'll largely define your own benchmarks as you go. * Willingness to work in\-office five days a week, and to be around some evenings and weekends when something critical breaks. **Preferred:** * Forward deployed, solutions, implementation, or product engineering experience where you also wrote production code * Experience in healthcare, revenue cycle, insurance, or another domain with dense rules you had to learn from scratch * Experience with durable workflow orchestration, browser automation, or long\-running job systems * You use AI coding tools yourself, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, to move faster * Based in Los Angeles, or ready to be We'll teach you the industry. We can't teach you to find it interesting. Compensation and Benefits * Base salary of $150,000 to $185,000 depending on experience * Founding\-team equity * Health insurance Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

jobs.title: Forward Developed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your at You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description: Docflow builds AI agents that run the back office for healthcare providers. Our automation handles the work that buries their teams: document intake, prior authorizations, order entry, and payer portal workflows. Customers start with a paid pilot, see real work getting done within weeks, and expand from there. We're a small, scrappy, AI\-native founding team, and we're growing fast. We ship a lot of real software fast, and we hold a high bar for how it's built. That's why we're hiring you. The Role You'll be an early engineer working directly with our CTO on the core product: the systems that ingest documents, orchestrate long\-running automated workflows, drive browser automation across dozens of external portals, and present it all in a fast, modern web app. This is a true full\-stack role. You'll move fluidly from the database to the backend and workflow engine to the UI. We're hiring two engineers. This is the one that builds the platform itself, including the engine every customer workflow runs on and the pipeline they ship changes through. Our other engineering role lives closer to the customers and owns the workflows running on top of it. If you'd rather build the thing a hundred workflows depend on than tune any one of them, this is your seat. We care as much about how you build as what you build. We write TypeScript with rigorous type safety, model our domain with precise types instead of loose ones, and treat correctness in asynchronous, long\-running systems as a first\-class concern. If you take pride in code that is clean, well\-typed, and hard to misuse, you'll fit right in. Because we handle protected health information, reliability and care are not optional. You'll help us build software that is fast for users and trustworthy with sensitive data. What You'll Do * Ship features across the full stack, from database schema to backend logic to user interface * Build and maintain long\-running, asynchronous workflows that must be reliable, idempotent, and resumable * Work on browser automation that interacts with many external systems * Build the deployment and versioning rails that let workflow changes ship safely and roll back cleanly * Design clean, precise domain models and APIs that are hard to misuse * Care for a production system that handles sensitive healthcare data with the reliability that demands * Work closely with the CTO to set the engineering standards the team grows into What We're Looking For **Must have:** * Strong professional experience building and shipping production web applications end to end. We care more about the systems you've built than a years\-of\-experience number, though in practice this usually means several years in the field. * Deep TypeScript proficiency. This is a must. You reach for precise, discriminated types and exhaustive handling rather than escape hatches like any or unsafe casts, and you use the type system to make invalid states unrepresentable. * A strong instinct for correctness in asynchronous and concurrent systems. Race conditions, retries, idempotency, cancellation, and failure handling are things you think about by default, not after a bug. * Comfort across the whole stack: relational databases and type\-safe data access, backend services, and modern component\-based UI. * Care for user\-facing quality: responsive, asynchronous interfaces with thoughtful loading, error, and optimistic states. * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, and with serverless and managed infrastructure. * High standards for readable, maintainable code and a low tolerance for needless complexity. **Preferred:** * Experience with durable workflow orchestration or long\-running job systems * Experience with browser automation or end\-to\-end testing frameworks * Experience in regulated or security\-sensitive domains such as healthcare or fintech, and handling sensitive data * Experience shipping in a monorepo and in a fast, small\-team environment * You use AI coding tools yourself, such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor, to move faster * Based in Los Angeles, or ready to be Compensation and Benefits * Base salary of $150,000 to $185,000 depending on experience * Founding\-team equity * Health insurance Compensation Range: $150K \- $185K

jobs.title: Founding Enteprise Sales
jobs.description: **Build the pipeline and drive qualified opportunities that accelerate Hypercubic’s growth and revenue.** **About the role** ------------------ We’ve built an initial enterprise pipeline through founder\-led sales. Now we’re looking for an exceptional founding salesperson to dramatically expand that pipeline, keep opportunities moving, and help turn early traction into a repeatable sales motion. Your three core responsibilities: * Own the entire top of funnel: sourcing, prospecting, outreach, and qualification. * Drive opportunities from first call, owning demos, follow\-up, and deal progression. * Work with the CEO on strategy, pricing, negotiation, and closing. You’ll have meaningful ownership over who we pursue, how we reach them, and how we advance opportunities. You’ll build the playbook through daily execution and customer feedback, with room to take on more of the sales cycle as you grow. **What you’ll own** ------------------- * **Create qualified pipeline.** Research accounts and generate opportunities through outbound, warm introductions, partners, conferences, and inbound leads. * **Run discovery.** Lead first calls, understand the problem and urgency, identify stakeholders, and establish whether there’s a credible path to a purchase. * **Keep deals moving.** Build champions, engage decision\-makers, identify blockers, and secure concrete next steps. * **Partner with the CEO.** Bring them into deeper demos, strategy, pricing, and negotiation with strong preparation. Own follow\-through afterward. * **Build the playbook.** Test messaging and channels, document what works, maintain an accurate pipeline, and use AI and automation to increase your output. Success means more qualified opportunities, faster deal progression, and more pilots converting into revenue. **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * **Proven sales ability.** You’ve built your own pipeline and won complex enterprise business, ideally including six\- or seven\-figure contracts. You can point to deals you personally created and advanced. * **High agency.** You find ways into accounts and move independently without an established playbook. * **Enterprise judgment.** You build champions, navigate buying committees, and know when to push, adapt, or walk away. * **Technical curiosity.** You learn complex products quickly and earn credibility with engineers and executives. * **Sharp communication.** You write compelling outreach, run focused discovery, and get to the point. * **Disciplined execution.** You prepare thoroughly, keep an accurate pipeline, and follow through. * **Resourceful with tools.** You’re hands\-on with CRMs, prospecting tools, and AI. You build workflows that accelerate research, outreach, meeting preparation, and follow\-up. * **Ambition and coachability.** You take ownership of results, seek feedback, and want to become exceptional at your craft. You may be an AE who built your own pipeline, a standout BDR ready for broader ownership, or a founder who sold a technical product. You’re excited to be **Sales \#1**: own the playbook, learn directly from the founders, and shape the sales function as Hypercubic grows. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * A sustained increase in qualified enterprise opportunities. * More accounts progressing toward pilots and paid deployments. * Active deals with engaged stakeholders, understood blockers, and concrete next steps. * Repeatable sources of pipeline beyond the CEO’s personal network. * Driving the founders to spend more time in consequential bottom of the funnel customer conversations. * A repeatable sales playbook grounded in what actually wins business. You’ll help build the commercial foundation of a company tackling some of the world’s most consequential software. You’ll work closely with the founders and engineering team, influence how we reach the market, and see your work directly shape the business. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: This role is in\-person 5 days a week based in San Francisco, California near FiDi. * Sponsorship: Unfortunately, we are unable to sponsor new H1B employment visas at this time. **Benefits** ------------ We offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Founding\-team level equity, * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K) * Monthly stipend to support your wellness and commute * Daily lunches/dinners and snacks in the office to fuel you * Generous PTO and sick day policy to rest and recharge **About Hypercubic** -------------------- At Hypercubic, we’re building AI systems that can understand, reason about, and rearchitect large\-scale legacy applications running on mainframes and COBOL. We work at the intersection of program analysis, knowledge extraction, and agentic systems, applied to some of the most critical enterprise software in the world. We’re a small, deeply technical team in San Francisco, backed by top investors, and working with some of the largest organizations in the world. Compensation Range: $100K \- $160K

kernels. **Benefits include** -------------------- * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401k plan * Daily lunch, snacks, and beverages * Flexible time off * Competitive salary and equity **Equal The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product \& Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. **Job Summary:** Disney Media Systems Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency. Disney Media Systems Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware, and software\-based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer\- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post\-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more. The Media Systems Engineer II position is the perfect role for an engineer who has some hands\-on sustainment and design/build experience with the creation, production, and distribution of linear or digital video/audio content. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote available (U.S. Only) **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- ResearchScience Research **Compensation** ---------------- * $180K – $250K • Offers Equity **About us** ============ Edison Scientific builds and deploys AI scientist agents to accelerate science and the development of new medicines. We are an ambitious team run by scientists and engineers from leading institutions across biology, physics, chemistry, and AI. **Role** As a **Forward\-Deployed** **Biostatistics Subject Matter Expert**, you will build and evaluate AI agent systems to automate statistical analysis and clinical development workflows. You'll be embedded directly with some of the world's leading pharma and biotech organizations, and will be responsible for ensuring Edison's AI agents deliver statistically sound, regulator\-ready outputs. You'll work with our partners to create benchmarks that measure agent performance on complex tasks across trial design, SAP development, and submission\-quality statistical deliverables, then work with our internal AI engineering team to improve agent performance on those tasks. You'll need to deeply understand our partners' statistical methodology, their study design conventions, and their regulatory bar, then determine where our platform can drive the most meaningful impact. This position would ideally be in Boston, NYC or San Francisco, but we are also open to fully remote with 20\-40% travel. **Responsibilities** * Improving the ability of LLM agents to execute long, coherent statistical analysis and trial design tasks within real\-world scientific environments and customer data infrastructures. * Designing benchmarks to evaluate LLM agent performance, acceptance criteria, and failure modes on complex biostatistical tasks (e.g., SAP development, sample size determination, endpoint analysis). * Partnering directly with biostatisticians and clinical development leaders at client organizations to apply AI agents to statistical and regulatory deliverables. * Serving as the statistical authority on AI\-generated outputs, evaluating accuracy and regulatory soundness, identifying failure modes, and determining what warrants further investigation. * Partner with GTM and account executives to scope engagements, define success metrics, and support pre\-sales technical evaluation. * Build trusted relationships with biostatisticians and research leaders at customers, earning credibility as both a statistical peer and a knowledgeable AI practitioner. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of experience in biostatistical applications within biotech or pharma (sponsor or CRO). * Graduate degree (Ph.D. preferred) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or a related discipline. * Proven expertise in crafting SAPs, determining sample sizes, and designing early\-phase (I/II) clinical trials. * Proficiency in R and/or SAS (both preferred). * Experience in therapeutic areas such as oncology, immuno\-oncology, immunology, cardiovascular, neurology, or hepatology (MASH) preferred. * Deep familiarity with ICH and FDA regulatory standards, including direct experience with CSRs, IND filings, and CDISC\-compliant datasets (SDTM/ADaM). * Prior experience in an industry or client\-facing context, outside of academia. * Ability to travel domestically 20\-40% of the time. **Bonus points for** * Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript. * You enjoy quickly iterating on ideas through rapid prototyping. * You operate with high independence, and like to execute complex tasks to completion in a high\-stakes environment. * You thrive when working on a diversity of projects in sprint\-based formats, and have high comfort with uncertainty. * You are proficient in statistical programming and validation, and could QC or independently reproduce an analysis if necessary. **Why join us?** ================ We're a fast\-moving, mission\-driven culture where smart people do their best work and actually enjoy doing it. We also offer full\-time employees the following: * Competitive salary and equity * Full healthcare coverage; we pay 100% of premiums for you and your dependents * Support for growing families, including a yearly new parent stipend and fertility coverage through Carrot * Mental health support through Rula, our in\-network therapist and psychiatrist network with fast availability * 12 weeks of paid parental leave for maternity, paternity, and adoption * Pet care support with a yearly employer\-funded stipend for your animal companions * Commuter benefits so you can pay for transit and parking with pre\-tax dollars * 401(k) company matching * $300 health and wellness benefit quarterly * Lunch is on us every day you're in the office, and dinner is on us when you're working late * Regular team off\-sites and company events *Edison Scientific is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.* Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

* Assist with the construction of the system as needed to maintain schedule, budget, and design integrity. * Develop “as\-built” documentation and drawings including Operation and Maintenance Manuals * Provide after\-shipment support as needed for successful system commissioning. * Develop and maintain key mechanical contractor relationships with respective contractor service/project critical contacts. * Serve as the senior Technical Support resource supporting escalated field troubleshooting efforts. * Serve as Technical representative, alongside other RFM site representation, to liaise with principals regarding product problem resolution and/or product improvements. This is largely a deskbound role; however, filing, correlating, reproduction and binding materials are required. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets, bend or stand on a stool, climb stairs, and prepare training and meeting rooms/spaces as necessary. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, listen, bend, squat, walk, lift, pull, push, and climb stairs. **Position Type/Expected Hours of Work** This is a full\-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. This position regularly requires long hours and occasional travel work as job duties demand. **Travel** Travel may be required for this position to customer and RFMCo. sites with out\-of\-area and possible overnight travel expected. **Required Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in ME, or related discipline preferred or Associate degree and 4 – 7 years of relevant project management experience; or 7 years of relevant project management experience. * 5 years’ experience in project management/estimating. * Ability to perform diversified clerical functions and working knowledge of GAAP and accounting procedures. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills**.** * Proficient in Excel, Word, and accounting software systems.) * Strong interpersonal skills. * Ability to understand and follow written and verbal instructions. * Ability to deal effectively with a diversity of individuals at all organizational levels. * Commitment to excellence and high standards. * Strong organizational skills; able to manage priorities and workflow. * Keystrokes a minimum of 45 wpm. * Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities with enthusiasm. * Must be able to speak, read, write, and understand the primary language(s) used in the workplace. * Professional appearance and demeanor * Excellent attendance and promptness a must. **Preferred Education and Experience** Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred. **Other duties:** Please note, this job description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer II
jobs.description: **QA Automation Engineer II** **Department** Quality Assurance **Reports To** QA Manager **Location** Chicago, IL or Remote (US) **Role Overview** The QA Automation Engineer II plays a central role in strengthening automated test coverage and quality practices across our TMS. This is a heavy automation and AI role: you'll use AI daily as your default way of working, not as an occasional aid, paired with the judgment to validate what it produces rather than simply trust it. You'll also help establish AI\-assisted testing as a standard practice across the broader QA team, working alongside our QA Analysts as a peer. This is deliberately not a developer role, and it's not a fit for someone who assumes they already know better than the team and process they're joining. We're looking for someone who cares about getting this right, wants to learn our TMS and Salesforce platform well enough to have real opinions about both, and brings genuine curiosity and process discipline to the table. **Responsibilities** * Serve as the standing review function for automated test coverage across the TMS, an ongoing part of the job every time new coverage is added, not a one\-time audit. * Flag unreliable, flaky, or false\-positive tests, including AI\-generated tests, before they're trusted as real regression signal. * Maintain and extend automated test coverage for Revenova's Salesforce\-native TMS, working within the approach and priorities the QA Manager sets. * Use AI tools daily as the default way of working: generating test cases from a spec, maintaining and refactoring existing suites, and accelerating review of test output. * Build deep familiarity with the TMS and the underlying Salesforce platform. * Champion AI\-assisted testing as a required practice across the QA team, working directly alongside QA Analysts as the foundation for how that practice gets established and maintained, not as something offered only to whoever happens to be curious. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Daily, hands\-on use of AI tools in real testing work is required, not a bonus. Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or similar. You can point to specific, concrete examples of how it changed your output, such as coverage reached faster or manual maintenance reduced. * The judgment to validate AI output, not just produce it. You can spot the failure mode where an AI\-generated test passes without asserting anything meaningful, or where AI\-assisted review misses a real defect. * 2\-4 years of hands\-on experience writing and maintaining automated tests (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Java), within an AI\-assisted workflow. Not required to have built an automation framework from scratch. * Experience reviewing or auditing another engineer's or team's test automation code, including AI\-generated test code, with the judgment to explain whether it's good. * API and integration testing experience; able to identify which layer a given risk belongs to. * A QA mindset, not a developer's. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. **This position reports to:** Continuous Improvement Manager \_\_ **Your role and responsibilities** In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the deployment of the continuous improvement strategy for a local organizational unit, including promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvement. Each day, you will mentor and coach teams to achieve operational excellence and drive improved results. You will also showcase your expertise by deploying and leading projects to improve and sustain local business performance. The work model for the role is: \#LI\-onsite This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Division in Selmer, TN. You will be mainly accountable for: * Escalating to relevant stakeholders, as necessary, to remove roadblocks that prevent the successful implementation and adoption of continuous improvement initiatives at local level and helping facilitate cases of conflicting priorities in collaboration with cross\-functional teams. * Ensuring the continuous improvement approach and strategy deployed at local ABB unit level is aligned with the global strategy. * Facilitating significant improvements with respect to safety, quality, delivery, inventory, and/or cost targets, meeting customer and stakeholder commitments in collaboration with local leadership. * Providing training support by developing and maintaining training modules and toolkits aligned with business needs in collaboration with management at local level. Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there. **Qualifications for the role** * Engineering degree(mechanical, industrial or related degree) preferred. In lieu of degree will consider 15 years of experience. * Minimum of 5 years of experience in manufacturing, leading large projects and purchasing new equipment. * Knowledge of Six Sigma, Lean Tools, Kaizen, Root Cause Analysis is preferred. * Experience with project management and proven history of driving and sustaining change. * Possess knowledge of SAP and MS Office package. Power Bi \& Power Apps is an added advantage * Travel required \- 10% (Domestic and International) * Candidates must already have a work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US. **What's in it for you?** We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. **Benefits** We also offer our employees the following benefits: * ABB Benefit Summary for eligible US employees Go to myBenefitsABB.com and click on “Candidate/Guest” to learn * Health, Life \& Disability * Choice between two medical plan options: A PPO plan called the Copay Plan OR a High Deductible Health Plan (with a Health Savings Account) called the High Deductible Plan. * Choice between two dental plan options: Core and Core Plus * Vision benefit * Company paid life insurance (2X base pay) * Company paid AD\&D (1X base pay) * Voluntary life and AD\&D – 100% employee paid up to maximums * Short Term Disability – up to 26 weeks – Company paid * Long Term Disability – 60% of pay – Company paid. Salaried exempt positions are provided vacation under a permissive time away policy. **Retirement** * 401k Savings Plan with Company Contributions * Employee Stock Acquisition Plan (ESAP) **More about us** ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. jobs.title: Senior Back End Engineer
jobs.description: **About Altruist** Altruist is transforming the multi\-trillion dollar wealth management industry by building an AI platform for wealth professionals. We partner with financial advisors nationwide, empowering them to grow, optimize time and resources, and deliver superior outcomes for their clients. We're looking for exceptional talent to help us achieve our mission of making financial advice better, more affordable, and accessible to all. If you're passionate about challenging the status quo and want to do the most important work of your life, we'd love to meet you! **But first, our values** **Kindness** \- Kindness doesn't *just* equal niceness. We listen to understand. We embrace, and encourage healthy debate and diverse perspectives. We approach conflict openly, honestly, and respectfully. **Brilliance** \- Humility is the skill we're most proud of and possessing a growth mindset is always top of mind. We take ownership in everything we touch; regularly using our unique superpowers to reach a common goal as a team. We succeed and fail as one. **Grit** \- When challenges arise, we stay laser focused on achieving our mission and finding a way forward, even when it's hard. We are nimble and maintain a sense of urgency, swiftly adapting to change and overcoming obstacles. ### **The opportunity** Altruist is in the midst of an exceptional growth phase and we're excited to hire Senior Back End Engineers to join our growing Engineering organization. We have multiple teams hiring for high impact \& high visibility projects, with a particular focus on the security, scalability, and reliability of the platform our clients trust with their assets. jobs.title: Principal System Debug Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.** At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** As a Principal System Debug Engineer, you will lead the system\-level debug of our advanced microprocessors within complex customer applications and system design environments. You will act as the critical bridge between our internal silicon/software engineering teams and our top\-tier OEM, ODM, and Hyperscaler customers. This is a highly visible, cross\-functional leadership role that requires deep technical expertise in CPU architecture, high\-speed I/O interfaces, firmware/BIOS, system software, drivers, OS/kernels and software stacks, and platform hardware design, signal integrity, power integrity. You will drive the investigation, root\-cause analysis, and resolution of the most complex, system\-level CPU issues in the context of new system bring\-up and customer applications and platform level debug. **THE PERSON:** You are a subject matter expert and strong technical contributor with strong processor architecture, hardware and software expertise, and extensive system level debug experience. You excel as part of a team where technical leadership, customer engagement, communication and team skills are highly valued. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:*** **Technical Leadership \& Debug: Lead** the triage, investigation, and root\-cause analysis of complex system\-level issues involving CPU silicon, platform hardware, firmware, drivers and OS/hypervisor interactions in customer environments. * **System Bring\-Up: Drive** early platform bring\-up activities for next\-generation CPUs, both in internal labs and on\-site at customer facilities, ensuring rapid time\-to\-market. * **Customer Engagement: Serve** as the primary technical liaison for strategic customers. Guide customer engineering teams through platform design, debug methodologies, and issue resolution. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner** closely with internal Silicon Design, Architecture, Firmware (BIOS/UEFI/BMC), OS/Kernel, and Validation teams to drive systemic fixes and influence future CPU architectures based on customer feedback. * **Debug Methodology \& Tooling: Architect** and develop advanced debug methodologies, scripts, and tools to accelerate issue isolation across the hardware/software boundary. * **Escalation Management: Act** as the technical task force leader during critical customer escalations, providing clear executive updates and driving technical action plans under tight deadlines. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** **CPU Architecture: Deep**, foundational knowledge of modern CPU architectures (x86 mandatory), including pipelines, cache coherency, memory controllers, and power management (C\-states, P\-states). RAS features, MCA (Machine Check Architecture), SoC and platform security features, RoT (root\-of\-trust). * **I/O \& Interconnects: Extensive** expertise in the architecture and protocol\-level debug of high\-speed I/O interfaces, including PCIe (Gen 4/5/6\), CXL, DDR4/DDR5, Ethernet, USB, and low\-speed buses (I2C, SPI, I3C, eSPI). * **Firmware \& Software Stacks: Strong** understanding of the full system software stack, including BIOS/UEFI, BMC/IPMI, Linux/Windows kernel internals, device drivers, and hypervisors (KVM, VMware, Hyper\-V). * **Platform Design: Solid** grasp of system\-level hardware design, including board schematics, PCB layout, power delivery networks (VRMs), clocking, and signal integrity fundamentals. * **Hands\-On Debug: Proven** track record of performing complex system bring\-up and debug using hardware tools (JTAG/ITP debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers) and software debuggers (GDB, WinDbg, kernel panics/crash dump analysis). * Experience working directly with Cloud Service Providers (Hyperscalers) and Tier\-1 Server/Client OEMs. * Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, C, C\+\+) for test automation and debug tool development. * Hands\-on expertise in debugging hardware (system bring\-up, signal integrity, power integrity issues) and debugging firmware/software running on actual hardware platforms. * Experience with RAS (Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability) architecture and machine check exception (MCE) analysis. **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:** Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. **LOCATION:** Austin, TX or San Jose, CA preferred, hybrid option available. **This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.** \#LI\-MV1 \#HYBRID Qualifications: *Benefits offered are described:* AMD benefits at a glance. *AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third\-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.* *AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. This is one of the top individual contributor levels in the Field Service Engineer path — the work is technical leadership, not supervision. **What You Will Be Working On** * Serve as the technical expert for an assigned product, module, or application at a customer site. * Lead diagnosis and resolution of the most complex hardware, software, and integration failures. * Own tool\-down escalations end to end, including documentation and closure. * Lead root\-cause investigations on quality and repeat events, and drive the corrective actions. * Identify failure trends across the fab and act on them before they become downs. * Create technical training material and mentor FSEs to increase module proficiency. * Drive improvements to ASM procedures and customer specs — redlines, spec edits, drawing corrections. * Partner with spares and the customer to convert reactive work into proactive maintenance. * Travel domestically and internationally (25–75%). **What We Are Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Electronics, Electro\-Mechanical Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent military technical training. * 10\+ years of field service or semiconductor manufacturing experience on complex capital equipment. * Demonstrated ownership of critical escalations in a high\-volume production environment. * Deep troubleshooting capability on microprocessor\-controlled electro\-mechanical systems, including issues without a documented path. * Fluency reading and redlining electrical, electronic, and electro\-mechanical schematics. * Structured problem solving and root\-cause analysis, with documentation others can follow. * Proven ability to coach and develop other engineers. * Credibility with customer engineering and operations leadership. **What Sets You Apart** * Deposition experience — ALD, epitaxy, PECVD, PEALD, or vertical furnace. * Prior role as module owner, escalation owner, or site SME. * Track record building and delivering technical training. * Knowledge of vacuum, closed\-loop gas control, and electro\-pneumatic systems. * Experience working around toxic and flammable gases in a fab environment. * History of converting recurring failures into permanent design or procedure changes. **Apply today to be part of what’s next.** We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting\-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect. jobs.title: Facilities Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction to the job** --------------------------- ASML is a global leader in the high\-tech semiconductor equipment manufacturing industry. We are seeking a skilled and detail\-oriented Mechanical Engineer to support the operation, maintenance, and optimization of our facilities infrastructure. This role is critical to ensuring the reliability, efficiency, and safety of our complex mechanical systems, which enable the success of our manufacturing operations. The Mechanical Engineer – Facilities will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and supporting the operation of major facilities systems such as HVAC, DI water, process water, chillers, boilers, pumps, exhaust systems, heat exchangers and roofing systems. This role also involves overseeing the distribution of process gases and liquids critical to manufacturing processes. The ideal candidate has deep technical knowledge of mechanical systems and experience in facilities engineering within a high\-tech or manufacturing environment. **Role and responsibilities** ----------------------------- Mechanical Systems Design \& Optimization: * Design, analyze, and improve mechanical systems to enhance efficiency, reliability, and performance. * Evaluate system performance metrics and implement upgrades or modifications as necessary. Facilities Operations \& Maintenance Support: * Provide technical expertise for troubleshooting and maintaining HVAC, process water, DI water, chillers, boilers, and other critical systems. * Develop and refine preventative and predictive maintenance programs to minimize downtime. Fluid and Gas Distribution Systems: * Design, maintain, and optimize distribution systems for process gases and liquids, ensuring adherence to safety and operational standards. * Monitor system flow, pressures, and integrity to support manufacturing needs. Project Management Support \& Implementation **:** * Lead mechanical engineering projects from concept to completion, including expansions, upgrades, and new installations. * Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and cross\-functional teams to ensure project milestones are achieved. Compliance \& Safety: * Ensure all mechanical systems comply with regulatory, environmental, and safety standards. * Support sustainability initiatives, including energy efficiency improvements and waste reduction strategies. Capacity \& Risk Management: * Assess current mechanical system capacities and plan for future growth to meet operational needs. * Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies to address potential system failures. Documentation \& Reporting: * Maintain detailed records of system designs, performance data, maintenance activities, and project updates. * Prepare reports and presentations for management, highlighting system performance and improvement opportunities. **Education and experience** ---------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. * 8\+ years of experience in facilities engineering with a focus on mechanical systems in a high\-tech or manufacturing environment. * Strong expertise in HVAC, DI water, process water, chillers, boilers, and heat exchangers. * Experience with gas and liquid distribution systems, including piping, valves, and control systems. **Skills** ---------- * Proficiency in engineering software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, or equivalent). * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail. * Excellent organizational, communication, and teamwork skills. * Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification. * Experience in high\-tech manufacturing, such as semiconductor or pharmaceutical industries. * Knowledge of safety and environmental regulations (e.g., OSHA, ASHRAE). **Other information** --------------------- * Occasional travel to support projects or troubleshoot system issues across sites. * Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast\-paced environment Additional Responsibilities: There is potential for exposure to strong magnetic fields, high voltage and currents. The current base annual salary range for this role is currently: $117,600\-161,700 Pay scales are determined by role, level, location and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of several factors that that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job\-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and pay relative to other team members. The Company offers employees and their families, medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees are able to participate in the Company’s 401k plan. Employees will also receive eight (8\) hours of vacation leave every month and (13\) paid holidays throughout the calendar year. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
