jobs.title: Snr. Constructability Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Are you passionate about shaping how data center infrastructure is designed, built, and brought to life? As a Senior Constructability Engineer at Amazon, you will embed directly into first\-of\-a\-kind and new\-product programs — including next\-generation cooling, racking, and modular designs — catching constructability and commissioning issues during design maturation, well before they reach the field. You will validate new construction methods such as prefabrication and modularization, quantify their schedule, cost, quality, and carbon impact, and convert field\-proven innovations into fleet\-wide standards. If you thrive at the intersection of design engineering and hands\-on construction delivery, this role offers the chance to influence how Amazon builds at global scale. Key job responsibilities \- Embed into first\-of\-a\-kind and new\-product programs (new cooling, racking, modular and Design for Manufacture and Assembly solutions) during design maturation to identify and resolve constructability and commissioning risks before they reach sites \- Run first\-of\-a\-kind validation, vendor qualification, and deployment\-readiness assessments to confirm new designs meet construction and operational requirements * Develop and validate new means and methods — prefabrication, modularization, new materials — and quantify their schedule, cost, quality, and carbon impact * Convert field\-proven innovations into fleet standards by supporting basis\-of\-design intake and specification updates across the global infrastructure portfolio * Partner with product owners, construction management teams, and manufacturers on integration and buildability across products, driving consistency and technical alignment A day in the life You are reviewing new\-product designs for buildability, visiting prefabrication facilities for factory acceptance tests, running first\-article deployment assessments, and quantifying the benefit of a new method against the current standard. You work upstream of the field so that when a new product reaches a site, it is genuinely deployable — and you package what works into a standard the whole fleet inherits. About the team Our Constructability Engineering team works at the heart of Amazon's global data center delivery program. We partner across design engineering, construction management, product development, and manufacturing to ensure that every new infrastructure concept can be built safely, efficiently, and at scale. Our focus over the coming years is accelerating the adoption of modular construction, new cooling technologies, and sustainable materials — and this role is central to making that happen. If you want to shape the future of how critical infrastructure is delivered worldwide, we would love to hear from you.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 6\+ years of data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance experience * 6\+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience * Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment * Experience in data center design, construction, operations, or facility maintenance * Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities * Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * Professional Engineering or Architectural License * Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region * Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production * Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- At Amazon's Alexa Shopping, we strive to enable shopping in everyday life. We allow customers to instantly search \& order whatever they need, by simply interacting with their Smart Devices such as Echo, Fire TV or any Alexa powered device. Our Services allow you to shop, no matter where you are or what you are doing, you can go from 'I want that' to 'that's on the way' in a matter of seconds. We are seeking the industry's best to help us create new ways to interact, search and shop. Join us, and you'll be taking part in changing the future of everyday life. The Alexa Shopping group is seeking a talented engineer to help build and drive the evolution of Routing Technology across Alexa's shopping ecosystem. You'll work on the horizontal technology that orchestrates how requests route to specialized shopping verticals, enabling seamless experiences from product discovery to post\-purchase on Alexa. In this role, you will build the next generation of AI\-driven routing technology. You will build and operate highly scalable systems to power delightful shopping experiences across various Alexa\-powered devices. You will work closely with multiple partner teams across Alexa to deliver innovative solutions that enhance the customer experience. About the team We are Foundational Routing Technology team, part of Alexa Shopping in Seattle. We own the routing layer upstream of every Alexa Shopping experience: the technology that decides which specialized shopping capability answers each customer request The work carries outsized reach. A single routing change shifts traffic across the entire shopping ecosystem, which means high ownership, careful engineering, and visible impact This is hands\-on AI engineering, not AI\-adjacent. jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, Amazon Catalog
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- What if the system you built today was used by hundreds of millions of people \- not hypothetically, but literally? Amazon Selection \& Catalog Systems (ASCS) is the engine behind the world's largest product catalog. Billions of products. Hundreds of millions of real\-time updates daily. Every price change, every new listing, every inventory shift, our systems make it happen, 24/7/365, at a scale where textbook solutions simply don't apply. We're hiring a Software Development Engineer (L5\) to join our Selection \& Curation Systems team in Seattle, and this isn't your typical SDE role. What Makes This Different This team is early\-stage by Amazon standards. We're building brand\-new services and tools from scratch, no legacy baggage, minimal operational burden, and a roadmap packed with greenfield projects scaling to worldwide customers this year. You won't just write code. You'll drive technical design across organizational boundaries, own end\-to\-end solutions, and tackle problems that sit at the intersection of massive scale and real ambiguity: Ensuring product identity and traceability at global scale. Processing and normalizing standardized product data from trading partners worldwide. Extracting structured data from unstructured content using LLMs Automatic classification of items and data at catalog scale Big data visualization and analytics pipelines Massively distributed systems that push the limits of scale and performance If you've ever wanted to work on problems where the answer doesn't exist yet and build it, this is that opportunity. Who You Are You have strong technical design instincts and can architect systems that work reliably at extreme scale You're comfortable leading across team boundaries — aligning with business owners, senior developers, and principals You're energized by ambiguity and greenfield work, not intimidated by it You ship, you learn, you iterate Why This Team, Why Now Direct impact on hundreds of millions of customers and sellers worldwide, your work shows up in the shopping experience, every day Ground floor of a new technology stack with a clear scaling trajectory Cutting\-edge problem space: LLMs, distributed systems, big data, applied to real products at real scale A team that's fast\-moving, collaborative, and genuinely fun to work with Interested? Reach out to amolsola@ to learn more or start a conversation. We'd love to tell you more about what we're building. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Communications
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Security’s Security Communications (SecComms) team builds and operates the platforms, tools, and systems that enable Amazon’s security organization to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders at scale. We support security events, ongoing security programs, vulnerability communications, and strategic initiatives that span multiple Amazon business units and AWS services. Our engineering products are the connective tissue between security findings, remediation owners, and the people responsible for keeping Amazon and its customers safe. We are seeking an experienced Software Development Engineer to drive the design, development, and operation of software systems that power security communications workflows, automation, and integrations at scale. This role is for a builder who brings engineering rigor to ambiguous problems, cares deeply about customer outcomes, and thrives working across organizational boundaries with security engineers, program managers, and communications professionals. Security Communications serves as the engineering and operations hub for AWS\-related security messaging, stakeholder notification, and communications tooling across the organization. Our team is responsible for building scalable platforms that enable consistent, reliable, and timely communication during high\-severity security events, coordinated vulnerability disclosure, and routine security program operations. We are a cross\-functional team — engineers work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with communications professionals, security operations personnel, AWS service owners, and executives. Candidates should be comfortable collaborating in this environment and contributing to discussions that span both technical and non\-technical domains. Key job responsibilities Design \& Delivery * Design and deliver software features and improvements spanning the full lifecycle — including scoping, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance — for major portions of the SecComms platform. * Work backwards from customer and stakeholder needs to define requirements and translate them into well\-designed, maintainable software solutions. * Design cohesive software implementations for difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks; bring clarity to ambiguous requirements and identify simple, extensible designs. * Balance constraints across new feature development, technical debt, and operational reliability; limit short\-term workarounds in favor of sustainable solutions. * Produce high\-quality, well\-tested, documented code that adheres to the Amazon Code Bar and can be maintained and extended by teammates who did not author it. Operational Excellence * Demonstrate operational excellence in all work; own and operate production services with appropriate alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and on\-call response. * Actively participate in operational support; identify and resolve the root causes of operational issues rather than accepting the status quo. * Routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve team operational processes, automation, and tooling — do not settle for operational friction when it can be eliminated. * Ensure that software failures are addressed with permanent fixes; avoid recurring incidents by addressing systemic causes. Collaboration \& Cross\-Functional Partnership * Work closely with security engineers, program managers, communications leads, and partner teams to understand the business and customer value of your software. * Operate effectively across team and organizational boundaries; collaborate with adjacent teams in an inclusive and constructive manner when integrations, dependencies, or shared priorities arise. * Balance customer requirements with team requirements; make effective priority tradeoffs between feature development and operational work. * Communicate clearly and proactively about work in progress, technical decisions, blockers, and scope changes to all relevant stakeholders — both technical and non\-technical. Mentorship \& Engineering Culture * Actively mentor engineers on the team; provide substantive, constructive code review feedback to peers including more senior engineers. * Train new team members on how the SecComms software is constructed, tested, operated, and secured — and how it fits into the broader Amazon Security architecture. * Document what the team’s software does, how it is constructed, and how it connects to the bigger picture; keep documentation current as systems evolve. * Seek feedback actively and early; incorporate feedback into designs and implementations to continuously raise the engineering bar. * Evaluate and apply industry innovations — new tools, design patterns, and AWS capabilities — where they improve team outcomes. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we  al to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores. Inclusive Team Culture In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices. Training \& Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, training, and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent * Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems * Knowledge of Machine Learning and LLM fundamentals, including transformer architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization techniques * Familiarity with security domains including incident response, vulnerability management, security operations, or coordinated disclosure Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Benefits Technology
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon’s healthcare and benefit programs are among the largest investments the company makes in its people, and BXT is building one of the most ambitious AI\-native platforms anywhere at Amazon to protect the value of those programs for more than a million employees and their families. This is not AI bolted onto an old process. It is a platform architected from the ground up around large language models and autonomous agents that reason over healthcare claims at a scale and depth no rules engine has ever matched — making sure the dollars Amazon spends on employee health reach the care employees actually need. Across a population this size, a small share of medical claims drive an outsized share of program cost. In partnership with Amazon’s health plan, we are building agentic systems that read live claims as they flow, reason about which ones merit a closer look, assemble the evidence, and route them for review before they are paid — so the program spends more on care and less on avoidable waste. The patterns worth finding never hold still, so the platform is built to learn: models retrain, agents improve from every outcome, and the system gets sharper every week. This is a big\-data and AI\-forward engineering role where the work has real consequences and the technology is genuinely frontier. You will build agentic systems that read live claims, reason about them with large language models, assemble their own evidence, and produce results a person can trust and act on. Correctness, latency, and availability are first\-order requirements because these results feed decisions about benefit programs — and precision matters more than volume, because a wrong result costs an employee time and confidence in their benefits. Key job responsibilities * Design, build, and operate the AWS services that turn live claims data into signals Amazon can act on \- the real\-time pipelines, data stores, and scoring services \- owning their correctness, latency, and availability alongside their results. * Build generative\-AI in production, not beside it: LLM\-backed evaluation, multi\-agent workflows where specialized agents reason from different perspectives and assemble the evidence, retrieval over claims and reference data, and the test harnesses that keep model behavior predictable. * Build the models and the machinery around them \- feature pipelines, scoring, threshold management, and the retraining path that keeps them sharp as patterns move. Routine volume resolves automatically; everything else routes to a person with the context they need. * Build the review surfaces a person works in: what the platform found, why it surfaced, the supporting data behind it, and a durable, auditable record of what was decided. * Design and operate the real\-time data exchanges with Amazon’s health\-plan partner, working directly with their engineers to solve entity resolution at scale \- probabilistic matching, blocking strategies, and merge/split policy for records that share no common identifier. * Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, technical design, and sharing best practices. **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, IES SRDEX
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Join us in Bellevue as we innovate on behalf of our customers in Amazon's fastest growing market: emerging markets. Our mission is to build transformative programs that don't just adapt existing solutions but reimagine them entirely for the customers and communities we serve. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Amazon customers expect every product they receive to be authentic, undamaged, and exactly as described. You will drive end\-to\-end ownership of the product quality investigation journey, making architectural trade\-off decisions across ML model design, hardware\-software integration, and pipeline orchestration. You will partner with applied scientists, software engineers, hardware teams, and operations stakeholders to define the technical vision, prioritize capabilities, and ship solutions that reduce product condition complaints for hundreds of millions of customers worldwide. This role offers the opportunity to shape how Amazon verifies product authenticity and condition at global scale through AI/ML systems. Key job responsibilities 1\. jobs.title: Work Based Learning Program Data Center Operations Technician
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking Data Center Technicians as part of our Work Based Learning Program (WBLP). This trainee position requires the successful candidate report to a site location. Amazon has multiple WBLP trainee openings between June and December of 2026\. Physical Requirements (reasonable accommodations available): * Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41\+ pounds * Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after\-hours support as needed * Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments * Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8\+ hours a day * Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation * Tolerance for working in non\-climate\-controlled environments with temperature fluctuations. NOTE: Amazon is not able to provide immigration sponsorship now or in the future for these positions. Eligible candidates must have work authorization without employer intervention to be considered. NOTE: If applying for positions in Oregon (OR) and Ohio (OH), these sites are within AWS GovCloud region. Effective May 15, 2017, logical access to the AWS GovCloud region will be restricted to Amazon employees who are U.S. Persons (GovCloud may NOT be accessed from outside of the United States). Key job responsibilities * Performing server rack installations, hardware break\-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues, and responding to operational incidents that impact service availability, escalating to senior technicians and management as needed/required * Serving as a contact point for both internal and external stakeholders, including engineers, software developers, vendors, and contractors * Performing on\-call duties and participating in scheduled maintenance and change management activities * Contributing to documentation and process improvement initiatives based on your analysis of operational issues * Successfully completing the 12\-month Work Based Learning Program training curriculum, including all required safety certifications, technical competencies, and performance milestones. A day in the life Day in The Life As a Data Center Technician professional, you will grow into an industry\-leading role and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge while you * Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution * Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context * Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting You may be required to work shifts that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays. Traveling within the regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and a valid driver’s license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided. About the team AWS is committed to providing a safe and healthy work environment. The WBLP training program has a focus on safety, as a WBLP you will be trained on data center safety, policies, procedures, and guidelines. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Work/Life Balance We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. jobs.description: **About Us** American Century Investments® is a leading global asset manager with over 65 years of experience helping a broad base of clients achieve their financial goals. Our expertise spans global equities and fixed income, multi\-asset strategies, ETFs, and private investments. Privately owned and independent, we focus solely on investment management. But there’s an unexpected side to us, too. We direct 40% of our dividends every year—over $2 billion since 2000—to the Stowers Institute for Medical Research. Our ongoing financial support drives the Institute’s breakthrough work and mission of defeating life\-threatening diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s. So, the better we do for our clients, the more we can do for everyone. All who work here around the globe are inspired every day by the unique difference our hard work can make in so many lives. It shows in the curiosity we bring to every initiative, the deep relationships we build with our clients, and the way we treat each other in the hallway. If you’re excited to **Role Summary** The **Software Engineer** is a role on the IT Client Experience team focused on helping build, support, and improve ACI’s digital client\-facing platforms and experiences, including public websites, authenticated web experiences, mobile capabilities, and related Sales and Marketing technology integrations. The primary responsibility of this role is to learn and contribute across day\-to\-day engineering and production support activities, including troubleshooting issues, validating releases, making code changes, improving support documentation, and partnering with senior engineers to keep digital experiences reliable, secure, accessible, and easy to use. This position is well suited for an engineer early in their career who is eager to grow skills in modern web development, cloud\-native platforms, integrations, observability, and production support while learning how technology enables client, advisor, sales, and marketing experiences. This role reports to the IT Manager – Software Engineering. This hybrid position will be based out of our Kansas City, Missouri office. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without visa sponsorship, now or in the future. **How You Will Make an Impact** **Digital Experience Engineering \& Production Support** * Support ACI’s client\-facing digital platforms by helping troubleshoot production issues, service requests, defects, and operational questions. * Assist with triage by gathering details, recreating issues, reviewing logs or monitoring data, and coordinating with the appropriate engineers, product owners, vendors, or support partners. * Help validate releases, hotfixes, content changes, and configuration updates to ensure web and mobile experiences are ready for production use. * Provide clear status updates during support issues and contribute to post\-incident notes, follow\-ups, and documentation. * Maintain and improve runbooks, troubleshooting guides, support documentation, and standard operating procedures for owned applications and integrations. **Web, Mobile \& Platform Reliability** * Monitor application behavior, alerts, recurring issues, and client experience impacts across supported web, mobile, and marketing technology platforms. * Assist with root\-cause analysis and help implement fixes that reduce repeat issues and improve reliability, performance, accessibility, and supportability. * Learn how front\-end applications, APIs, content platforms, analytics, authentication, and third\-party services work together to deliver end\-to\-end digital experiences. * Support operational readiness by reviewing changes, checking deployment results, and confirming that monitoring and documentation are in place. **Software Engineering \& Technical Growth** * Develop and maintain small enhancements, bug fixes, automated tests, and configuration updates for supported digital platforms. * Participate in code reviews, testing, deployment activities, and technical discussions with guidance from senior engineers. * Build familiarity with modern web development practices, including JavaScript/TypeScript, component\-based UI development, APIs, CI/CD, cloud hosting, and observability. * Learn and apply team standards for secure coding, accessibility, performance, maintainability, and production readiness. * Use AI\-assisted engineering tools responsibly to improve productivity while following team review, testing, and governance expectations. **Team Collaboration** * Work closely with product owners, engineers, QA, UX, Marketing, Sales, operations, and support partners to understand priorities and deliver reliable digital solutions. * Ask questions, seek feedback, and actively learn from teammates while building ownership of assigned work. * Contribute to team rituals such as stand\-ups, backlog refinement, planning sessions, demos, and retrospectives. * Communicate clearly with  cal partners, especially when explaining issue status, risks, or next steps. **What You Bring to the Team (Required)** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, finance, business, or an equivalent combination of education and work experience. * Professional software development, technical support, internship, co\-op, or related technology experience. * Experience using AI\-assisted software engineering tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to support software development activities such as coding, debugging, testing, documentation, code review, and problem solving, with the ability to evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs * Foundational understanding of software engineering concepts, problem solving, debugging, and application support. * Interest in learning modern web technologies, APIs, cloud platforms, production operations, and digital client experience systems. * Ability to communicate clearly, ask good questions, document findings, and follow established processes. * Willingness to support production systems and occasionally respond to urgent issues or release\-related needs. * Demonstrates the American Century Investments Winning Behaviors: Client Focused, Courageous and Accountable, Collaborative, Curious and Adaptable, jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: The American College of Physicians (ACP) is looking for a Data Engineer to join the Technology division. ACP, a national organization of internal medicine physicians with headquarters in Philadelphia, is the largest medical specialty organization and the second\-largest physician group in the United States. This is a full\-time hybrid position with 2 days in\-office (Philadelphia HQ) per week required. The Data Engineer will provide technical leadership responsibility for building and managing enterprise\-wide data transformation and orchestration processes and data pipelines. This work will require expertise in several layers of our enterprise data infrastructure, including our diverse source systems, our medallion\-modeled data lakehouse, data activation platforms, and the orchestration and transformation of data as it flows throughout the entire data estate. Responsibilities include but are not limited to: * Provides technical leadership in data pipeline design and development organization\-wide, ensuring data flows are orchestrated in alignment with business needs and system architectures. Emphasis will be on ingestion, unifying transformations, and deliveries to activation platforms via the data lakehouse. * Ensures that designs and techniques are compliant with system architectures as well as data management and governance standards and policies in place within the organization. * Uses agile software development processes, in collaboration and alignment with the development, analyst, and data administration teams, to make iterative deployments with full visibility and change tracking. * Ensures documentation of data models, transformations, and orchestration remain current, comprehensive, semantically precise, and accessible to all staff. * Partners with others across the data management team to collaborate with business stakeholders, ensuring that pipelines are optimized for quality, reliability, contextual accuracy, and actionability. * Plays a key role in enterprise data architecture design and analysis, including interactions with consultants and contractors. * Monitors data systems and flows, utilizing automated tooling to ensure successful and reliable pipelines. Qualifications: * A Bachelor's degree is required, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Data Science, or another field closely related to data engineering. * Demonstrable experience with the Snowflake platform and related tooling, e.g., dbt and Fivetran, is required. Currency in the evolution of Cortex Code (CoCo) and Semantic Views is highly desirable. * At least 3 years of experience designing and developing data pipelines in modern data engineering environments is required. Experience working with large\-scale (1M\+ records) customer and behavioral data models and systems, e.g., “Customer 360” models highly desirable. * Experience with multiple techniques for modeling and transformations, e.g., ETL, reverse ETL, and modern ELT techniques/platforms, as well as real\-time/streaming processes, e.g., Apache Kafka. * Strong understanding of all stages of integrated, data lakehouse\-oriented architectures, from ingestion to semantic modeling to delivery/activation. * Deep experience with core data engineering coding techniques/languages: SQL, Python. * Experience working within multiple large\-scale API\-based, cloud architectures, e.g., Amazon AWS\-based and Microsoft Azure\-based is highly preferred. * Excellent oral and written communication skills are essential to interact with all levels of College staff, members, and external resources in both group and one\-on\-one settings. ACP offers a competitive salary, superior benefits and a supportive work environment. Learn more and apply online at: https://www.acponline.org/working\_at\_acp/jobs/. ACP is an Equal Opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: Joining Amex Tech means discovering and shaping your contribution to something big. Here, you can work alongside talented tech teams and build a unique career with the Powerful Backing of American Express. With a range of opportunities to work with the latest technologies, and a commitment to back the broader engineering community through open source, our mission is to power your success. Because Amex Tech is powered by our technology, our culture, and our colleagues. The Technology organization enables and accelerates the company’s growth strategies, delivering global capabilities and services in support of Amex’s customers and colleagues, while maintaining 24/7 servicing and availability to ensure an uninterrupted, high\-quality customer experience. Technology provides the foundation for everything we do in the company while driving differentiation through building and leveraging innovative technology and data insights. Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom\-and\-pop shops to approximately 70% of the S\&P 500\. We are the number one issuer of small business cards, the industry leader in corporate T\&E and represent approximately 40% of the company’s total revenues. Our vision is to be essential to our customers’ businesses every day. We do that by offering a diverse suite of payment and cashflow tools our customers need to run and grow their businesses, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage their financial and payment needs. * Significant hands\-on software engineering experience building and operating large\-scale, business\-critical applications. * Strong programming and software design skills with the ability and desire to contribute directly to production software. * Deep knowledge of modern software engineering practices, distributed systems, APIs, microservices, and highly available architectures. * Strong public cloud fundamentals and experience designing, building, and operating cloud\-native applications. * Experience modernizing legacy applications, architectures, and engineering patterns while managing complexity and technical risk. * Experience with modern engineering practices and tooling across CI/CD, automated testing, observability, infrastructure automation, and production operations. * Experience applying AI\-enabled tools and capabilities across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity and quality. * Demonstrated ability to diagnose and solve complex technical and production problems across application and platform layers. * Broad technical curiosity with the ability to quickly learn new technologies, platforms, and enterprise tooling. * Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence technical decisions, mentor engineers, and work effectively across engineering teams. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience. Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the U.S. is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: As a Senior Software Engineer, you will help build Alamo, the internal MES/ERP platform powering The American Housing Corporation’s design, real estate, manufacturing, operations, and supply chain workflows. You will work across the product surface: from polished user\-facing workflows in Next.js to durable backend services, database models, integrations, and operational tooling. You will build software that helps architects design and configure homes, helps real estate teams identify developable opportunities, and helps manufacturing teams turn designs into physical products. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who likes working close to the business, understands that excellent software is both technically rigorous and deeply practical, and wants to help build the operating system for a new kind of housing company. **What You’ll Be Working On** * Build fullstack product workflows for Alamo, our internal MES/ERP system. * Build software that helps architects design, configure, and refine homes from concept through production. * Build tools that help the real estate team evaluate land, identify developable opportunities, and understand project feasibility. * Design and implement production\-grade frontend experiences using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui. * Build backend services and APIs using NestJS, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and shared Zod contracts. * Model complex operational domains including parts, inventory, production, purchasing, quality, work orders, real estate, design systems, and factory workflows. * Partner directly with manufacturing, supply chain, finance, design, real estate, and operations teams to turn messy real\-world processes into clear, reliable software. * Own features from discovery through implementation, rollout, iteration, and long\-term maintenance. * Help establish engineering patterns for a system that will scale from early internal tooling into mission\-critical infrastructure. * Improve system reliability, observability, performance, security, and developer experience. **Qualifications** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong experience building fullstack web applications in TypeScript. * Deep familiarity with React and modern frontend architecture. * Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including API design, data modeling, service boundaries, and production debugging. * Experience with relational databases, especially PostgreSQL. * Track record of shipping complex product features in ambiguous environments. * Strong product judgment and ability to work closely with non\-technical operators and stakeholders. * Care for craft: clean abstractions, thoughtful UI, robust tests, and maintainable systems. * Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, high\-ownership environment. * Experience with manufacturing, ERP, MES, inventory, logistics, construction, or industrial software is a plus. **Additional Information** * The company provides comprehensive benefits, PTO, and participation in company equity programs. * This is an in\-person role in Austin, TX for builders who want to work closely with the people using the software every day. * No visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Part Time Research Assistant Data Scientist and Engineer
jobs.description: American University is a student\-centered research institution located in Washington, DC, with highly\-ranked schools and colleges, internationally\-renowned faculty, and a reputation for creating meaningful change in the world. Learn more about American University **Department:** Kogod School of Business**Time Type:** Part time **Job Type:** Temporary (Fixed Term)**FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt**Work Modality:** **Union:** Excluded**Job Description:** **Summary:** This part\-time research assistant position will hold the functional title, Research Data Scientist and Engineer. The Research Data Scientist and Engineer position supports the design, development, and analytical infrastructure of the CRPD Disability Rights Dashboard (https://idpp\-crpd\-dashboard.share.connect.posit.cloud) which is a first\-of\-its\-kind NLP\- and AI\-powered platform that makes the full UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD) reporting cycle searchable, visual, and actionable. With support from the National Science Foundation (NSF) through the American University Translating Research into Action Center (TRAC), the dashboard will scale to include data and analyses for all nine\-core human rights treaties and implementation/monitoring communities. This position integrates data science, software engineering, and applied research, contributing to the analytical methods that generate insight from UN treaty body documents and the technical systems that deliver those insights to users. Responsibilities include developing and refining NLP and text analysis pipelines, designing and computing indicators and metrics from structured and unstructured data, building and maintaining the Streamlit\-based dashboard and its supporting codebase, collaborating on AI\-assisted research features, managing deployment and infrastructure on Posit Connect Cloud, contributing to the platform's evolution toward a comprehensive Advocacy Toolkit, and supporting user testing, documentation, and research dissemination activities. The position reports to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Derrick Cogburn, and works at the intersection of disability rights research, data science, and software development. The position will be based in the American University Institute on Disability and Public Policy (https://www.idppglobal.org). IDPP is a multidisciplinary, cross\-campus research center that creates and disseminates knowledge that enables all persons to participate effectively in society, locally, nationally, and globally. IDPP uses supervised and unsupervised machine learning, deep learning, text analysis, natural language processing (NLP), and large language models (LLMs) to evaluate progress on disability rights globally and specifically on implementing the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (CRPD) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). IDPP also explores the role of accessible information and communication technologies (ICTs) and digital technologies, including telepresence robots and mobile apps, to accelerate full participation in society for persons with disabilities. IDPP was the lead organization for the AU 2030 Strategic Initiative on Global Disability and Development and worked in conjunction with several other campus organizations to lead the Strategic Research Initiative on Inclusive Technology and Policy (ITP). IDPP was founded in 2009 through the generous support of The Nippon Foundation and was initially focused on Southeast Asia. IDPP works in partnership with the World Bank’s Disability Data Hub (https://disabilitydata.worldbank.org/en/home) and the Disability Data Initiative (https://www.disabilitydatainitiative.org/) led by Fordham University. Both initiatives providing quantitative disability data for the Disability Rights Dashboard. **Essential Functions:** 1\.) Computational Research and Data Science/Analytics * Design, develop, and refine NLP and text analysis pipelines for processing UN treaty body documents, State Party reports, Committee concluding observations, and related human rights records. * Compute quantitative and qualitative indicators from structured and unstructured data sources, including keyword\-based text analysis, sentiment analysis, and thematic classification across CRPD articles. * Build and maintain data ingestion, cleaning, and transformation workflows to ensure the dashboard reflects current and accurate treaty body data. * Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in CRPD implementation and reporting across 190\+ States Parties. * Support the expansion of analytical methods to additional UN core human rights treaties beyond the CRPD. 2\.) Dashboard and Software Development * Build, maintain, and enhance the Streamlit\-based CRPD Disability Rights Dashboard, including front\-end UI components, interactive visualizations, and data filtering systems. * Manage the codebase architecture, ensuring clean separation between data\-loading ds. * Coordinate with the Principal Investigator on project timelines, sprint planning, and milestone tracking. * Support infrastructure management including environment configuration, dependency management, and CI/CD workflows. **Competencies:** * Acquiring and Analyzing Information. * Prioritizing and Organizing. * Acting Ethically and With Integrity. * Displaying Creativity. * Serving Customers. * Supporting a Diverse and Inclusive Community. * Supporting Coworkers. **Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:** * Part\-time. * 20 hours per week. * This is a temporary position ending on or before Dec. 31, 2026\. **Salary Range:** * $20\.00 per hour. **Required Education and Experience:** * Master's degree in Data Science, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Science, Computational Social Science, or a closely related field. * Less than 1 year of relevant experience. * Demonstrated proficiency in R and Python programming for data science applications, including data manipulation, statistical analysis, and visualization. * Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques and text analysis methodologies. * Experience with version control systems (Git/GitHub), including branching, pull requests (PRs), and collaborative workflows. * Familiarity with machine learning concepts, including model training, evaluation, and deployment. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data from real\-world sources. * Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively in an academic or applied research environment. * Coursework in machine learning, artificial intelligence, deep learning, NLP and text analytics, and advanced data analytics. * Coursework or training in international affairs, public policy, human rights, or disability studies. * Familiarity with Quarto, R, Python, Positron, GitHub, or other tools used in academic research and data communication. **Additional Eligibility Qualifications:** * Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Benefits** **Other Details** * Hiring offers for this position are contingent on successful completion of a background check. * Employees in staff positions at American University must deliver their services to the university from either the District of Columbia, Maryland, or Virginia, or perform work on\-site at the university. * Please note this job announcement is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. * American University is an E\-Verify employer. **Current American University Employees** American University current employees must apply through their employee Workday account. If you are a current employee at American University, please log into Workday and select the Find Jobs report which will take you to our internal career listings. **Contact Us** For more information or assistance with the American University careers site, email theworkline@american.edu. *American University is an equal opportunity, affirmative action institution that operates in compliance with applicable laws and regulations. The university does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, national origin, religion, sex (including pregnancy), age, sexual orientation, disability, marital status, personal appearance, gender identity and expression, family responsibilities, political affiliation, source of income, veteran status, an individual’s genetic information or any other bases under federal or local laws (collectively "Protected Bases") in its programs and activities.*

jobs.title: Customer Trust Specialist
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As a Customer Trust Specialist at Anthropic, you'll work on the customer\-facing security engagements that build the trust and transparency for large enterprises to leverage Claude with their critical workloads. You'll partner closely with Go\-to\-Market, Legal, Deal Desk, Product, and Security to make Anthropic's security posture straightforward for customers and their auditors to understand. When a negotiation, audit, or executive briefing gets beyond what the standard process handles, you'll pick it up and see it through. As you resolve things, you'll turn what you learn into reusable positions, playbooks, and a knowledge\-bank content. Building with Claude is a normal part of this job. You'll use it to automate evidence gathering, support internal research and knowledge building, and build tooling for yourself and the team. This is an individual contributor role for someone who works well independently, doesn't need much structure to be effective, and enjoys being the person who reliably handles hard cases well. If you've been a Head of Security or similar at a smaller company and want to go deep on the customer\-facing work without managing a team, this is a good fit. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Negotiate security terms and schedules with regulated enterprise customers, exercising judgment on what to hold and what to escalate; when a deal needs a new position, help develop it with Legal * Take on complex customer questionnaires, RFPs, and security assessments that fall outside the standard answer bank, and drive them to completion * Run onsite and remote security audits with strategic accounts: scope the agenda, walk customers through our controls, work through disputed findings, and drive them to documented closure * Speak to our security posture in customer briefings where CISOs ask detailed questions about architecture, data handling, retention, tenancy, and model training, answering accurately and in depth * Contribute to the team's library of Legal\-approved positions, the canonical answer bank, and audit runbooks, so that resolutions become repeatable * Build with Claude: contribute to the team's AI\-powered questionnaire and RFP automation, automate information gathering across internal systems, and help verify machine\-drafted responses before they go out * Help write and maintain customer\-facing trust artifacts (white papers, FAQs, Trust Center content, architecture diagrams), and check that security claims match how our systems actually work before they ship * Route control gaps and new\-capability asks surfaced by customers to the right Product and Security owners, and follow through to closure * Notice patterns across audits, questionnaires, and negotiations, and surface them to Customer Trust and Security leadership as signal about where customer expectations are moving * Track engagement metrics (escalation volume, remediation follow\-through, deal impact) and report on them regularly **Minimum qualifications** -------------------------- * Solid security expertise in at least one domain, from engineering to governance, risk, and compliance, with working fluency across the others * Hands\-on experience with customer\-facing security work, including audits, security questionnaires, contract security terms, or executive briefings with regulated enterprises * Ability to hold a security position under pressure, weigh business needs against security requirements, and recognize when the right answer is to move * Comfortable talking security with a customer CISO and then checking a claim's accuracy with an infrastructure engineer, and committed to telling customers only what you've verified internally * Experience writing positions, playbooks, or standard answers that teammates actually used * Clear written communication, because your positions, runbooks, and summaries are what others work from * Ability to get engineering, Legal, and GRC colleagues to prioritize and close work without having authority over them * Comfortable working independently and building the structure you need **Preferred qualifications** ---------------------------- * 10\+ years in security across any domain * Including 3\+ years in security leadership, ideally as Head of Security or similar at an early\-stage company: you've represented a security program younger and leaner than the enterprise programs evaluating it, and earned CISOs' confidence anyway * Have applied LLMs to security assurance or GRC work, such as questionnaire automation, evidence retrieval, or claim verification * Familiarity with finan fety) * Experience supporting contract negotiations by reviewing and refining security clauses and commitments The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $255,000 \- $270,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Materials R&D Lab Technician
jobs.description: Antora Energy delivers affordable, reliable energy to industry, data centers, and the grid. Our thermal batteries turn low\-cost electricity into always\-on heat and power, without supply\-constrained critical minerals or multi\-year construction timelines. We are growing our company with people who put team and mission first, value connection through laughter and joy, and work with humility and openness. We are committed to building a diverse, passionate, and creative team dedicated to a future powered by abundant, clean, low\-cost energy. ##### **Position Summary** Antora Energy is seeking a **Materials** **R\&D Lab Technician** to join our materials development team at our headquarters near San Jose, CA. In this hands\-on role, you will partner directly with engineers to execute high\-temperature experiments using benchtop furnaces and supporting lab equipment — work that is central to developing the novel materials inside Antora's thermal energy storage systems. You will be responsible for setting up and running tests, operating instrumentation and data acquisition systems, and producing clear, thorough documentation of every experiment. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced hardware R\&D environment, is meticulous about data quality, and takes pride in keeping a lab running smoothly. ##### **Roles \& Responsibilities** * **Experiment execution:** Set up, operate, and monitor benchtop furnaces and other high\-temperature lab equipment according to test plans and procedures defined by engineers. Manage sample preparation, fixturing, and loading/unloading of test articles. * **Instrumentation \& data collection:** Install, configure, and operate DAQ systems, thermocouples, and other sensors to capture temperature profiles, environmental conditions, and material response data during experiments. * **Documentation \& reporting:** Maintain detailed lab notebooks and digital test records for every experiment. Compile data summaries, charts, and observations into clear reports for the engineering team. * **Equipment maintenance:** Perform routine calibration, preventative maintenance, and minor repairs on furnaces, instrumentation, and lab tools. Flag equipment issues early and coordinate with vendors or internal teams for resolution. * **Lab operations:** Keep the lab organized, stocked, and compliant with safety protocols. Track consumables and supplies. Support sample inventory and traceability. * **Safety:** Follow all EH\&S procedures for high\-temperature work, chemical handling, and general lab safety. Participate in safety reviews and report hazards or near\-misses promptly. * **Continuous improvement:** Suggest and implement improvements to test setups, fixtures, data collection workflows, and lab organization. Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with materials development engineers to understand test objectives, troubleshoot experiments in real time, and adapt plans based on emerging results. ##### **Key Qualifications** * Associate's degree or higher in a technical field (e.g., Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Physics, Chemistry, or related discipline), or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 3\+ years of experience working in a hardware R\&D lab, test lab, or similar hands\-on technical environment. * Direct experience operating furnaces, kilns, ovens, or other high\-temperature equipment. * Familiarity with data acquisition systems (DAQs), thermocouples, and common lab instrumentation. * Strong documentation habits — comfortable maintaining lab notebooks, writing test reports, and organizing data. * Proficiency with spreadsheets, databases, and AI for basic data organization, plotting, and analysis. * Detail\-oriented, safety\-conscious, and comfortable working independently once given clear direction. * Ability to lift and handle lab samples and equipment (up to \~50 lbs) ##### **Additional Qualifications Desired** * Experience with high\-temperature materials such as carbon, graphite, ceramics, or refractory metals. * Familiarity with CAD tools for interpreting engineering drawings and fixture designs. * Experience with PLCs, Python, AI, or other tools for data acquisition or analysis. * Exposure to Design of Experiments (DOE) methodology. * Prior experience in a startup or fast\-moving R\&D environment. * Familiarity with sample preparation techniques (cutting, grinding, polishing, mounting) using equipment such as table saws and bandsaws Work Location: Onsite \- San Jose, CA Salary Range: $35\-41/hr Salary Basis: Hourly Please note that the salary range listed above reflects Antora Energy's estimated pay for this position. jobs.title: Developer Writer
jobs.description: **The Role** Developers increasingly rely on AI search, coding assistants, technical communities, and traditional search engines to find and evaluate solutions. For Apryse to earn their attention, our content must be technically accurate, easy to discover, and genuinely useful. As a Developer Writer, you will create the technical content that helps developers understand what they can build with Apryse and how to get started. You will write tutorials, how\-to blogs, use\-case content, code\-led articles, and other documentation\-adjacent resources designed to answer real developer questions. This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who can turn technical concepts and product capabilities into clear, practical content. You do not need to be a software engineer, but you must be comfortable reading code, working with technical subject\-matter experts, and writing for an audience that values precision over marketing language. **Responsibilities** Create Technical Content Developers Can Use * Write how\-to guides, technical articles, use\-case content, and other documentation\-adjacent resources. * Translate product capabilities and technical concepts into clear, practical content for developers and technical decision\-makers. * Incorporate code samples, implementation steps, technical requirements, and relevant product details into marketing\-owned content. * Create content that answers specific developer questions and helps readers evaluate, adopt, and successfully use Apryse products. * Refresh and improve existing content to strengthen its accuracy, clarity, usefulness, and discoverability. Support Developer Discoverability * Execute technical content priorities identified by the AEO Program Manager and Manager, Content. * Partner with the AEO Program Manager and SEO specialists to address gaps in AI\-generated answers, coding assistants, search results, and other developer discovery channels. * Structure content so it can be easily understood by both developers and AI systems. * Apply content briefs, query research, competitive findings, and product positioning to each assignment. * Help ensure Apryse is accurately represented when developers research document\-processing solutions. Collaborate Across Technical Teams * Work with Engineering, Product, Product Marketing, and Documentation to verify technical claims and product details. * Incorporate technical feedback quickly and accurately while maintaining a clear, consistent voice. * Coordinate with content owners and subject\-matter experts to keep published content current as Apryse products evolve. Contribute to the Broader Content Program * Support additional Content team priorities, including ebooks, one\-pagers, campaign content, sales enablement materials, and BDR programs. * Adapt technical subject matter for different audiences, channels, and stages of the buyer journey. * Contribute to a developer\-focused brand voice that is credible, direct, useful, and free from unnecessary marketing language. **Requirements** * 2\+ years of experience writing technical content for developers or another technical audience. * Experience creating tutorials, how\-to articles, integration content, technical blogs, or documentation\-adjacent resources. * Ability to read, understand, and clearly explain code samples. * Strong writing and editing skills, with an emphasis on accuracy, clarity, structure, and usability. * Ability to translate complex technical information into content that is approachable without oversimplifying it. * Comfort working across multiple programming languages and SDK environments. * Experience collaborating with engineers, product teams, documentation teams, or other technical subject\-matter experts. * Strong attention to detail and the ability to incorporate technical feedback quickly. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and deliver high\-quality work against agreed timelines. **Skills \& Mindset** * You understand that developer trust is earned through accuracy and usefulness, not marketing claims. * You can tell when a technical explanation or code sample is incomplete, even if you are not writing production code yourself. * You are curious and comfortable asking detailed questions until you fully understand the subject. * You are an adaptable writer who can move between a technical tutorial, a use\-case article, and a broader marketing deliverable. * You are comfortable receiving direct technical feedback and revising your work accordingly. * You are organized, self\-directed, and able to turn a defined content brief into a polished deliverable. **Nice to Haves** * Experience writing for an SDK, API, developer\-tools, infrastructure, or software company. * Experience with API or SDK documentation and developer tutorials. * Familiarity with document\-processing technologies, including PDF SDKs, document conversion, data extraction, OCR, or digital signatures. * Familiarity with AEO, GEO, SEO, or writing content intended to perform in AI\-generated answers. * Experience testing code samples or working with GitHub repositories. * Basic video editing or screen\-recording skills for product and use\-case walkthroughs. **Compensation Philosophy** The compensation for this position is commensurate upon experience, and the range listed reflects total compensation or on target earnings. The top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive experience and a profile that strongly aligns with the senior expectations of this role. **Benefits:** * Competitive salary commensurate with experience and qualifications. * A comprehensive extended benefits package including health, dental and vision for you and your family, with company paid offerings. * An uncapped commissions structure. * Generous paid time off (PTO) is offered to support the ability to rest and recharge. * A great team environment and resources, supporting you to do the best work of your life and providing unlimited career growth potential. * Highly autonomous and entrepreneurial environment. * Annual recurring WFH allowance for you to purchase items you need for your home office. * Ongoing support for learning development so you can master your craft. * Work with the hardware you're most comfortable with (Windows or Mac). * Diverse and inclusive workplace where we all learn from each other. **Company Description** As the industry\-leading provider of document software development (SDK) technology powering everything from traditional desktop software to innovative web and mobile applications, at Apryse we are committed to delivering cutting\-edge technology solutions that empower our clients to achieve their goals. With a broad international portfolio of combined companies, products, and leading technologies, we are actively changing the way the world works with documents to make work better and life simpler. Customers like IBM, Autodesk, DocuSign, Boeing, Microsoft (and many more!) come to us to realize their web and mobile strategies for document management, editing, and collaboration as the \#1\-ranked commercial document SDK of choice for companies worldwide. As a result, you can find our document technology in thousands of solutions, including those of household names, used by millions across virtually every industry. Our XODO app alone has 25M unique installs \- and counting \- and the highest ratings among PDF productivity apps on the largest online app marketplaces. **Ready to join our team?** If you are interested in helping Apryse deliver on its commitments and taking your career to the next level, we invite you to apply online now. Additionally, we view the above section as a guide, not a checklist. We welcome diverse and non\-traditional backgrounds and encourage you to apply even if you do not have every requirement listed. We are committed to a work environment that is inclusive to all and free of discrimination. It is our policy to be an equal opportunity employer without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic predisposition or carrier status, veteran status, citizenship status or any other factors prohibited by law. Apryse will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
