jobs.title: Failure Analysis Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Us** With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world's leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e\-mobility a global reality. Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once\-in\-a\-lifetime opportunity to create an all\-electric future and a trillion\-dollar market. At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us. Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come. ### **Reports To** Sr. Manager \- Product Quality and Failure Analysis Engineering (PQE/FAE) ### **What You Will Be Doing** ChargePoint is looking for a Failure Analysis Engineer with an interest in hands\-on failure analysis lab of electronics and PCBA including AC/DC converters, DC/DC converters, electrical components, and modules. In this role, you will lead failure analysis investigations, interpret findings from electrical and physical testing, and communicate root cause conclusions to cross\-functional teams. You will own investigations end\-to\-end—from initial fault isolation through final corrective action—ensuring exceptional quality at every stage of ChargePoint's electric vehicle charging products. To be successful at ChargePoint this person must be highly motivated, self\-directed, and comfortable working in a loosely structured and fast\-paced environment. Training and mentorship will be provided for candidates who bring strong analytical foundations and a willingness to learn hands\-on electrical and physical analysis techniques. ### **What You Will Bring to ChargePoint** As a Failure Analysis Engineer, your responsibilities will focus on conducting and interpreting root cause analysis: * Lead system\- and component\-level failure analysis for customer field returns, new product introductions, and factory yield excursions; identify patterns across multiple failure events to surface systemic issues * Performs laboratory hands\-on electrical and physical failure analysis for fault isolation on electronic products (EVSE, AC/DC converters, DC/DC converters, PCBA, and cable harness); interprets test data and documents findings in formal failure analysis reports * Defines and executes test plans for functional electrical testing, circuit analysis, fault isolation, probing, and failure duplication; communicates root cause conclusions to engineering and cross\-functional stakeholders * Collaborates with engineering and operations teams to identify the root cause for issues related to field, manufacturing, supplier quality, and product design * Drives corrective and preventive action (CAPA) closure; maintains KPIs and databases; engages directly with suppliers or contract manufacturers on quality escapes as needed * Drives ambiguous problems to resolution independently, translating incomplete or conflicting data into clear findings and actionable next steps. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechatronics, or a related technical field with 0–2 years of experience (new graduates welcome). Relevant coursework, capstone projects, and internships count toward experience. * Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and component data sheets * Familiarity with electrical systems and components (PCBA, MOSFETs, IGBTs, Capacitors, Relays, Cable Harness, etc.) including their failure modes/mechanisms * Familiarity with or exposure to electrical test equipment such as Digital Multi\-meter (DMM), Oscilloscopes, Power Supplies, Electronic Loads, etc. * Familiarity with physical failure analysis techniques such as optical microscopy and 2D / 3D X\-ray * Experience applying problem solving tools including Root Cause Analysis * Ability to work independently as a self\-starter; comfortable driving investigations with limited guidance and adapting approach as new data emerges * Interest in electronics industry such as automotive, consumer electronics, solar, electric vehicle, AI data centre, or battery * Willingness to travel domestically and internationally up to 10% of the time ### **Location** Campbell, CA The base salary range for this role is $83K – $112K per year. In addition, this position is eligible for annual merit\-based RSU grants. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off; parental leave; life and disability insurance; and wellness resources. Compensation may be adjusted based on work location. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. ChargePoint is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.description: Description: At CloudBolt we help organizations maximize the value of their cloud investments through greater visibility, governance, and cost optimization across complex cloud environments. Our platform empowers teams to make smarter cloud decisions by turning insights into action, helping businesses improve efficiency, control spending, and accelerate innovation. As a remote\-first global SaaS company, CloudBolt is committed to fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performing culture where employees can do their best work and make a meaningful impact. Learn more at **www.cloudbolt.io**. As a **Senior ML Engineer**, you'll be building and owning the recommendation engine at the heart of our Kubernetes resource optimization product, StormForge, cutting our customers' cloud spend without putting a workload at risk. This is a critical hands\-on position at the intersection of applied machine learning and production engineering, where the hardest problems are as much about data quality, guardrails, and knowing when not to recommend as they are about forecasting itself. You'll need to bring rigor and curiosity in equal measure, designing time\-series models and the fallback strategies around them, proving their behavior through repeatable regression testing, and iteratively raising the ceiling on accuracy and safety as we discover and learn more about the workloads our customers run. **Responsibilities** * Own the recommendation engine end to end: model selection, algorithm design, preprocessing, and the guardrails that keep recommendations safe to apply to live production workloads. * Design, evaluate, and productionize time\-series forecasting and statistical models (e.g., Prophet, percentile\-based estimation) that right\-size Kubernetes workloads across CPU, memory, GPU, and JVM heap. * Build and maintain the data\-quality layer: detecting and filtering anomalies, load\-test windows, startup spikes, and autoscaling artifacts from production telemetry before it reaches a model. * Define and continuously improve how we measure recommendation quality: regression testing against golden datasets, behavioral validation, and accuracy/safety metrics in production. * Investigate and resolve recommendation quality issues reported from customer environments, tracing them through data, preprocessing, and model behavior. * Serve as the team's machine learning authority: guide technical direction on ML questions, make model\-vs\-heuristic tradeoff calls, and clearly communicate them to platform engineers, product, and leadership. * Write production\-grade Python for models and pipelines alike and share ownership of the surrounding service (message consumption, metrics ingestion, caching) with the rest of the team. * Prototype and validate new optimization capabilities (new resource types, new algorithms, new workload classes) from research through gradual, feature\-flagged rollout. * Stay current on time\-series forecasting and resource optimization techniques, and pragmatically evaluate which are worth adopting. Requirements: **Must have strong experience…?** * Master's degree or higher in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics). * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 years building and operating machine learning or statistical systems in production. * Expert\-level Python: you write typed, tested, production\-grade code, and you're fluent in numpy or similar array\-based numerical computing. * Hands\-on experience with time\-series analysis and forecasting: seasonality, trend decomposition, anomaly detection, and classical statistical methods (percentiles, distributions, smoothing), not just deep learning. * Experience testing ML systems rigorously: regression testing against known\-good baselines, behavioral validation, and reasoning about numerical reproducibility. * Working knowledge of Kubernetes: resource requests and limits, autoscaling behavior, and what happens to a workload when it's under\-provisioned (OOM kills, CPU throttling). * Comfort owning a production service, not just a model: queues, caches, retries, observability, and debugging issues in customer environments from logs and metrics. * Clear written and verbal communication: as an ML engineer on the team, so you must be able to explain model behavior and tradeoffs to platform engineers, product managers, and customers. **Experience in the following is beneficial** * Experience with Prophet or similar forecasting libraries. * Prometheus/PromQL and experience working with metrics at scale. * Cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, or infrastructure efficiency background * AWS (S3, Managed Prometheus). * Experience being the ML domain expert on a team of generalists. **We Offer** Our US benefits package includes: * Medical/Dental/Vision coverage * 401k with Company Match * Health \& Dependent Care FSA * Unlimited PTO * 11 Company Holidays * Volunteer/Community Engagement Day * Tuition Reimbursement * Paid Parental Leave * Equity Grants * Home internet Reimbursement Base Salary Range: $170,000 \- $220,000 USD Annually, actual compensation will be determined based on job\-related factors, including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs. **About CloudBolt** CloudBolt is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact **careers@cloudbolt.io****.**

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - REMOTE
jobs.description: Backend Engineer \- REMOTE About the role As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will make an impact by shaping the architecture and delivery of scalable backend services that support reporting, data access, scheduled processing, and data export. You will be a valued member of the engineering team and work collaboratively with product, quality assurance, and partner engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions. In this role, you will: * Own the technical roadmap for backend services supporting reporting, data access, scheduled processing, and export or delivery capabilities. * Drive and document architectural decisions across interdependent services and data sources while balancing immediate delivery needs with long\-term technical health. * Establish and enforce engineering standards for code quality, testing, API design, security, observability, and technical debt management. * Translate ambiguous requirements into executable technical plans, review designs and code, resolve complex engineering challenges, and contribute hands\-on code for high\-risk or high\-ambiguity work. * Partner with product, quality assurance, engineering teams, and vendors on scope, sequencing, dependencies, platform evaluations, and architecture decisions while mentoring engineers and strengthening technical judgment across the team. Qualifications: · 7\+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems, including demonstrated formal or informal technical leadership. · Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring or another modern backend language and framework, along with scalable distributed application design. · Proven ownership of architecture across multiple services, including REST API and service contract design, authentication and authorization patterns, and distributed\-system security tradeoffs. · Strong relational database expertise covering schema design, migrations, query performance, and system\-level data design. · Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform, plus containerization and continuous integration and delivery pipelines. Why Apply? We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. jobs.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
jobs.description: **Job Description** =================== **Position Summary:** --------------------- The Full\-Stack Web Developer advances the Division of Learning Innovation's ability to reach and support learners by developing, integrating, and maintaining reliable, accessible, and scalable digital pathways. This position supports learner\-facing websites, web applications, middleware, data connections, and application integrations across credit, noncredit, professional, continuing, Extension, and lifelong learning portfolios. As part of the technology and digital experience infrastructure supporting Learning Innovation, this position develops full\-stack web solutions that connect learner\-facing experiences with Salesforce, content management systems, registration platforms, payment gateways, marketing automation tools, analytics and reporting environments, Canvas/LTI tools, and other applications. The role supports front\-end and back\-end development, API integrations, secure data flows, accessibility, performance, documentation, testing, and operational continuity. The Division of Learning Innovation is a university\-wide enterprise dedicated to expanding access, strengthening learner success, and advancing innovative models of teaching and learning. Through CSU Online, Professional and Continuing Education, Osher Lifelong Learning Institute, Learning Innovation for Extension Programs, and other cross\-university partnerships, the division designs and supports learning experiences across the learner lifecycle, from open learning and noncredit credentials to degree pathways and workforce\-aligned programs. The primary work location and work arrangement for this position will be determined in alignment with university needs, role responsibilities, and CSU policies. Regular collaboration with campus and divisional partners is expected. Occasional travel or flexible work hours may be required based on launch timelines, system releases, incident response, partnership meetings, and learner or community engagement activities. **For full consideration, all materials must be RECEIVED no later than 12:00 AM Mountain Time on Monday, September 28, 2026\.** **Essential Job Duties:** ------------------------- * Develop, enhance, and maintain full\-stack web applications, learner\-facing websites, middleware, and custom functionality that support the Division of Learning Innovation across credit, noncredit, professional, continuing, Extension, and lifelong learning portfolios. * Build and maintain integrations among web forms, content management systems, Salesforce CRM, registration platforms, payment gateways, marketing automation tools, analytics systems, reporting tools, Canvas/LTI tools, and other applications using secure APIs, middleware, and reliable data exchange practices. * Translate learner journey, portfolio, enrollment, marketing and growth, accessibility, and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions, user flows, interface improvements, application features, and implementation plans. * Create and improve front\-end components and back\-end services using modern web standards, accessible and responsive design practices, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, relevant frameworks, C\#/.NET or comparable server\-side technologies, database queries, and version\-controlled code. * Configure, deploy, monitor, test, and troubleshoot development and production environments, integrations, release cycles, and code quality processes, including unit testing, code reviews, security updates, performance optimization, technical documentation, and maintainability practices. * Develop technical capabilities that support findability, search, SEO, event tracking, analytics, A/B testing, form submission, data capture, conversion measurement, personalization, and reliable handoffs into Salesforce and other learner\-support systems. * Provide timely technical consultation and support to Learning Innovation teams by diagnosing issues, prioritizing enhancements, coordinating with Salesforce administrators, DoIT, vendors, and application owners, and resolving web and application problems with a service\-centered approach. Maintain accessibility, usability, privacy, security, and data integrity standards for learner\-facing web and application work, escalating enterprise platform, compliance, institutional data, budget, or risk issues to appropriate divisional leaders and enterprise partners. * **Conditions of Employment:** ----------------------------- * Pre\-employment Criminal Background Check required for new hires. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States by the proposed start date; visa sponsorship is not available unless otherwise approved through standard university process. * Hybrid, remote, or on\-site work arrangement may be available based on role responsibilities, business needs, and CSU policies. Occasional travel or flexible work hours may be required based on business needs, launch timelines, system releases, e findings, or performance indicators to improve digital experiences. Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise, organize technical requirements, coordinate stakeholders, and move development work from need identification to implementation. * **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Experience with Salesforce, CRM integrations, Salesforce\-connected forms, Salesforce APIs, marketing automation, learner/student systems, or customer relationship management workflows. * Experience with content management systems such as Sitefinity, WordPress, Drupal, dotCMS, or comparable platforms. * Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs, middleware, data integrations, SaaS connections, .NET MVC, Entity Framework or other ORM tools, LAMP/WAMP stacks, cloud services, or comparable application architectures. * Experience with web analytics and optimization tools, Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4, event tracking, SEO, search tools, schema markup, A/B testing, or conversion measurement. * Experience supporting online learning, continuing education, Extension, lifelong learning, workforce education, higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or operationally complex digital environments. * Experience with Canvas, Learning Tools Interoperability (LTI), registration systems, payment gateways, reporting tools, accessibility testing, WCAG, semantic markup, ARIA, assistive technology, or remediation of legacy accessibility constraints. Experience working with IT, Salesforce, marketing, enrollment, learner success, academic, data, vendor, and cross\-functional teams on learner\-facing digital initiatives. * **Application Instructions:** ----------------------------- Please submit the following to apply: * Resume Cover letter addressing how professional experiences align with identified required and preferred qualifications of the position. * **Salary Range** ================ $110,000 \- $120,000 **Required Application Documents** ================================== To apply, please upload the following applicant documents. Ensure your materials fully address the required and preferred job qualifications of the position. Please note, applicants may redact information from their application materials that identifies their age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. Cover Letter, Resume/CV **Employee Benefits** ===================== Colorado State University is not just a workplace; it’s a thriving community that’s transforming lives and improving the human condition through world\-class teaching, research, and service. With a robust benefits package, collaborative atmosphere, and focus on work\-life balance, CSU is where you can thrive, grow, and make a lasting impact. * **Background Check Policy Statement** ===================================== Colorado State University strives to provide a safe study, work, and living environment for its faculty, staff, volunteers and students. To support this environment and comply with applicable laws and regulations, CSU conducts background checks for the finalist before a final offer. The type of background check conducted varies by position and can include, but is not limited to, criminal history, sex offender registry, motor vehicle history, financial history, and/or education verification. Background checks will also be conducted when required by law or contract and when, in the discretion of the University, it is reasonable and prudent to do so. **EEO** ======= Colorado State University (CSU) provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Advanced Quality Technician Specialist is responsible for advanced operation, programming, and maintenance of Coordinate Measuring Machines (CMM) and precision metrology equipment. This salaried role supports Quality, Engineering, and Production by ensuring accurate dimensional analysis, maintaining measurement systems, and improving inspection processes for a 150‑employee assembly manufacturing environment. **Key Responsibilities** * CMM Operation \- Perform daily setup, calibration, and operation of CMM equipment to support production and quality inspections. * CMM Programming \- Develop, modify, and optimize CMM programs using PC‑DMIS, Calypso, or equivalent software. * Dimensional Inspection \- Conduct first‑article, in‑process, and final inspections; interpret GD\&T and engineering drawings. * Metrology System Maintenance \- Maintain gauges, fixtures, calibration records, and metrology documentation. * Quality \& Engineering Support \- Partner with Quality Engineers and Production Supervisors to resolve dimensional issues and support root‑cause analysis. * Data Reporting \- Generate inspection reports, capability studies, and measurement data for PPAP, audits, and customer requirements. * Continuous Improvement \- Recommend improvements to inspection methods, fixtures, and measurement processes. * Compliance \- Ensure all measurement activities meet internal standards, customer specifications, and ISO/IATF requirements. **Qualifications** **Education** * Associate degree in Manufacturing, Engineering Technology, Metrology, or related field preferred. * Equivalent technical experience considered. **Experience** * 3\+ years of experience in precision measurement, CMM operation, or quality inspection in a manufacturing environment. * Experience with GD\&T, blueprint reading, and measurement systems analysis preferred. * Prior experience with PC‑DMIS, Zeiss Calypso, or similar CMM software strongly preferred. **Skills** * Strong understanding of GD\&T and engineering drawings. * Proficiency with CMM programming and metrology tools. * High attention to detail and accuracy. * Ability to analyze data and communicate results clearly. * Strong problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook). **CVG IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER** Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc (CVG) is an equal employment opportunity employer such that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. **Visa Sponsorship** At this time, we are not providing sponsorship for this role. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country of the job posting location on a full\-time basis. **No Unauthorized Referrals from Recruiters \& Vendors** Please note that Commercial Vehicle Group, Inc (CVG) and any of its affiliated companies does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or offers from third party recruiters or staffing agencies associated with any published or unpublished employment opportunities. Any unsolicited information sent to CVG will be considered as unencumbered and free from any fee or charge whatsoever. Only members of our Human Resources Team have the authority to engage or authorize recruiting services, which must be agreed upon before any resume or offer is received. **Career Scam Disclaimer** Commercial Vehicle Group (CVG) makes no representations or guarantees regarding employment opportunities listed on any third\-party website. To protect against career scams, job applicants should take the necessary precautions when interviewing for and accepting employment positions allegedly offered by CVG. Applicants should never provide their national ID numbers, birth dates, credit card numbers, bank account information or other private information when communicating with prospective employers or responding to employment opportunities online. Job applicants are invited to contact CVG through CVG’s website to verify the authenticity of any employment opportunities.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Developer** **ABOUT THE CONNECTICUT HOUSING FINANCE AUTHORITY:** Connecticut Housing Finance Authority ("CHFA") is a self\-funded, quasi\-public organization. Its mission is to alleviate the shortage of housing for low\- and moderate\-income families and persons in the state of Connecticut ("State") and, when appropriate, to promote or maintain the economic development of the State through employer\-assisted housing efforts. CHFA is a mission\-driven leader in creating affordable housing opportunities for families and individuals in Connecticut. We believe in the power of the diverse and inclusive communities we serve. We provide a challenging, progressive, and supportive environment that encourages and promotes employee development. We offer competitive salaries; tuition reimbursement; 457 deferred compensation, state\-sponsored pension plan, comprehensive health, dental, life, and disability plan, paid vacation, sick, and holidays, hybrid work schedule, ongoing training, career development, and, if qualified, employee may be eligible for student loan forgiveness under Federal Loan assistance program. **ABOUT THE POSITION:** This position serves as a developer and technical resource responsible for designing, developing, testing, implementing, and supporting software applications that meet CHFA's business and operational needs. The role combines hands\-on application development with technical expertise, contributing to solution design and promoting development standards and best practices across applications and databases. Working collaboratively with business stakeholders and IT staff, the position assists in defining business and system requirements and translating those requirements into practical, scalable, and maintainable technology solutions. The position participates in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, implementation, documentation, and ongoing support, with an emphasis on delivering secure, reliable, and high\-quality solutions. The position is also responsible for the development, enhancement, maintenance, and ongoing support of web\-based and Windows\-based applications used throughout the organization. In addition, the role coordinates software development initiatives from initial concept and requirements definition through implementation and successful delivery, working with stakeholders and other technical resources to ensure solutions meet established business and technical objectives. **SUPERVISION RECEIVED:** Receives directions from Assistant Director, Information Technology or a position of a higher grade. **SUPERVISION EXERCISED:** None **POSITION SUMMARY:** * Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain robust, scalable software applications and services using modern programming languages and frameworks. Provide programming support across the full software development lifecycle for both web\-based and Windows applications. * Define project scope and develop detailed project plans for the design, development, and implementation of information systems, including deliverables, milestones, and resource allocation. Collaborate with product owners, architects, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical specifications and actionable development plans. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code in accordance with established coding standards and best practices. Participate in code reviews to ensure high\-quality deliverables and provide constructive feedback to team members. * Develop a strong understanding of CHFA's business model, product lines, business processes, and legacy systems through stakeholder engagement, system analysis, and industry benchmarking with other Housing Finance Agencies (HFAs). * Troubleshoot and resolve complex software issues by identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions. Monitor application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement optimizations to improve reliability and user experience. * Provide second\-tier technical support for internal and external applications, including web and Windows applications, as well as third\-party products and services. * Develop ad hoc reports, data extracts, and queries to support program monitoring and business needs. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED****:** BS/BA in business administration or computer science preferred; jobs.title: Compressor Technician - Kermit, TX
jobs.description: Welcome to ConocoPhillips, where innovation and excellence create a platform for opportunity and growth. Come realize your full potential here. **Who We Are** We are one of the world’s largest independent exploration and production companies, based on proved reserves and production of liquids and natural gas. With operations and activities in 13 countries, we explore for, develop, and produce crude oil and natural gas globally. We are challenged with an important job to safely find and deliver energy to the world. Our employees are critical to our success, and with them we power civilization. We’re grounded by our SPIRIT Values – safety, people, integrity, responsibility, innovation, and teamwork. These values position us to deliver strong performance in a dynamic business – but not at all costs. We believe it’s not just what we do – it’s how we do it – that sets us apart. **Fostering an Inclusive Work Environment** To deliver superior performance, we create an environment that respects the contributions and differences of every individual. Wherever possible, we use these differences to drive competitive business advantage, personal growth and, ultimately, create business success. **Job Summary** ConocoPhillips's Lower 48 segment consists of operations located in the 48 contiguous U.S. states, with a portfolio mainly consisting of low cost of supply, short cycle time, resource\-rich unconventional plays and commercial operations. The majority of our acreage is unconventional. Based on 2025 production volumes, the Lower 48 is our largest segment and contributed 67 percent of our consolidated liquids production and 74 percent of our consolidated natural gas production. In 2025, net production averaged 1,484 MBOED. **Position Overview** As a **Compressor Technician,** you’ll play a critical role in ensuring safe, efficient, and environmentally compliant compressor performance across our assets. Based in **Kermit,** **TX** you’ll support new site construction, equipment installation, and ongoing optimization of compression systems. You’ll work closely with the Gas Lift/Compression Foreman, vendors, and field teams to drive operational excellence. Preference will be given to candidates who live within an hour’s commute of the work area. This is a **Safety\-Sensitive Position** . **Key Responsibilities** * Ensure safe and environmentally compliant operations for all company ‑ owned and rental compressors. * Train operators on shutdowns and safety devices. Verify devices are installed, tested, and functional. * Train field teams to meet or exceed environmental laws, rules, and regulations across all sites. * Support preparation, installation, startup, and performance of new compressor units. * Oversee site construction, equipment layout, and piping for new installations to meet design and compliance standards. * Coordinate operating conditions and evaluate vendor proposals for new installs. Secure required approvals for rental or purchase agreements. * Serve as the field point of contact for compressor vendors. Align on scope, timelines, and performance expectations. * Monitor and optimize compressor performance. Identify efficiency opportunities and operational risks. * Collaborate with operations engineers to recommend unit replacements or alternate lift solutions. Manage changes through plan, execute, and verify. * Assist pumpers and production foremen/supervisors with compressor issues to restore runtime and throughput fast. * Set up and maintain tracking tools with operations engineers and Compression Leads to measure runtime, mechanical availability, fuel usage, throughput, and environmental compliance. * Set up and troubleshoot alarm configurations for operators, coordinating with vendors when needed. * Document incidents and abnormal operations. Report findings and corrective actions to the supervisor promptly. **Inspection and Reporting Cadence** * Perform weekly inspections on new company ‑ owned and rental units during stabilization. * Perform quarterly inspections on units after acceptance into steady operations. * Complete daily operational reports for assigned areas. * Deliver weekly and monthly summaries and KPIs to the Gas Lift/Compression Foreman. **Success Profile** To thrive in this role, you’ll demonstrate the following Leadership Competencies: * **Drives** Performance: Delivers results through realistic planning to accomplish goals * **Builds** **Talent and Teams:** Takes an active role in acquiring, developing, and retaining a high performing, highly engaged team. * **Takes Accountability:** Takes ownership of actions and follows through on commitments by courageously dealing with important problems, holding others accountable, and standing up for what is right. **Qualifications** **Basic Requirements:** * Legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. * Valid driver’s license. * 5 or more years of experience in mechanical or maintenance roles. * 5 or more years of experience in compressor operations and maintenance. * Willing and able to meet the physical demands and work environment requirements outlined in this job description, with or without reasonable accommodation. **Preferred Requirements:** * 1 or more years of experience in the upstream energy industry. * 1 or more years of experience in a fast\-paced, multitasking environment. * Intermediate knowledge of compressor operation, maintenance, and repair. **Physical Demands \& Work Environment** * Work is performed outdoors in remote field locations with exposure to varying weather conditions. * Requires walking, bending, climbing, and lifting up to 50 lbs. * Frequent driving between sites in a company\-provided vehicle. * May involve working independently for extended periods. * Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) is mandatory. * Occasional unscheduled overtime may be required. **Apply By:** Sep 24, 2026 **Sponsorship:** ConocoPhillips’ sponsorship for employment authorization in the U.S. is NOT available for this position. **Benefits Overview** ConocoPhillips offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being and career growth: * **Taking Care of Your Health \& Wellness** : Medical, dental, vision, mental health support, and wellness programs. * **Supporting and Building Financial Security** : Competitive base pay, annual performance bonuses, and retirement savings plans. * **Promoting Work\-Life Balance** : Paid time off, paid parental leave, and family support resources. * **Offering Career Development** : Access to training, mentoring, and internal career mobility tools. * **Guiding Recognition \& Inclusion** : Peer\-nominated awards, inclusive culture, and employee resource groups. **Why ConocoPhillips** At ConocoPhillips, we believe our people power the future of energy. We’re committed to creating a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow—professionally and personally. We don’t just offer jobs—we offer meaningful careers in a company that values how we work as much as what we achieve. **EEO:** In the US, ConocoPhillips is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: **WE WELCOME YOU INTO A GROWING COMPANY** Consumer Direct Care Network is all about caring for people. Care is at our core, and we strive to live up to it every day. We provide services in 14 states across the USA, and our programs grow every year. We specialize in home and community\-based services that support individuals with disabilities and older adults so they can remain in their homes and communities.**Culture Vision at Consumer Direct Care Network** *At CDCN, we strive to create a workplace where everyone is supported and motivated to be their best; we collaborate on shared goals and celebrate our accomplishments.* **JOB SUMMARY** The Software Engineer II independently designs, develops, and maintains cloud\-based and web application components in support of business objectives. They contribute to full\-stack development, lead small projects, and mentor junior engineers. This role is responsible for writing clean, scalable code, ensuring system performance, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to define and refine technical solutions. A Software Engineer II is expected to follow coding best practices, participate in code reviews, and remain current with emerging technologies and development methodologies. **JOB DUTIES** * Independently develop website architecture for small to mid\-sized projects * Deploy and author code for cloud infrastructure and software components on the Azure platform, including: * + Azure Functions + Service Bus + Logic Apps + Cosmos DB (NoSQL) + Data Factory + Event Grid * Design and implement moderately complex user interactions on web pages * Develop and optimize back\-end website applications with minimal supervision * Create and manage databases to support application functionality * Ensure cross\-platform optimization and application responsiveness * Lead small projects through the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) * Design and develop basic APIs and support their integrations * Participate in team discussions, sprint planning, and story refinement sessions * Document technical solutions, implementations, and acceptance criteria * Collaborate with Quality Assurance to ensure adequate test coverage * Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers * Mentor and support Software Engineer I team members * Guide user stories through SDLC phases with oversight **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field * 2–4 years of experience in software development * Proficiency in object\-oriented programming languages such as C\# or Java * Strong experience with front\-end technologies and frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, HTML, CSS, JavaScript) * Working knowledge of server\-side languages such as Python, .NET, or JavaScript * Experience with relational and NoSQL database technologies (e.g., MSSQL, Cosmos DB) * Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment * Ability to manage multiple tasks and adapt to shifting priorities * Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours, if needed, to meet the job requirements * Employees must provide their own reliable internet if working a remote/hybrid position The incumbent typically works in an office environment and uses a computer, telephone and other office equipment as needed to perform duties. The noise level in the work environment is typical of that of an office. Incumbent may encounter frequent interruptions throughout the workday. The employee is regularly required to sit, talk, or hear; frequently required to use repetitive hand motion, handle or feel, and to stand, walk, reach, bend or lift up to 40 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU** When you join Consumer Direct Care Network, you will be exposed to numerous professional development opportunities. We welcome your contributions and value your integrity as we collaborate on work that moves us all toward a compassionate community. We have a long history of helping individuals build their careers in the home\-care industry. This is truly a place where there is something for everyone, whether you are looking to support a particular lifestyle, seeking professional growth, or seeking new and challenging work, all in an expanding nationwide company with that small\-company feel. Most importantly, you will experience the satisfaction of working in a culture built on caring. Caring for others comes naturally at Consumer Direct Care Network, based on our long history of connecting people and championing change, all geared toward helping others. We are proud of the longevity and loyalty of our employees. Their commitment to doing good work is what makes us a leader in the industry. **As a Consumer Direct Care Network team member you will receive:*** A rewarding career helping others * Fun and engaging work environment built on team unity * Job satisfaction knowing you make a difference in the work you do and lives we serve * Professional training to help advance your skills for career development **Based on your position and employment status, you may be eligible for:*** Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Vacation accrued at 3\.07 hours per pay period to use when accrued * Profit\-sharing for employees in good standing * Two Paid Floating Holidays * Nine Paid Federal Holidays * Paid Safe Sick Time accrued at 1 hour per 30 worked to use when accrued * Instant Earnings Option * 401(k) Retirement plan \& discretionary company match * Company\-Paid Life Insurance * Supplemental Life, Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital benefits * Short and Long\-Term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible Spending Account * Employee Assistance Program * Pet Insurance **WHO WE ARE** Consumer Direct Care Network specializes in home and community\-based services that assist older adults and individuals of all ages with disabilities and impairments to continue to live their lives independently in their own homes and communities. We provide coordinated service delivery in 14 states. Our services span from financial management services and support brokerage to traditional agency in\-home care and caregiving to behavioral health. We have extensive experience with Medicaid, Medicare, private insurance, and with supporting people who pay for their own care. Your opportunities within our network are endless, it’s not just a job, it’s a career… advance it with the Consumer Direct Care Network! The Consumer Direct Care Network and its subsidiaries are an Equal Opportunity Employer and drug\-free workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In accordance with the Immigration and Reform Control Act (IRCA), you may only work at Consumer Direct Care Network if you are legally authorized to work in the United States. Consumer Direct Care Network does not provide visa sponsorship or STEM OPT extensions to employees.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: What We Need Corpay is currently looking to hire an Site Reliability Engineer within our Prepaid card division. This position falls under our Corporate Payments line of business and is located in Brentwood, TN. This role will improve the reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency of the systems that power Corpay's Prepaid business across both on\-premise infrastructure and cloudnative workloads in AWS. A major focus will be reducing manual work, improving deployment and recovery processes, strengthening observability, and increasing automation across Corpay managed and vendor\-provided technology. Just as importantly, this role will help influence how engineering teams design and operate systems by promoting robust, scalable, automated choices rather than relying on manual operational processes. As Corpay becomes an AI\-native software engineering organization, this engineer will leverage AI to accelerate troubleshooting, automation, incident analysis, documentation, and delivery while applying strong engineering judgment. The Site Reliability Engineer is accountable for delivering high\-quality software while developing people, improving engineering practices, and partnering closely with Product Management and business stakeholders to achieve business outcomes. In this role, you will report directly to the Senior Software Engineering Manager in the Prepaid division. How We Work As a Site Reliability Engineer, Corpay will set you up for success by providing: * Workspace in Brentwood, TN location * Company\-issued equipment * Formal, hands\-on training * Access to modern AI\-powered engineering tools and platforms Role Responsibilities **The responsibilities of the role will include:** * Identifying reliability risks and opportunities for automation across applications, infrastructure, and vendor\-provided technology. * Designing and implementing automation that improves system resilience and team effectiveness. * Improving monitoring, observability, alerting, and the team's ability to quickly understand and resolve production issues. * Translating reliability concerns into practical technical guidance for developer teammates. * Troubleshooting complex issues across applications, infrastructure, and third\-party platforms and driving them to durable resolution. * Improving CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and other engineering practices that make software delivery safer and more repeatable. * Applying incident learnings to improve systems, automation, and operational practices. * Leveraging AI to accelerate software delivery, troubleshooting, and modernization. * Collaborating with other departments and stakeholders, and responsibilities as assigned. Qualifications \& Skills * Bachelor's degree in computer science/related field or equivalent experience * 5\+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Experience with AWS or Azure cloud services, as well as traditional on\-premise infrastructure. * Demonstrated ability to apply modern SRE practices to improve reliability, resilience, and team efficiency. * Experience with modern CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, monitoring, and observability practices. * Experience leveraging generative AI across software development, testing, delivery, or operations. * Experience designing and operating highly available, scalable, self\-healing systems in complex environments. * Experience with Git and modern source control workflows. * Excellent communication, collaboration, and technical leadership skills. Benefits \& Perks * Medical, Dental \& Vision benefits available the 1st month after hire * Automatic enrollment into our 401(k) plan (subject to eligibility requirements) * Virtual fitness classes offered company\-wide * Robust PTO offerings including major holidays, vacation, sick, personal, \& volunteer time * Employee discounts with major providers (i.e. wireless, gym, car rental, etc.) * Philanthropic support with both local and national organizations * Fun culture with company\-wide contests and prizes Pay Transparency The expected salary range for this position is $157,000 – $190,000 based on the candidate’s work location. This range reflects a good faith estimate of the expected compensation for this role at the time of posting. The final offer will be determined based on job\-related factors including skills, experience, qualifications, and applicable market conditions. Compensation may vary based on geographic location and will be confirmed during the hiring process. Additional compensation and benefits, including incentive programs, health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and other benefits (where applicable), may also be provided. About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. Our specialized payment solutions help businesses control, simplify, and secure payment for fuel, general payables, toll and lodging expenses. Millions of people in over 80 countries around the world use our solutions for their payments. At Corpay, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace where employees are valued for their diverse perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We believe that diversity, equity, and inclusion strengthen our teams, drive innovation, and support our continued success globally. As part of our hiring process, offers of employment may be subject to the successful completion of pre\-employment screening conducted by an authorized third\-party provider, in accordance with applicable laws and Corpay policies. jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer II, GenAI Evaluation Framework
jobs.description: **About the AI Accelerator** The AI Accelerator drives AI innovation across Cox Automotive. The team builds proof\-of\-concept agents, ships reusable AI components, sets evaluation and governance standards, and partners with product teams to bring AI into production. **About the Role** Cox Automotive is hiring a Machine Learning Engineer II to own and build the GenAI Evaluation Framework (GEF), the shared capability that measures whether AI agents running in production meet quality standards. This is a builder\-owner role. You own GEF as an internal product, which means you set the roadmap, decide what ships and what gets retired, and sequence which teams onboard. You also write the evaluators, pipelines, and reference implementations yourself. The framework already exists and has been proved in one production implementation with the Virtual Contact Assistant. The current work is turning that implementation into a product other teams adopt on its merits, since adoption across business units is voluntary. You will have the direct support of the Director of Machine Learning and AI on prioritization and executive alignment, and full latitude on the technical and product decisions inside GEF. **What You Will Own** * **GEF product roadmap.** Shared accountability with AI leaders of what ships next, what to generalize from the first production implementation, and what to deprecate. You help to maintain the roadmap and the reasoning behind it. * **Enablement queue.** You sequence which product teams onboard, when, and against what success criteria, and you negotiate that sequence with the teams involved. * **Framework build.** You implement and maintain LLM\-as\-judge, rule\-based, and statistical evaluators, and calibrate them against human\-labeled baselines. * **Evaluation pipelines.** You build and operate the pipelines that score agent traffic on a schedule and publish results to dashboards and the Cox Agent Registry. * **Golden datasets.** You work with product teams and subject matter experts to assemble, version, and maintain the datasets evaluation depends on. * **Onboarding and adoption.** You integrate GEF into adopting teams' agents, debug failures, and write the documentation and reference implementations that let the next team self\-serve. * **Quality reporting.** You publish framework adoption, agent quality health, and cost\-per\-quality metrics each month, and supply the audit trails and evaluation evidence governance reviews require. * **Agent instrumentation.** You help add tracing and logging to agent workflows and integrate evaluation checks into CI and deployment pipelines. **What Success Looks Like in Year One** * Three to four product teams onboarded to GEF, with golden datasets curated and evaluators calibrated against human baselines. * A published GEF roadmap that adopting teams and leadership both plan against. * Framework capability a new team can adopt from documentation and reference implementations without direct support. * Quality health published per registered agent in the Cox Agent Registry, on a monthly cadence, without manual assembly. * Pipelines that run reliably, with monitoring and runbooks that let someone else operate them. **Who You Will Work With** Inside the AI Accelerator: the engineers building GEF, the team embedded with the Virtual Contact Assistant pilot, and the broader CADS data science group. Across Cox Automotive: engineering and product teams at VinSolutions, Autotrader, Manheim, Dealertrack, and other business units as they onboard, plus Platform Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise AI, Security, and FinOps. **Required Qualifications** * Two or more years of professional machine learning engineering experience with a Bachelor's Degree, OR up to two years combined with a Master's Degree in a quantitative field. * Applicants must currently be authorized to work in the United States for any employer without current or future sponsorship. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** The energy industry is entering one of the most significant periods of growth and transformation in its history. Meeting the nation's growing demand for reliable electricity will require new ideas, new infrastructure, and talented people committed to building for the future. At Cypress Creek Energy, we're meeting that challenge by developing and operating the energy infrastructure needed to power communities, support economic opportunity, and strengthen resilience. We believe our responsibility extends beyond the grid and that how we build matters just as much as what we build. That same commitment extends to our employees. We invest in professional growth, encourage collaboration across teams, and provide opportunities to take ownership, expand your expertise, and advance your career. Our culture is grounded in safety, accountability, respect, and a shared commitment to deliver results. Join us and help meet one of the most important energy challenges of our time while building a rewarding career. **Overview** The Software Engineer is responsible for building and maintaining the backend services and APIs that Cypress Creek Energy's business runs on, and for applying machine learning and data science techniques to the forecasting and analytical challenges the business depends on. The role spans the full lifecycle: gathering requirements from business stakeholders, designing and implementing backend services and models, shipping them through the deployment pipeline, and supporting them in production. This role pairs deep backend software engineering with applied machine learning. The majority of the work is designing, building, and maintaining well\-tested APIs and services; that work is complemented by developing and deploying ML models that improve forecasting and data\-driven decision\-making across the business. Engineers build technical depth in the systems and models they own while expanding their domain knowledge of the renewable energy business those systems serve. **Responsibilities** Software Design \& Development * Design, build, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and internal applications. * Write clear, well\-tested, maintainable code and participate actively in code review. * Translate business requirements into technical designs. * Contribute to the team's engineering standards, shared libraries, and services. * Experience with event\-driven or stream\-processing architectures (Kafka or similar). Production Ownership * Deploy and operate services in production including monitoring and triage of failures. * Diagnose issues across service boundaries (application code, data stores, message streams, and third\-party dependencies) and resolve root causes. * Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment configuration for the services you work on. Data, ML \& Integrations * Apply machine learning and statistical modeling techniques to forecasting models and other data science initiatives across the business. * Build and maintain integrations between internal applications and enterprise systems. * Perform exploratory data analysis, feature engineering, and model validation using scientific Python tooling (numpy, pandas, and related libraries). * Design and evolve data models in the company's analytical data platform and write efficient queries against large datasets. * Build and maintain data pipelines and services that ingest, transform, and serve data from internal and third\-party sources. * Move ML models from prototype to production: package, deploy, monitor, and retrain models as part of the services you own. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Partner directly with business users (development, engineering, finance, and operations) to understand their workflows and turn ambiguous needs into working software. * Support internal users of the applications you own, including troubleshooting unexpected results and explaining technical behavior to non\-technical audiences. * Produce and maintain documentation that lets business users work independently and allows other engineers to pick up your work. Continuous Improvement * Identify and address technical debt, manual processes, and operational pain points in the systems you work on. * Evaluate new tools, libraries, and approaches, and make the case for adoption where they meaningfully improve the team's output. * Contribute to a culture of clear documentation, code quality, and engineering discipline across the team. **Education \& Experience Required** * 3\-6 years of professional software engineering experience with backend development in Python. * Experience designing, building, and consuming APIs. * Experience applying machine learning or statistical modeling techniques (for example, forecasting, predictive modeling, or other data science methods). * Experience with scientific or numerical Python (numpy, pandas, and related tooling). * Experience with databases, including schema design, migrations, and query performance. * Background in renewable energy development and/or operations \- solar development, energy modeling, performance engineering, or asset management. * Demonstrated ownership of software in production, including debugging and resolving live issues. * Strong written communication skills; able to document technical work and explain it clearly to non\-technical audiences. * Judgment to distinguish problems that warrant a robust engineered solution from those that need a fast, correct answer today. * Ability to manage ambiguity and drive work to completion with limited direction Preferred Qualifications * Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and container orchestration (Kubernetes). * Working knowledge of containers and CI/CD. * Experience integrating with Salesforce or a comparable enterprise system of record. * Familiarity with energy modeling. * Experience with ML frameworks and libraries (for example, scikit\-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow) or time\-series forecasting methods. * Embrace and live by the mission and values of Cypress Creek Energy. **Location:** The location for this role is one of our office locations: Durham, NC; or Washington, DC. Our team operates on a hybrid schedule, with in\-office schedule of three days per week. **Compensation:** The salary range for the position is$120,000 \- $150,000**.** This position is also eligible for an annual bonus. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate's qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. **Benefits:** * 15 days of Paid Time Off, accrual up to 20 days, 11 observed holidays. * 401(k) Match * Comprehensive package including medical, dental, vision and health insurance * Wellness stipend, family planning stipend, and generous parental leave * Tuition Reimbursement * Phone Bill Reimbursement * Company Swag **A note to Recruiting Agencies Cypress Creek Energy Human Resources team does not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiters, staffing firms, or related agencies. The Human Resources team coordinates all recruiting and hiring at our company. We do not accept resumes from third\-party recruiters unless authorized by the Human Resources team and if a signed agreement is in place. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered property of CCE and we are not responsible for any related fees. All communication related to recruiting partnerships should ONLY be directed to the Human Resources team.** **Cypress Creek Energy is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace that is inclusive and values diversity, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.** *Please be aware of recruiting scams—official communications will only come from @ccrenew.com, we will never request personal or financial information, and any suspicious activity should be reported to* *HR@ccrenew.com**.*

jobs.title: R&D Software Engineer
jobs.description: **R\&D Software Engineer** **About PDCflow** PDCflow is a proven leader in payment management and digital workflow software. Collecting payments, securing e\-signatures, and delivering invoices are the lifelines of business operation, but managing them separately can be tedious and time\-consuming. Our comprehensive platform combines secure payments and document workflows into one frictionless experience, leveraging decades of compliance expertise to streamline operations for our customers. **Role Overview** We are looking for a Software Engineer (R\&D Focused) to play a key role in building PDCflow’s next\-generation payment and transaction platform. First and foremost, you will be a hands\-on backend software engineer helping design, write, and deliver core features for our newest product. Beyond day\-to\-day product development, you will bring an exploratory R\&D mindset to the team: researching emerging technologies, building rapid proofs\-of\-concept (POCs), and identifying better ways to modernize our stack. Your main day\-to\-day work will be backend\-heavy (Java, Spring, PostgreSQL, Docker), building secure, high\-throughput engines for our new product line. Side\-by\-side with feature delivery, you will explore new tools (such as Claude Code and AI\-assisted dev workflows) and test lightweight frameworks (like Svelte) to continually optimize how our engineering organization builds, containerizes, and deploys secure financial technology. **What You’ll Do** * **New Product Development:** Design, build, and deploy production\-ready RESTful APIs and backend microservices for PDCflow’s newest platform features using Java and Spring Boot. * **Database \& Data Architecture:** Write efficient SQL, design relational schemas, and optimize database performance in PostgreSQL to handle high\-volume transaction processing. * **Containerization \& Operations:** Package, run, and optimize containerized services using Docker across local and deployment environments. * **Targeted R\&D \& Prototyping:** Research, benchmark, and build targeted POCs for emerging tools and architectural patterns before bringing viable solutions into our core codebase. * **AI Tool Integration:** Experiment with and incorporate AI\-assisted developer workflows (**Claude Code**, LLM coding agents) to accelerate refactoring, testing, documentation, and feature delivery. **What We’re Looking For** **Core Technical Skills** * **5\+ years** of hands\-on software development experience with a strong foundation in backend engineering. * **Java \& Spring Framework:** Solid proficiency in Core Java and Spring Boot for building robust backend services and REST APIs. * **Database Fundamentals:** Strong SQL skills with **PostgreSQL**—ability to analyze, design, and optimize data models during POC development. * **Containerization:** Experience using **Docker** for local development setups, containerizing applications, and environment configuration. * **Exploratory Mindset:** A track record of testing new libraries, tools, and developer utilities on your own initiative. **Nice\-to\-Haves / Bonus Skills** * Active experience or curiosity in AI\-assisted development tools (**Claude Code**, GitHub Copilot, or CLI LLM integrations). * Familiarity with lightweight web frameworks like **Svelte** for rapid front\-end prototyping. * Exposure to fintech, payment processing, or compliance environments (PCI\-DSS, HIPAA). * Familiarity with microservices architecture, messaging queues, or cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP). **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Flexible Hybrid Model:** Enjoy the best of both worlds with a balanced hybrid schedule at our Ogden, UT office—alternating between 2 days in\-office one week and 1 day in\-office the next (just 6 days in\-office per month). * **High Autonomy \& Freedom:** You get dedicated time and space to investigate new tech without being locked into rigid, repetitive ticket\-slog sprints. * **Direct Team Impact:** Your research and POCs will directly influence the tech stack, tooling, and day\-to\-day productivity of the entire PDCflow engineering team. * **Modern Developer Culture:** We actively embrace cutting\-edge AI utilities like Claude Code to automate boilerplate work and focus on solving real engineering problems. * **Competitive Benefits:** Comprehensive Health, Vision, Dental, 401(k) match, generous PTO, and team perks.

jobs.title: Director, Estimating and Preconstruction
jobs.description: Description Deploy's Client is revolutionizing the construction industry by integrating advanced manufacturing principles with innovative technology to deliver high\-quality, modular building solutions. We are driven by a mission to rethink how buildings are designed, fabricated, and delivered, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and sustainability. Deploy's Client is seeking a Director, Estimating \& Preconstruction to lead Deploy's Client entire estimating and preconstruction function across every platform category (Data Center, Healthcare, Retail, and emerging building types), together with the Associate Directors, Managers, and Estimators who staff it. This role owns the accuracy, integrity, and margin impact of every price Deploy's Client puts in front of a client; owns the historical cost database and the estimating standards the organization prices from; holds final pricing review authority prior to executive sign\-off; and presents pursuit, pricing, and margin performance to the Board and C\-suite. Program Management is the central nervous system of Deploy's Client, and estimating is the organ that translates design intent into accurate price and schedule commitment. Every pursuit Deploy's Client commits to is shaped by the precision and credibility of its estimates, and every margin protected or lost at execution traces back to the basis of estimate produced in preconstruction. Where an Associate Director owns pricing outcomes across the programs assigned to them, the Director, Estimating \& Preconstruction owns the fountainhead itself at an organizational level: the cost intelligence Deploy's Client prices from, the standards that govern how it is used, the capability to price building types Deploy's Client has never built before, and the estimate\-to\-actual discipline that turns every completed project back into a better estimate. This role sets what Deploy's Client is willing to price and on what terms, decides where estimating capacity and technology investment go, provides governance for escalated pricing disputes, and serves as Deploy's Client credible voice on modular cost and productivity inside the company and across the industry. **Job Responsibilities** **Estimating \& Preconstruction Leadership** Own the accuracy, integrity, and margin impact of Deploy's Client's preconstruction estimates at an organizational level. Accountable for pricing outcomes across all platform categories, **not oversight only.** Hold final review and approval authority over pursuit pricing prior to executive sign\-off; establish and enforce the estimate assumptions, risk registers, contingency, and escalation logic Deploy's Client is willing to stand behind. Own estimate\-to\-actual performance as a measured organizational outcome: lead post\-project cost reviews, drive corrective action, and translate reconciled actuals into improved benchmarks, unit costs, and productivity factors. Define, implement, and uphold organization\-wide estimating standards (templates, workflows, Basis of Estimate requirements, and data practices) for conceptual, schematic, design development, and GMP estimates. Own Deploy's Client's preconstruction relational database (historical cost, schedule, and bill of materials) as an enterprise asset; direct Technology and Finance investment to keep it accurate, current, and reconciled to ERP cost actuals. Lead capital and capacity planning inputs from the estimating function: manufacturing slot pricing and capacity assumptions, escalation strategy, labor market and supply chain exposure, and the estimating headcount and technology investment required to support forecast pursuit volume. Stand up estimating and preconstruction capability for new building types and platform categories. Establish first\-of\-a\-kind cost models, pricing structures, and schedule baselines where no historical data exists. Design and evolve the organizational structure of the Estimating \& Preconstruction function; make hiring, promotion, restructuring, and succession decisions across Associate Director, Manager, Estimator, and Assistant Preconstruction levels. Lead, mentor, and develop Associate Directors and Managers within the function; accountable for their performance, retention, and professional development, and for building the estimating leadership bench Deploy's Client growth requires. Set organizational standards for preconstruction pricing exercises end\-to\-end, covering subcontractor outreach and Building Connected administration, RFP compilation, pricing documents, price leveling, and award recommendation, and hold the function accountable to them. Own the go/no\-go and pursuit prioritization recommendation from an estimating standpoint; provide Deploy's Client Leadership with margin viability, capacity, and risk analysis for programs, clients, and pursuits under consideration. Establish the standards and cadence for program and project risk analysis in preconstruction; escalate organizational\-level pr s of those decisions to executive leadership. Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills; ability to synthesize complex pricing information for Board, Executive Leadership, and C\-suite client audiences. Advanced proficiency in estimating technology and preconstruction platforms (Building Connected, Sage Estimating, Timberline, WinEst, or comparable). Advanced proficiency in scheduling; ability to set organizational estimating\-phase scheduling standards and direct scheduling work across multiple platforms (MS Project, Primavera P6, and Smartsheet). Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel for portfolio\-level pricing and risk analysis. Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint) and Bluebeam. Strategic and operational leadership capacity; calm, precise, and decisive under pursuit pressure. Ability to travel up to 35% depending on pursuit activity and client engagement needs. **Preferred** Master's degree in a relevant field (MBA, Construction Management, Data Analytics, or similar). Relevant professional license, certification, or registration (PE, AIA, PMP, CPE, CCP, LEED AP, ASHE CHC, or similar). Established presence in the DMC, modular, or industrialized construction industry, including speaking, publishing, or participation in cost benchmarking and standards bodies. Demonstrated capacity to set analytical and data requirements for the estimating organization; ability to evaluate whether the right pricing analysis is being performed, not only whether the number is correct. Demonstrated ability to set organizational standards for cost modeling, estimating, and financial analysis; fluency reviewing complex pricing models at an executive level. Ability to interpret CAD, Revit, or SolidWorks models sufficient to lead constructability and design strategy discussions during pursuit, and to drive model\-based quantification. Working understanding of Python, SQL, and data modeling tools sufficient to evaluate and sponsor their application within the estimating database and pricing workflows. Working knowledge of AI/ML, statistical modeling, and data engineering concepts sufficient to set organizational adoption strategy for estimating intelligence and direct investment. Demonstrated ability to champion adoption of AI tools such as Claude.ai, Claude Code, Lovable, or Replit across estimating and preconstruction organizations; proven track record establishing adoption standards and performance benchmarks. Experience directing ERP reporting and data strategy (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central or comparable) for preconstruction and estimating cost actuals and historical reconciliation. Demonstrated senior\-level leadership experience in estimating, cost analysis, or data analytics within construction, manufacturing, or related industries. Experience operating within modular construction, industrialized construction, or design\-build environments. Benefits Deploy's Client offers the full spectrum of comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance. We also offer flexible spending accounts, paid time off, short term disability, long term disability, life insurance and a 401k plan. Deploy's Client believes in the growth of our people. We provide support for employees pursuing licenses/certifications, creating clear pathways for skill development and career advancement. Deploy's Client (LLC) is committed to making employment decisions based on an individual's qualifications, performance, and ability to contribute to our team. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are equally committed to maintaining a respectful and inclusive workplace. Harassment or discrimination of any kind based on a protected status is strictly prohibited.

jobs.title: SAP CPQ Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation

Our CPQ capabilities provide our clients with robust solutions to drive sales and enable channel partners and end\-customers with a low or no\-touch Configure, Price, Quote capability that removes friction in the Quote\-To\-Order and Lead\-To\-Cash processes.
