A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing \& Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer\-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in\-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead\-to\-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. **Qualifications** Required: * 5\+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience * 2\+ of experience working with a major CPQ technology vendor solution preferably SAP Callidus CPQ or SAP Hybris CPQ * Bachelor's Degree, advanced degree preferred * Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred * Proven experience building CPQ and lead\-to\-cash solution * Good understanding of Quote\-To\-Order and Lead\-To\-Cash processes * Good understanding of product structures (made to stock, made to order), configurations, product pricing and quote management * Hands on experience with CPQ configuration including organization, market, currency, simple and configurable products, attributes, compatibility rules, pricing, quote design, proposal documents and scripting extensions * Experience with software development and scripting technologies. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce. Recruiting for this role ends on December 9, 2026 **Work you'll do** Deloitte Digital offers services that enable client solutions using digital technologies, including the Web, Mobile, Social Networking, Digital Strategy, Digital Content and Digital ERP. The Digital Web team works with clients to advise, design, implement and deploy CPQ solutions. Our CPQ capabilities provide our clients with robust solutions to drive sales and enable channel partners and end\-customers with a low or no\-touch Configure, Price, Quote capability that removes friction in the Quote\-To\-Order and Lead\-To\-Cash processes. You are the soothsayer. You have gazed into the future of our clients' businesses, and you see a clear path to success. You understand what it takes to make complex SAP CPQ solutions happen, and you'll have a firm hand on the controls every step of the way. * Act as a lead on client projects and for junior staff. * Help define business requirements and process design (including scenario design and flow mapping). * Create functional designs, prototyping test planning and execution, training coordination, and documentation of operational support procedures. * Help clients define forward\-looking business strategies related to digital transformations. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** Deloitte's Advertising, Marketing \& Commerce team creates content and experiences that inspire action. We design and implement technology platforms for personalized marketing across all digital touchpoints, specializing in customer\-centric B2B and B2C solutions. Our in\-house agency engages customers throughout their journey, working on projects like AdTech, MarTech, campaign automation, CRM, and lead\-to\-loyalty orchestration. Join us to drive impactful customer interactions and business growth. **Qualifications** Required: * 5\+ years of relevant consulting or industry experience * 2\+ of experience working with a major CPQ technology vendor solution preferably SAP Callidus CPQ or SAP Hybris CPQ * Bachelor's Degree, advanced degree preferred * Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve * Limited immigration sponsorship may be available Preferred * Proven experience building CPQ and lead\-to\-cash solution * Good understanding of Quote\-To\-Order and Lead\-To\-Cash processes * Good understanding of product structures (made to stock, made to order), configurations, product pricing and quote management * Hands on experience with CPQ configuration including organization, market, currency, simple and configurable products, attributes, compatibility rules, pricing, quote design, proposal documents and scripting extensions * Experience with software development and scripting technologies. E.g., Python, .net, UI5 framework and SQL * An understanding of information architecture related to sales, dealer or customer experience and usability design techniques The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 \- $218,300\. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance. \#Customer\_US \#AMC\_US

jobs.title: AI Governance Analyst
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Dentsu is operationalizing AI at scale. Across every brand and practice, business teams are identifying AI\-powered tools, platforms, and vendors they want to deploy — and they need a fast, expert path through the governance process to do it safely. The AI Governance Concierge Service is dentsu's answer to that challenge — a dedicated, end\-to\-end service that gives any Americas business team a single expert point of contact for AI product adoption. The AI Governance Analyst is the research, documentation, and clarity engine that makes the service work. Every piece of information needed to evaluate, document, and submit a request flows through this role — and it is the Analyst's job to ensure that information is packaged with the precision and context that allows every reviewing group to do their job efficiently and confidently. Working in close coordination with the AI Governance Service Lead, the Analyst owns all research, documentation, and submission activity — transforming raw discovery findings into clear, complete, submission\-ready packages that give Legal, Information Security, Data Privacy, Emerging Technology, Procurement, and Global Enterprise Technology exactly what they need to reach informed decisions without unnecessary back\-and\-forth. The AI Governance Concierge Service is not simply an approval function — it is a service built around bringing every engagement to a successful conclusion. That means approving solutions that meet dentsu's standards, identifying alternative products or approaches that address the business need within governance requirements, and providing solutions that facilitate approval where possible. When risks are identified that prevent approval, the service's role is to clearly document and communicate those risks and leave the decision to the business to weigh the risk and reward. Success is a business team that always has a clear path forward — not just a ruling. **What You Will Do** **Vendor \& Solution Research** * Conduct structured research on AI tools, platforms, and vendors surfaced through the Lead's discovery conversations — understanding capabilities, architecture, deployment model, data handling practices, and integration requirements. * Build comprehensive risk profiles across all applicable governance categories: data privacy, security posture, model transparency, contractual terms, regulatory exposure, and reputational risk — structured to address the specific concerns of each reviewing function. * Gather the full evidence set required to support the review and approval process — including security certifications, privacy policies, data processing agreements, compliance attestations, contractual documentation, and vendor architecture materials. * Verify solution fit and redundancy — confirming whether the proposed tool is already covered by an existing approval or whether a preferred alternative exists in the dentsu\-approved landscape. **Documentation \& Submission** * Document the full business case for each request — capturing the business need, the proposed solution, solution fit, and rationale for moving forward. * Frame and present each submission with clarity and precision — ensuring that Legal, Information Security, Data Privacy, Emerging Technology, Procurement, and Global Enterprise Technology each receive the context, evidence, and framing they need to review confidently and reach decisions efficiently, minimizing back\-and\-forth across all reviewing functions. * Create and own all submission forms and supporting documentation on behalf of the requesting business team — submitting via AIRS and TPSA as required — ensuring accuracy and completeness before routing to the Service Lead for review. * Validate that the proposed product aligns with dentsu's AI, security, and data protection policies prior to submission — identifying and flagging gaps early to prevent delays downstream. * Update the AI Concierge Program Tracker with accurate progress during the research and submission phases, ensuring the Service Lead has a current view of all active engagements at all times. * Stay actively engaged through the review process — collaborating with the Governance Engineer when reviewers require additional research, documentation, or clarification, and responding with the thoroughness and speed needed to keep submissions moving. **Program Development — Research \& Submission** * Contribute to the ongoing improvement of the research methodology, submission process, and documentation standards as patterns emerge across the pipeline. * Identify recurring research gaps, vendor documentation issues, or submission quality patterns and surface them to the Service Lead with recommended process improvements. * Partner with Global Enterprise Technology to ensure project\-level process and policies are being met, and to work through new concepts emerging from incoming requests that could impact existing policy or warrant the creation of new   * Detail\-oriented and organized; able to manage multiple research workstreams simultaneously without letting accuracy or completeness slip. * Proactive and collaborative; able to operate independently on structured tasks while staying closely aligned with the Service Lead and Governance Engineer on identified priorities, timing, and evolving needs. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media, marketing, advertising, or professional services organization. * Familiarity with GenAI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act, ISO 42001\) or data privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA). * Background in vendor risk assessment, third\-party due diligence, or enterprise procurement research. * Exposure to enterprise AI platforms (Claude Enterprise, Microsoft Copilot, Google Gemini, or similar). * Experience with OneTrust, ServiceNow, Coupa, or similar enterprise compliance and workflow tools. * IAPP AIGP, CIPP, or equivalent certification is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** In your first 90 days, you have completed research packages for at least three active submissions, established a working rhythm with the Service Lead and Governance Engineer, and documented any recurring gaps in vendor documentation or submission quality. At six months, the Service Lead receives complete, accurate packages that require minimal revision before routing for review. Reviewing functions — Legal, Security, Data Privacy, and others — are getting what they need from submissions without having to ask for more. The Governance Engineer rarely needs to return a submission to you for additional information. You have contributed at least one process improvement to the research or submission methodology. At one year, the Analyst function is recognized internally as a force multiplier for the service — enabling the team to handle higher submission volume without sacrificing quality or accountability. Your submissions are consistently complete, your tracker updates are a reliable source of truth, and your research is shaping how the service evolves its approach to new technology categories. The annual salary range for this position is $94,875 \- $130,000\. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Benefits available with this position include: * Medical, vision, and dental insurance, * Life insurance, * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, * 401k, * Flexible paid time off, * At least 15 paid holidays per year, * Paid sick and safe leave, and * Paid parental leave. Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. jobs.title: VP, Senior Account Director
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Merkle is a leading data\-driven, technology\-enabled, global performance marketing agency that delivers unique, personalized customer experiences across platforms and devices. For over 30 years, Fortune 1000 companies have partnered with Merkle to maximize the value of their customer portfolios. With 16,000\+ teammates across 50\+ global offices, we bring together diverse expertise: 5,000\+ technologists and engineers, 4,500\+ data analysts and scientists, 3,000\+ strategists and operators, 2,500\+ loyalty and engagement experts, and 1,000\+ designers and UX professionals. As part of Dentsu, we combine media and creative excellence with data, CX, and technology depth to deliver end\-to\-end solutions. Merkle is seeking a VP, Senior Account Director to help grow and evolve our strategic partnership with Adobe. This role sits at the intersection of partnership management, digital transformation, solution strategy, and business growth, bringing together cross\-functional teams to identify opportunities, drive adoption, and deliver measurable business value. You will partner closely with stakeholders across Adobe, Merkle, and client organizations. The role requires executive presence, strong relationship\-building skills, and the ability to influence decisions across complex, matrixed environments. Digital Transformation at Merkle spans the design and delivery of web and app experiences, front\-end and back\-end development, user experience (UX), commerce platforms, customer experience technologies, and the ecosystems that connect them. As a result, this role requires a broad understanding of the Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem and how these solutions are designed, implemented, and brought to market. You will leverage this expertise to lead executive\-level client and partner conversations, shape engagement strategies, identify growth opportunities, and position Merkle's capabilities effectively in a competitive marketplace. **Responsibilities:** * Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Adobe and Merkle, serving as a strategic advisor on partnership priorities and growth opportunities. * Partner with product, consulting, engineering, delivery, and account teams to drive the development, adoption, and market success of Adobe\-based solutions. * Represent Merkle in executive client and partner discussions, translating complex technology capabilities into clear business outcomes and strategic recommendations. * Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and industry trends to inform solution strategy, partnership investments, and go\-to\-market initiatives. * Leverage expertise across the Adobe ecosystem to guide conversations around digital experience, commerce, customer data, personalization, and marketing technology solutions. * Support business growth by differentiating Merkle's Digital Transformation capabilities and helping position the organization competitively in the marketplace. * Influence and align diverse stakeholder groups to achieve shared objectives and deliver measurable client and business results. **Qualifications:** * 12\+ years of experience in consulting, account leadership, partnership management, digital transformation, technology services, or a related field. * Experience working with enterprise clients and executive stakeholders. * Demonstrated success leading complex, cross\-functional initiatives. * Strong communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to influence decisions without direct authority. * Experience translating business objectives into actionable strategies and solutions. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions. * Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, or related technologies. * Background in alliance management, product strategy, solution commercialization, or customer experience transformation. * Experience within consulting, professional services, or technology organizations. * Knowledge of AI\-enabled marketing or customer experience solutions. At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in\-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. jobs.title: Associate Technician – GE 1.5
jobs.description: **Deutsche Windtechnik (DWT)** is Germany’s largest Independent Service Provider, offering a comprehensive service package for Wind Turbine Generators (WTG) from one single source. What makes us stand out from other service companies? We offer everything from A to Z and match that with a passion for all technical services related to wind power. The objective of our engineers and technicians is to individually increase efficiency and to keep availability high at all times. It is our objective to achieve the best possible technical operation for our client’s systems and in turn offer cost\-effective solutions. We do everything possible to keep the wind turbines up and running and improve their performance, for the long term. Deutsche Windtechnik is entering its fifth year of operations in the United States, and is headquartered in Houston, TX. As the largest and most reputable independent service provider in Germany, it is our objective to transfer and improve the same level of quality, safety, efficiency and customer service to the US market. Deutsche Windtechnik aims to become the strongest independent service provider in the US within the next 5 years, and you can be part of this success! **SCHEDULE****:** Typically, from 7am to 4:30pm, Monday through Friday, some weekends and shift work. Usually, 40 hours per week with 30 minutes/1 hour lunch break unless arrangements have been agreed to by the employer and the employee. 20\-25% travel required. **JOB SUMMARY**: This is a skilled position; Employees in this role perform maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems, understands schematics and uses appropriate diagnostic tools. The successful candidate will interpret fault reports, maintain power generation reports, service logs in the computer database, and monitor turbine performance. **ASSOCIATE TECHNICIAN SUMMARY** The technician should be able understand and utilize Deutsche Windtechnik documentation to include basic drawings and schematics, work procedures, equipment, tooling and machinery associated with routine wind turbine operation and maintenance. It expected that the technician will learn basic electrical and mechanical maintenance skills such that they will be able to perform maintenance related tasks independently, as well as provide adequate assistance to more experienced technicians in the performance of routine activities. **DEUTSCHE WINDTECHNIK CULTURE:** At Deutsche Windtechnik, what sets us apart is our intense focus on our customers, employees and culture. Our Mission is ***to be the most trusted O\&M partner******to wind farm owners,*** while Our Vision ***is to*** ***empower the Americas‘ achievement of 100% renewable energy, one wind turbine at a time.*** How do we accomplish this? By building a team and a culture with the core values that are Transparent, Innovative, Guiding (advisor and partner), Efficient (cost conscious) and Rapid (agile and bold). **MENTAL DEMANDS**: * Read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals * Write routine reports and correspondence * Understand and follow customary instructions in order to perform the essential functions of the position in a satisfactory manner * Read and interpret blueprints and schematics * Deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations * Work with minimal supervision, given proper instructions **PHYSICAL DEMAND CLASSIFICATION**: * While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to: stand; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. * The employee must be capable of lifting and/or moving up to 100 pounds. * Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. * Employee must be physically fit enough to free climb 250 ft multiple times a day while wearing 25\+ lbs. of climbing gear under extraordinary weather conditions. * Must be capable of rescuing team mate anywhere in tower in the event of emergency. Must be able to work in extreme weather conditions. **DESCRIPTION OF TASKS**: * The provision of preventative and corrective maintenance on GE 1\.5 wind turbines as per DWT instructions * Completion of all relevant paperwork, including work order cards, checklists, etc. * Ensure all health and safety procedures are followed * Performs scheduled maintenance as required * Performs unscheduled maintenance consisting of troubleshooting on mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems * Assist large corrective teams with replacement of major turbine components e.g. generators and gearboxes * Assist in all areas of site operations * Provide safe access and egress to all people in the work party * Establish and maintain general safety from the system/Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO) * Comply with Deutsc  supervision, if needed) * Performs wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic systems troubleshooting and repairs * Recognizes occurrences of wind turbine error codes and appropriately reports the problem * Assists with removal and installation of wind turbine mechanical, electrical and hydraulic components * Assists with heavy equipment (crane) rigging and directing * Performs wind turbine controller maintenance and repair * Completes required reports and other paperwork, some of which require computer entry * Assists with high\-voltage system maintenance and repair * Maintains adherence to company policies, safety standards and good housekeeping practices * Maintains proper care of company tools and vehicles * Demonstrates the ability to learn advanced troubleshooting and repair of the wind turbines **REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:** * High School Graduate/GED * Associate Degree preferred (not required) * Persons with Wind Energy Certifications, Military Experience, electrical and mechanical experience are highly encouraged to apply. * Experience 0 \+ 2 years in Wind Energy, electrical, mechanical and technical equipment * Valid driving license (NON CDL/CDL) * Must be able to pass a physical exam and drug/alcohol screening * Must be able to climb and work atop freestanding wind turbine towers that exceed 250 ft in height **EQUIPMENT, MACHINES, TOOLS USED:** Electrical Testing Equipment, Torque Wrench, Crane Rigging, Scada Systems, Computer, Computer Software, Scanner, Printer, Telephone, Copier, Fax Machine **DESCRIPTION OF WORK ENVIRONMENT:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts; high, precarious places; particulate matter and outside weather conditions. The employee can be exposed to risks of electrical hazards. The employee is occasionally exposed to hazardous chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud. **ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:** This job description in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee filling this position. Employee will be required to follow any other job\-related instructions and to perform any other job\-related duties requested by management. Management has the right to add to, revise, or delete information in this job description. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. This document does not create an employment contract, implied or otherwise, other than an “at will” employment relationship. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** Deutsche Windtechnik is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship status, ancestry, sex, age, physical or mental disability, marital status, family responsibilities, pregnancy, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, transgender, sex stereotyping, protected veteran or military status, and other categories protected by federal, state or local law. **EEO is the Law** Applicants and employees are protected under Federal law from discrimination. *Whenever employees are working, operating DWT supplied vehicles, on DWT premises, or are conducting DWT related work off\-site, they are prohibited from:* * *Using, possessing, buying, selling, manufacturing or dispensing an illegal drug (to include possession of drug paraphernalia);* * *Having alcohol or an illegal drug in their system; and* * *Possessing or consuming alcohol.* *Through UnitedHealthcare, UMR and HealthSCOPE Benefits creates and publishes the Machine\-Readable Files on behalf of Deutsche Windtechnik.* *To link to the Machine\-Readable Files, please click on the URL provided:* **https://transparency\-in\-coverage.uhc.com/** wQcy1qBMRD

jobs.title: Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** **"We Power the Magic!"** That's our motto at Disney Experiences Technology \& Digital. Our team builds premier immersive digital experiences for the Company's world\-class vacation brands including Disney's Parks \& Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort \& Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. Do you love data? Do you want to help build the next generation of data products at Disney? Join us! We are looking for a hands\-on leader to help drive the development and delivery of modern data products. You will lead a team of engineers responsible for building and improving the pipelines and processes that handle consumer data, ensuring freshness, completeness, security, and privacy, while executing against the roadmap for new features and capabilities that provide useful insights and drive growth for our business. You will sit in Data Products \& Platform within the Technology \& Digital organization for Disney Experiences. You will work closely with internal segment partners and technical peers from across the company, reporting to a Senior Manager or Director within the org. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with stakeholders across the organization to understand business needs and translate them into well\-scoped engineering work * Execute against the strategy and roadmap for data products supporting Guest experiences, and contribute ideas that help shape it * Lead a team of engineers day\-to\-day, balancing delivery against plans with the growth and development of individual team members * Reinforce a strong culture of best practices and standards in data and engineering * Serve as a technical resource on delivery practices, able to speak to capabilities and processes with engineers and partners alike * Support data collection strategies and onboarding processes that enable improved data capabilities while adhering to data privacy requirements * Stay current on product direction for applicable technologies to understand how shifts in the consumer privacy landscape may affect the Guest data strategy **Required Qualifications \& Skills:** * Minimum of 8\+ years related work experience, including 3\+ years’ experience leading or mentoring engineers * Solid working knowledge of Data Architecture, Data Warehousing, Advanced Analytics, and Data Science implementations * Experience with Data Warehouse platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery, with strong working knowledge of the Snowflake Platform * Familiarity with Data Lakehouse architectures and formats/standards, such as Parquet and Iceberg * Experience designing or maintaining automated, highly available ETL/ELT big data pipelines at scale * Experience with data transformation and orchestration tools such as dbt and Airflow * Familiarity with data quality practices and tooling such as Data Dog and Anomalo * Familiarity with data security and privacy regulations * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences * A team player with vision, passion, discipline, and integrity * Demonstrated inclusive and collaborative leadership that embraces diverse thought; experience developing engineers on a team * Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed organization where partnership and influence support success * Ability to work efficiently in a fast\-paced and changing environment **Required Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience **Preferred Education** * Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software, Electrical or Electronics Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience \#TECHATDISNEY The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $163,400\.00 to $219,100\.00 per year, in Seattle, WA is $179,700\.00 to $241,000\.00 per year, and in Glendale and Anaheim, CA is $171,600\.00 to $230,100\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Salesforce Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Salesforce Software Engineer** **Chicago, IL \| Peoria, IL \| Dallas, TX (Hybrid)** *Diversified Services Network, Inc. (DSN) is seeking a full\-time Salesforce Software Engineer to join our team in your choice of our Chicago, IL, Peoria, IL or Dallas, TX offices. We offer a hybrid work model with 1\-2 days per week of onsite work, full benefits, PTO, 401k, and more! If you're looking to grow your career within an extremely reputable, stable Fortune 100 company \- let's talk!* **Position Overview** We are seeking a Salesforce Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain Salesforce solutions that support enterprise digital platforms and customer, dealer, and partner\-facing experiences. This role blends hands\-on development across Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce Flow with integration work, solution architecture, and cross\-functional collaboration in an Agile delivery environment. **Key Contributions \& Responsibilities** **Salesforce Application Development** * Design, develop, implement, test, and maintain Salesforce solutions using Agile/Scrum methodologies. * Develop Salesforce applications using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, JavaScript, SOQL/SOSL, and Salesforce APIs. * Configure and customize Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, and related platform capabilities. * Implement declarative solutions using Flow, validation rules, custom objects, record\-triggered automation, approval processes, and platform configuration. * Develop integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications using REST, SOAP, Platform Events, middleware, and event\-driven architecture patterns. * Participate in solution architecture design, code reviews, technical documentation, release planning, and platform optimization activities. **Technical Problem Solving** * Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable Salesforce designs. * Troubleshoot Apex, LWC, automation, data, integration, deployment, and platform performance issues. * Optimize Salesforce security and access controls using profiles, permission sets, permission set groups, sharing rules, role hierarchy, and field\-level security. * Apply Salesforce development best practices, design patterns, and secure software engineering standards to build reliable enterprise solutions. **Collaboration \& Stakeholder Engagement** * Collaborate with Product Owners, Salesforce Administrators, Salesforce Architects, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, system analysts, and business stakeholders. * Gather, analyze, and refine functional and technical requirements for Salesforce initiatives and integrations. * Communicate platform capabilities, solution designs, project updates, and implementation approaches clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Participate in Agile sprint planning, standups, backlog refinement, release readiness, and production\-support activities. **Testing \& Quality Assurance** * Develop and execute unit, integration, regression, and user\-acceptance testing for Salesforce solutions. * Maintain Apex test coverage and support mock testing for integrations and asynchronous processes. * Use Salesforce DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment quality and release reliability. * Ensure compliance with Salesforce security, platform governance, and coding standards. **Continuous Improvement** * Contribute to Salesforce development standards, reusable components, and coding guidelines. * Identify opportunities to improve business processes through Salesforce capabilities, integrations, automation, and data quality improvements. * Research and implement emerging Salesforce technologies, platform releases, and AI\-assisted development tools. * Support knowledge sharing, technical documentation, and mentoring of junior engineers when applicable. **Team Structure \& Work Environment** * Contribute to a range of technical solutions, including digital platforms, customer\-, dealer\-, and partner\-facing Salesforce experiences, Experience Cloud portals, internal business tools, workflow automation, and API\-led integrations. * Hybrid work model with 1\-2 office days per week; candidates should be prepared to transition to full\-time onsite work in the future. **Requirements** **Candidate Requirements** **Education \& Experience** * No degree required. * 2\-4 years of experience in Salesforce development, required. * Salesforce certification is a plus, but not required. **Required Technical Skills** * Hands\-on experience developing, configuring, testing, and deploying solutions on the Salesforce Platform. * Knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, Salesforce data modeling, and Salesforce security concepts. * Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise applications, APIs, middleware, identity providers, and external systems. * Understanding of Salesforce governance, platform limits, release management, and scalable solution design. * Experience with DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, Agile delivery, and enterprise software development practices. * Salesforce Administrator, Platform Developer I, Platform Developer II, Experience Cloud, or related Salesforce certifications preferred. **Benefits** * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Vision Insurance * Disability insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Paid Holidays Please follow the link to our website for a list of job openings in Engineering, IT, Project Management, and more! https://www.dsnworldwide.com Salary expectations: 100,000\-120,000 per annual

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Founded in 1904, ESAB Corporation is a premier narrowly diversified global leader in connected fabrication technology and gas control solutions. Our rich history of innovative products, workflow solutions, and business system, ESAB Business Excellence, enables our purpose of *Shaping the World We Imagine*™. We’re looking to hire a **talented** Field Service Engineer. ESAB is seeking a high\-caliber, solutions\-driven Field Service Engineer (FSE) to lead technical commissioning, system diagnostics, preventive maintenance, and lifecycle support for our industry\-leading automated cutting systems across the United States. In this role, you will serve as the frontline technical authority for high\-precision CNC cutting tables, multi\-axis gantry systems, advanced plasma power sources, oxy\-fuel stations, and integrated digital cutting automation. Working directly at customer manufacturing facilities, heavy fabrication plants, shipyards, and structural steel operations, you will solve complex electromechanical, drive, and software challenges, optimize cutting cycle performance, and partner with plant engineering teams to maximize equipment uptime. If you thrive on troubleshooting complex industrial systems, working autonomously in the field, and delivering engineering excellence, this role offers direct technical impact and clear pathways for career progression within ESAB. **Key Technical Responsibilities** ---------------------------------- * **Advanced Diagnostics \& Root\-Cause Troubleshooting:** Perform comprehensive electromechanical, electronic, and pneumatic diagnostics on automated CNC cutting machines, AC/DC servo drive systems, height sensors, and high\-frequency plasma units using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, schematic drawings, and diagnostic software. * **Installation \& Turnkey Commissioning:** Lead on\-site system integration, machine alignment, leveling, I/O verification, CNC parameter configuration, process gas calibration, and test cutting to ensure systems meet factory specifications and customer acceptance criteria. * **Preventative \& Corrective Maintenance:** Execute planned multi\-point maintenance audits, component rebuilds, motion calibration, torch consumable optimization, and emergency repair interventions to ensure 99%\+ operational reliability. * **Control Systems \& Automation Support:** Diagnose and interface with CNC controllers (e.g., Vision, Columbus CAD/CAM interfaces), PLC logic, industrial fieldbuses (Ethernet/IP, Modbus, PROFINET), and safety interlocks (NFPA 79 / ISO 13849 standards). * **Client Enablement \& Operational Training:** Deliver technical training for customer maintenance technicians, CNC programmers, and operators on machine safety, daily operation, torch setup, and first\-line preventive care. * **Engineering Feedback \& Field Reporting:** Author detailed Field Service Reports (FSRs) documenting failure modes, root causes, corrective actions, and recommended preventative spares. Collaborate with Aftermarket and R\&D engineering teams to drive design reliability improvements. * **Spare Parts \& Aftermarket Advisory:** Assess system wear profiles, formulate bill\-of\-materials (BOM) recommendations for critical spare parts packages, and support customer retrofit/upgrade roadmaps. **Qualifications \& Requirements** ---------------------------------- **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * **Education \& Technical Training:** Associate Degree in Electronic Engineering Technology (EET), Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent technical trade school certificate / U.S. Military technical rating (e.g., Navy ET/EM/Nuke, Avionics, Army/Air Force electromechanical systems). * **Field Experience:** 2–5\+ years of hands\-on experience in industrial field service, machine tool repair, robotics, or automated manufacturing systems. * **Electromechanical Acumen:** Proven ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, ladder logic, hydraulic/pneumatic schematics, and mechanical assembly blueprints. * **Safety \& Standards:** Demonstrated commitment to industrial safety standards (OSHA compliance, Lockout/Tagout \[LOTO], NFPA 70E / Arc Flash awareness). * **Physical Requirements:** Ability to lift up to 50 lbs. unassisted, work in industrial plant environments, climb ladders, maneuver around large gantry machinery, and stand/walk for extended periods during commissioning. * **Mobility \& Driving:** Valid U.S. Driver’s License with a clean driving record and eligibility to obtain a U.S. Passport for occasional cross\-border training or technical support. **Preferred Qualifications \& Skills** -------------------------------------- * **Industry Exposure:** Direct experience with thermal cutting technologies (high\-definition plasma, oxy\-fuel, fiber laser, or waterjet) and CNC motion platforms. * **Software / CAD/CAM:** Familiarity with CNC nesting software, CAD/CAM file formats (DXF, DWG, ESSI, G\-code), and remote diagnostic tools. * **Bilingual Capability:** Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is an asset to support collaborative North American engineering initiatives. **Work Environment, Travel \& Total Rewards** --------------------------------------------- * **Work Environment:** High\-paced industrial manufacturing, steel fabrication, shipbuilding, and energy sector job sites. Full PPE and strict adherence to plant safety protocols required. * **Travel Scope:** 100% regional/domestic travel to customer facilities, travel expense coverage. **Pay Range:** $69,441\.00\-$80,472\.00

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Contractor)
jobs.description: Eikon Therapeutics is a new biopharmaceutical company employing revolutionary technology at the intersection of chemistry, engineering, computation, and biology to discover novel treatments for life\-threatening diseases. In this role, you will gain exposure to applied machine learning workflows, including model development, evaluation, interpretability research, and data pipeline optimization. This role will be responsible for building out standardized, general\-purpose interpretability tooling that contributes to research\-driven software solutions supporting scientific discovery. This is a contract role, expected to last approximately 3 months, with an anticipated workload of 20 hours per week. **About You** You are passionate about machine learning, computer vision, and solving complex data\-driven challenges. You enjoy designing experiments, analyzing results, and building models that generate meaningful insights. You are analytical, curious, and comfortable working with image data, machine learning frameworks, and real\-world datasets. You enjoy collaborating with engineers and scientists and are motivated to translate research ideas into practical tools and prototype solutions. **What You'll Do** * Lead or substantially contribute to a research\-focused project related to model interpretability and machine learning. * Develop and evaluate machine learning approaches to improve model performance, robustness, and usability of internal tools. * Support development and testing of model interpretability techniques to better understand and evaluate machine learning systems. * Design and execute targeted experiments to evaluate model performance, training strategies, and data pipeline improvements. * Prepare, clean, and analyze image\-based and structured datasets to support machine learning model development. * Evaluate model outputs using quantitative performance metrics and visualization techniques. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate research concepts into prototype solutions and internal tools. * Document technical approaches, experimental results, and research findings. * Present project outcomes and key learnings. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's or graduate\-level degree (completed or in progress) in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline. * Coursework or hands\-on experience in machine learning, statistics, and computer vision. * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience with data analysis, experimental design, and machine learning model evaluation. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret and communicate technical findings. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment while managing independent research or development tasks. * Must be available to work part\-time (20 hours per week) during core business hours for the duration of the 3\-month contract term. * Exposure to model interpretability, explainability, or visualization techniques is preferred. The expected hourly rate for this role is $56 to $68 depending on skills, competency, and the market demand for your expertise. jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: Department: IT \| Level: Lead Role Summary: The Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the enterprise data platform that powers analytics, reporting, and business applications across El Car Wash. This role develops scalable data pipelines, integrates data from multiple business systems, and transforms raw data into trusted, business\-ready datasets that support Finance, Operations, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Technology. As a key member of the Technology team, the Data Engineer will build and optimize our Snowflake data platform using a modern medallion architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), ensuring data is reliable, secure, well\-governed, and accessible. This role will partner closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to support business intelligence, automation, and future AI initiatives while helping standardize data across acquisitions and multiple source systems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: * Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines within the Snowflake data platform using a Bronze, Silver, and Gold (medallion) architecture. * Develop and optimize data models using dbt Cloud to create reliable, business\-ready datasets. * Integrate and manage data from multiple enterprise systems including POS, HRIS, ERP, CRM, Finance, Marketing, and operational platforms. * Lead the migration of legacy SQL Server and Azure SQL data environments into a modern cloud\-based architecture. * Develop and maintain a unified enterprise data model that standardizes information across multiple source systems and acquisitions. * Build automated ingestion, transformation, and change\-detection processes to support new business applications and acquisitions. * Implement data quality standards, testing, documentation, monitoring, and governance best practices. * Establish CI/CD processes and version control to support reliable, scalable data development. * Partner with Finance, Operations, Marketing, and Technology teams to understand business requirements and deliver trusted reporting and analytics solutions. * Support business intelligence, dashboards, self\-service reporting, and future AI and automation initiatives. * Troubleshoot data issues, optimize platform performance, and continuously improve the reliability and scalability of the data ecosystem. QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in data engineering, data warehousing, or analytics engineering. * Strong experience with Snowflake, including warehouse management, security, and performance optimization. * Experience with dbt and dbt Cloud for data modeling, testing, documentation, and deployment. * Advanced SQL skills with experience optimizing and modernizing legacy SQL environments. * Experience designing dimensional data models, including Kimball methodologies and Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 2\). * Experience building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and modern orchestration tools. * Familiarity with Azure cloud services including Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Key Vault, and related services. * Experience with Git\-based version control and CI/CD processes. * Experience integrating multiple enterprise applications and APIs. * Knowledge of business intelligence platforms such as Power BI or similar visualization tools. * Experience supporting retail, hospitality, automotive, or multi\-location businesses is preferred. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment and effectively manage multiple priorities.

jobs.description: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. **Introduction to the Team:** Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools to deliver high quality experiences for travelers, partners, and our employees. A singular technology platform powered by data and machine learning provides secure, differentiated, and personalized experiences that drive loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Loyalty Engineering organization powers continuous engagement, re engagement, and re acquisition for travelers worldwide. We build the systems that create a durable growth flywheel for Expedia, deepening traveler relationships while driving measurable business impact across brands and markets. As a Principal Engineer, you will set the technical vision and architecture for the AI empowered Loyalty charter, designing and delivering intelligent engagement experiences powered by modern AI and agentic systems. You will shape system design across multiple distributed engineering teams and drive alignment with Product, Data Science, and platform leaders to build solutions that are scalable, reliable, and genuinely novel. Your influence will extend beyond any single team, shaping how Loyalty engineering approaches hard problems for years to come. This role calls for deep, hands on technical leadership, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to build alignment across teams without relying on formal authority. You are expected to be a multiplier: the person other engineers look to when a problem is ambiguous, high stakes, or genuinely hard. **In this role, you will:** * Set the architectural vision, design, and delivery approach for complex software solutions across multiple technical domains, enabling AI and machine learning powered loyalty offers and experiences. * Drive system design, API development, and data modeling so our platforms remain secure, maintainable, and able to perform at scale. * Take on the most technically demanding problems across the loyalty experience ecosystem, stepping in where existing solutions fall short and closing critical gaps. * Mentor and raise the bar for engineering teams, fostering technical excellence and encouraging genuine innovation across projects and domains. * Elevate and simplify, always keeping the underlying business problem and customer metrics in view rather than treating architecture as an end in itself. * Strengthen operational excellence ecosystem, including its capabilities, dependencies, and architectural boundaries. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. * 12\+ years of relevant professional experience. * Demonstrated expertise in large scale system architecture, technical decision making, and delivery of complex solutions platforms at scale. * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architectural concepts clearly to engineers, product partners, and senior leaders alike. * Ability to build alignment across teams without relying on formal authority. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience leading architectural transformation and modernization initiatives for large, distributed systems. * Expertise in full stack engineering with a frontend leaning, and a proven ability to operate across multiple technical domains and platforms. * A track record of championing decisions grounded in data and operational excellence for mission critical systems. * Sound judgment in weighing tradeoffs between innovation, speed, scalability, and reliability. * A collaborative, positive presence who is known for attracting strong engineers and helping them grow. You will shape the foundational platform that powers customer\-facing services across brands, increasing developer velocity, reducing operational risk, and optimizing cloud spend. This role is ideal for a leader who can design complex systems, implement solutions in production, and lead broad cross\-team adoption. **What you will do:** * Define the technical strategy, roadmap and standards for cloud infrastructure and platform capabilities (container runtime, orchestration, networking, CI/CD, observability, security, IaC) * Lead migration and platform adoption efforts (containerization, Kubernetes/EKS, runtime platform) and drive roadmap execution end\-to\-end * Be an active code and IaC contributor (Terraform/CloudFormation/Helm, platform services, automation) and perform design/code reviews * Design scalable, resilient, and secure infrastructure patterns for microservices, data stores, caching, and messaging * Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, release automation, testing strategies, and safe deployment practices * Drive SRE and observability practices: define SLIs/SLOs, monitoring, tracing, alerting, runbooks, incident response, and post\-mortems * Lead capacity planning, performance tuning, and traffic engineering for high\-scale workloads * Own and evangelize AWS cost optimization practices (rightsizing, reserved/spot strategies, architecture changes, cost monitoring and show back) * Define and enforce platform standards, security controls, environment tagging, and operational excellence practices across teams * Mentor and grow senior and mid\-level engineers; identify high\-potential talent and raise engineering standards * Collaborate closely with product, security, platform, and operations stakeholders to align technical solutions with business goals and compliance requirements **Minimum qualifications:** * 10\+ years professional software engineering experience with significant hands\-on experience building and operating distributed cloud services * Strong, demonstrable experience building and running platforms on AWS (EKS, ECS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling) * Deep hands\-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes at scale (EKS or comparable) * Practical experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and Helm charts * Proven record of contributing production code and platform automation (languages such as Go, Python, Java, or similar) * Experience designing for resilience, observability, security and operational automation * Familiarity with CI/CD tooling and developer workflows (Spinnaker, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar) * Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-team technical initiatives and influence architectural decisions * Strong communication skills and experience mentoring engineers **Preferred qualifications** : * Prior platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure leadership at scale * Experience with monitoring/observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger) * Proven experience with AWS cost optimization strategies and tooling (Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, billing APIs) * Knowledge of service meshes (Istio, Linkerd, VPC Lattice), API gateways, and advanced networking patterns * Experience with security/compliance for cloud environments, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code * Experience migrating monoliths to cloud\-native architectures The total cash range for this position in Seattle is $231,000\.00 to $323,500\.00\. Employees in this role have the potential to increase their pay up to $369,500\.00, which is the top of the range, based on ongoing, demonstrated, and sustained performance in the role.\&\#xa;The total cash range for this position in San Jose is $249,000\.00 to $348,500\.00\. jobs.title: Sr Director, Commercial Product Management
jobs.description: **Position Type :** Full time**Type Of Hire :** Experienced (relevant combo of work and education)**Job Description** **ROLE SUMMARY** Sits within a newly acquired startup building an AI\-enabled, autonomous banking platform for Tier\-1 financial institutions within the banking group. The **Sr Director, Commercial Product Management** role is the single\-threaded product owner for Enterprise Customer — one trusted record of every person, organization, relationship, identifier, and consent the bank needs to serve customers, deployable standalone against any third\-party core. Requires deep customer\-master, identity, and consent expertise, an engineering foundation, and end\-to\-end ownership of what we build and why. The component is a natural first move in bank modernization and is deployable standalone. This is not a program\- or delivery\-management role: client\-program orchestration sits with the Forward Deployed team, and engineering owns architecture and implementation. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** Customer Strategy \& Roadmap * Own the direction: Define which party, relationship, agreement, and contact\-point capabilities to prioritize, which jurisdictions and identifier types are configured first, and how the standalone\-against\-any\-core motion is packaged. – * Own non\-discretionary change: KYC, beneficial\-ownership, tax\-certification (W\-9, W\-8 series, CRS), and privacy (GDPR erasure and equivalents) requirements. * Keep the roadmap on track and define success: Duplicate\-party rate, KYC done once versus per\-system, onboarding lead time, UBO query latency, migration parity, standalone deployments live. Customer Domain \& Client Leadership * Be the SME: Serve as the internal product authority on how banks master parties, resolve identity, model relationships and beneficial ownership, record consent and agreements, and maintain contact points across product silos. * Problem\-solve with clients: Join client working sessions to define what to build — whiteboard the actual onboarding, KYC, and customer\-maintenance flows, expose missing controls and duplicate\-record risk, and identify the minimum viable reusable capability. * Guard the platform: Convert recurring client and field signal into configurable types, relationship rules, and jurisdiction packs — not bank\-specific schema changes; countersign any client commitment that binds the roadmap before it is promised. * Challenge constructively: Push back on clients and internal experts with evidence; document decisions so they stay made. Technical Product Definition * Write the contract: Define party, relationship, agreement, and contact\-point APIs, domain events, the classified type system, identifier and tax certification models, and acceptance criteria. * Sweat the semantics: Identity resolution and de\-duplication, server\-enforced beneficial\-ownership constraints, agreement versioning and supersession, privacy\-law\-compliant erasure, external\-ID correlation and idempotent batch load for coexistence, and per\-tenant isolation with encrypted PII handling. * Own the boundaries: Product contracts with Ledger, Reg \& Compliance, Orchestration, Servicing, Data, Command Center, and the third\-party cores and CRMs the component sits in front of. * Respect the split: This role owns what, why, priority, and acceptance criteria; engineering owns architecture, implementation, and estimates. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& CAPABILITIES** Customer\-Master, Identity \& Consent Expertise * Deep, hands\-on expertise owning a customer master, party/identity service, CIF modernization, KYC/onboarding platform, or MDM program — with personal ownership of the data model and integration pattern. * Working command of party and relationship modeling, beneficial ownership and corporate hierarchies, identity resolution, consent and agreement versioning, tax certification (W\-9, W\-8, CRS), ISO 20022\-aligned identifiers, and privacy\-law erasure. * Practical exposure to coexistence beside a legacy core (external\-ID mapping, events replacing nightly extracts, parallel running) and multi\-jurisdiction configuration. Strongly preferred: deploying a customer master standalone in front of a third\-party core. Technical Foundation * 4\+ years owning a technical product or platform end to end, including at least one taken personally through launch, adoption, and iteration. * Engineering background or equivalent hands\-on record: typically 3\+ years building, shipping, and operating production software — not coordinating its delivery. * Fluent in APIs, event\-driven and distributed systems, data and state modeling, reliability, security, and observability; reads architecture diagrams without a translator. Operating Style * Strong ownership mindset — owns outcomes, not tasks; a product owner who ships, not a requirements librarian. High agency; writes the playbook when none exists. * Technically credible and commercially grounded — earns trust with senior engineers, bank onboarding, KYC, and customer\-operations leaders, data and privacy officers, and financial\-crime teams, and executives. Clear writer: turns complex rules into decisions that are hard to misinterpret. * AI\-native — uses analytics, telemetry, and AI\-assisted workflows as the default operating mode for discovery, prototyping, documentation, and decisions, not a side experiment. IMPACT \& SCOPE * Direct impact on the bank's golden customer record — eliminating duplicate KYC and screening across every downstream system * High autonomy and accountability within a small, senior team, paired with a senior engineering lead * Work shipped directly to production at enterprise scale, holding the bank's most sensitive data under per\-tenant isolation **WHY THIS ROLE** * This role offers the autonomy, ownership, and technical depth of a startup, combined with the scale, stability, and long\-term impact of FIS. You will define how some of the world's largest banks know who their customers are — once, everywhere — and make it the first module they modernize. jobs.title: Sales Support Associate
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. If you're passionate about building world class products and share our love for sports fans and collectors, Fanatics Collect offers an exciting opportunity to be part of a dynamic team creating the future of collecting. **About the Role** The Sales Support Associate plays a critical role on the Fanatics Collect Sales team, supporting sales representatives and serving as a primary point of contact for client communications across auctions, fixed price marketplace, private sales, and vault storage services. Reporting to the Director of Sales, this role is ideal for someone highly organized, responsive, and customer\-focused, with a passion for collectibles and a strong commitment to operational excellence. You'll collaborate cross\-functionally with Customer Service, Operations, and Sales Support to ensure a seamless client experience and help drive sales team efficiency. **Responsibilities:** * Support daily communications (phone, email, text, social media) with clients across Fanatics Collect sales channels * Assist Sales Reps in managing and growing relationships with collectors, both buyers and sellers * Respond promptly to client inquiries and internal requests related to submissions, curation, invoicing, and asset transactions * Coordinate with internal teams to resolve client issues and fulfill sales support requests * Maintain accurate records of asset submissions and track post\-sale data * Perform ongoing customer account maintenance and data entry * Provide high\-touch customer service with urgency and professionalism * Support team operations through administrative tasks and special projects as needed Uphold the highest standards of communication, organization, and responsiveness **Qualifications:** * 1–3 years of experience in a client\-facing support, operations, or sales assistant role * Background in sales or customer service preferred * Knowledge of trading cards, collectibles, or sports memorabilia is highly desirable * Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail * Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal * Proficiency in navigating fast\-paced, dynamic work environments * Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively * Demonstrated professionalism and a customer\-first mindset *Ensure your Fanatics job offer is legitimate and don't fall victim to fraud. jobs.title: IT SUPPORT SPECIALIST
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Farmington Country Club is seeking an IT Support Specialist to own front\-line help desk support alongside application\-level account administration and day\-to\-day technology operations across the Club. This is a hands\-on, hourly role combining day\-to\-day help desk troubleshooting with growing ownership of onboarding/offboarding coordination, device imaging and deployment, and support for Club systems such as point\-of\-sale and reservations, while serving as the first point of contact for staff technology issues and providing occasional one\-off support for member\-facing technology as it arises. This position works closely with the Senior Systems Engineer and Director of IT, with a clear path toward increasing autonomy in application\-level account administration, onboarding/offboarding coordination, and hands\-on network and systems troubleshooting. The role centers on end\-user support and application\-level systems, working alongside and learning from senior technical staff on infrastructure\-level work. Domain\-wide identity credentials (Active Directory and Entra ID accounts, MFA, and conditional access) are owned by the Senior Systems Engineer; this role owns application\-level credential support for the Club's business systems, such as Northstar Nexus. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** End\-User Support * Serve as the primary point of contact for staff technology issues across departments: dining, lodging, golf, racquets, aquatics, fitness, and events, with occasional one\-off support for member\-facing technology issues as they arise. * Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, printing, mobile device, and connectivity issues for end users. * Manage and prioritize the IT help desk ticket queue, ensuring timely response and resolution consistent with Club service expectations. * Provide staff\-side support for point\-of\-sale and other operational terminals used to serve members; assist with occasional one\-off member\-facing technology issues (e.g., member mobile app, IPTV) as they arise. Identity \& Access Administration * Coordinate the new\-hire onboarding and termination offboarding workflow: confirm domain account setup (initiated by the hiring manager's request form) completes correctly, flag any setup issues or adjustment needs to the Senior Systems Engineer, and confirm all downstream systems (phone, key fob, applications) are provisioned or deactivated on schedule. Domain\-wide Active Directory and Entra ID account creation, deactivation, and credential resets are owned by the Senior Systems Engineer. * Configure desk phones and provision voice mailboxes for new staff in the Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and Unity Connection environment as part of onboarding; deactivate extensions and mailboxes during offboarding. * Issue and program key fobs for new staff in the Club’s access control system, applying appropriate door/area permissions by role; deactivate and recover fobs during offboarding. * Create and manage user accounts, password resets, and role\-level permission assignments for Northstar Nexus and other Club business applications. * Maintain accurate records of issued devices, software licenses, and application\-level account assignments. * Process ad\-hoc application\-level access requests (Northstar Nexus and other Club software password resets or permission changes) and physical access requests (lost fobs, temporary access) in coordination with HR and department heads; escalate domain\-wide account or group permission changes to the Senior Systems Engineer. Device \& Systems Support * Image, configure, and deploy staff workstations, laptops, and mobile devices. * Perform routine maintenance on end\-user hardware, conference room AV systems, and common\-area technology. * Provide troubleshooting support for network connectivity issues (switch ports, wireless access points) and escalate complex infrastructure issues to the Senior Systems Engineer. * Support basic POS, reservation system, and access control device\-level troubleshooting in partnership with platform vendors. Documentation \& Process * Maintain up\-to\-date documentation for onboarding/offboarding procedures, common troubleshooting steps, and device inventory. * Contribute to the development of IT SOPs and end\-user training materials. * Participate in technology rollouts, seasonal event support, and Club\-wide system upgrades. **Required Qualifications** * 2\+ years of help desk or end\-user IT support experience, with the ability to work independently and pick up Club\-specific systems quickly; internal candidates with demonstrated aptitude will also be considered. * Working knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365 applications, and basic networking concepts. * Experience with or strong aptitude for application\-level account administration (e.g., Northstar Nexus, POS, or similar platforms); general familiarity with Active Directory/Entra ID concepts is helpful for coordinating onboarding, though domain\-wide account administration is owned by the Senior Systems Engineer. * Excellent customer service skills and the ability to communicate clearly with non\-technical staff, and occasionally members, in a hospitality setting. * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage a ticket queue with competing priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate's degree or technical certification in IT, computer science, or related field (or equivalent experience). * Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate (AZ\-802\), or equivalent Microsoft certification in hybrid identity or Windows Server administration, is a plus. * CompTIA A\+ certification is a plus. * Exposure to mobile device management, basic switch/wireless troubleshooting, or Cisco Unified Communications Manager/Unity Connection user provisioning. * Experience supporting hospitality, dining, or guest\-facing technology platforms. **Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** * Fully on\-site at the Club's Charlottesville, VA campus, with regular movement across golf, racquets, aquatics, dining, lodging, and event facilities; all work is performed in person on Club premises. * On\-site support is required for occasional holiday events. * Ability to lift and move IT equipment (up to 40 lbs). **What Farmington Country Club Offers** * Competitive salary with opportunity for growth and increased responsibility. * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits. * 401(k) with Club match. * Paid time off, holidays, and Club\-provided meals during shifts. * Hands\-on mentorship from senior IT staff and exposure to enterprise\-grade infrastructure and security tools
