detections** * **Experience with ML or data science concepts applied to security use cases (anomaly detection, behavioral analytics, risk scoring)** * **Excellent analytical, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills** * **Ability to perform independent root cause analysis and convey complex security risks to both technical and executive audiences** * **Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and contribute to a culture of continuous improvem jection techniques, LOLBAS, and fileless attack detection** * **Experience with endpoint forensics, malware triage, or adversary emulation exercises targeting endpoint environments** * **2 or more professional certifications (GCIA, GCIH, CISSP, GMON, GREM, GCTD, MLE, or AWS Cloud Practitioner, AWS Security)** ***At this time, jobs.description: **Accelerate your career. With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business\-to\-business technology experts. Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart. Learn more at www.ingrammicro.com Come join our team where you’ll make technology happen in surprising ways. Let’s shape tomorrow \- it’ll be a fun journey! ***This position is based at our Irvine, California headquarters and follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in the office and two days remote.*** As a Sr. Software Engineer, you will lead the design, stabilization, and delivery of scalable, secure, and high\-performance enterprise solutions across the full stack using C\#, .NET, SQL Server, Angular, and Azure Cloud. You will provide technical leadership in architecture, development, and deployment while mentoring engineering teams and collaborating closely with Product, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders. Experience or knowledge of IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) and reverse logistics processes is highly desirable. **Your role:** **Technical Leadership \& Architecture** * Own end\-to\-end solution design and lifecycle, including architecture, development, deployment, and production support. * Lead efforts to stabilize and optimize L1 (first level) and L3 (third level) production support systems, reducing downtime and improving incident resolution times. * Define enterprise\-wide architectural standards and best practices for full\-stack development on Microsoft technologies and Azure Cloud. * Provide technical oversight, lead code reviews, and ensure software quality, security, and performance across the stack. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues spanning frontend, APIs, backend, and cloud infrastructure; lead incident and problem management. * Guide disaster recovery planning and monitor production environments for reliability and scalability. **Full\-Stack Solution Development** * Architect and build microservices and APIs using C\# and .NET, optimized for Azure Cloud deployment. * Develop rich, responsive frontend applications using Angular, ensuring excellent user experience and performance. * Design and implement **self\-serve applications** enabling users to onboard, configure, and manage services independently. * Build and maintain **API gateways** to secure, route, and monitor service APIs effectively. * Lead **tenant onboarding** processes and systems to support multi\-tenant architecture and seamless customer adoption. * Leverage Azure Cloud services including App Services, Functions, SQL Database, and DevOps pipelines for scalable, fault\-tolerant applications. * Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and monitoring to support rapid, reliable delivery. * Champion Agile methodologies and foster collaborative, cross\-functional team environments. * Apply domain knowledge of ITAD and reverse logistics workflows to design solutions that optimize asset lifecycle management. **What you bring to the role:** * Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field with 5\-8 years in enterprise software engineering. * Strong full\-stack development expertise using C\#, .NET, SQL Server, Angular, and Azure Cloud services. * Proven experience designing and scaling enterprise systems with high traffic and transaction volumes. * Demonstrated success in stabilizing and enhancing L1 and L3 production support systems, improving system reliability and support responsiveness. * Experience building self\-serve applications, API gateways, and tenant onboarding for multi\-tenant platforms. * Familiarity with IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), reverse logistics, and related business processes. * Experience with cloud\-native architectures, containerization, and orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Docker) a plus. * Skilled in CI/CD tools, automated testing, and Agile delivery practices. * Experience leading technical teams in onsite\-offshore models and mentoring senior engineers. * Excellent communication skills and ability to influence cross\-functional stakeholders. **Why join us:** Join Ingram Micro as a Principal Engineer and shape the future of global technology platforms by leading full\-stack development initiatives using Microsoft technologies and Azure Cloud. Your expertise in production system stabilization, self\-serve platforms, and ITAD will help us deliver reliable, innovative solutions that empower our partners worldwide. \#LI\-RT1 \#LI\-Hybrid The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is USD $112,200\.00 \- $190,700\.00 per year. jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Substrate Packaging Technology Development (SPTD) is looking for a Packaging Research and Development Engineer to join the Module Engineering Backend Area specifically to be in charge of process and material development to scale advanced substrate packaging technology to enable further die disaggregation / heterogenous integration. This position requires most of time spent on the factory floor and/or interacting with equipment/material suppliers. The candidate will join and become part of a world class first of a kind embedded die packaging facility, learn advanced substrate manufacturing know\-how, drive disruptive technology innovations, and be part of creating history in the substrate packaging industry. Responsibilities will include but not be limited to: \- Define and establish equipment configurations, process specifications, and integrated process flow for new process technologies * Plan and conduct comprehensive DOEs to fundamentally characterize process window, and understand process / equipment / materials interactions * Drive continuous process improvements on process capability/stability, quality/reliability, cost/yield, automation, and productivity * Lead and participate in cross\-functional and cross\-organizational teams or work groups that support substrate technology development. The ideal candidate should exhibit the following behavioral traits and/or skills: \- Written and verbal communication and teamwork skills. * Interact with equipment and materials suppliers. * Willingness to travel (some travel may be required, less than 5 percent) * Work with ambiguity and flexibility with respect to job roles and working hours is required. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates. Knowledge and/or experience listed below would be obtained through a combination of your schoolwork and/or classes and/or research and/or relevant previous job and/or internship experiences. **Minimum qualifications:** The candidate must possess one of the following: * **Master's degree** in a relevant science or engineering discipline, preferably **Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or Chemistry** , with **3\+ years of related experience** ; **or** * **PhD degree** in a relevant science or engineering discipline, preferably **Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or Chemistry** , with **1\+ year of related experience** . Experience listed below should be in any of the following: * **Mechanical \& Materials Engineering:** Solid background in mechanical and materials engineering, with experience applying materials characterization, mechanical design principles, reliability assessments, and failure analysis to support advanced packaging and manufacturing technology development. * **Advanced Packaging \& Manufacturing Development:** Experience developing semiconductor packaging, substrate, embedded die, or heterogeneous integration technologies, including hands\-on work with process equipment, factory operations, and equipment suppliers. * **Process Characterization \& Optimization:** Expertise in DOE, statistical analysis, process development, root cause investigation, and driving improvements in yield, reliability, quality, and process capability. **Preferred qualifications:** 1\+ years of experience in the following: \- Research \& Innovation Experience: Experience conducting research in semiconductor packaging, materials, manufacturing processes, or related fields * Engineering troubleshooting and analytical skills on integrated technology issues and experience working with broad team of other process and integration engineers. * Experience owning process tools with knowledge of SPC PCS RFCs equipment troubleshooting statistical design of experiments and process development. * Experience working with a variety of organic/inorganic materials and processes as well as characterizations utilizing techniques such as DSC, TGA, D/TMA, Titration, ICPMS, FTIR, XPS, TOFSIMS, EDX, SEM, etc. is highly desirable. * Experience with statistical data analysis, JMP and JSL, Python, relational database structure and usage, machine learning. It consists of competitive pay, stock bonuses, and benefit programs which include health, retirement, and vacation. Find out more about the benefits of working at Intel . Annual Salary Range for jobs which could be performed in the US: $133,800\.00\-188,890\.00 USD The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Work Model for this Role** This role will require an on\-site presence. \* Job posting details (such as work model, location or time type) are subject to change. * ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: Intel is committed to Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) compliance and ethical hiring practices. We do not charge any fees during our hiring process. Candidates should never be required to pay recruitment fees, medical examination fees, or any other charges as a condition of employment. If you are asked to pay any fees during our hiring process, please report this immediately to your recruiter.

jobs.description: City: Washington DC Company: IDB Posting End Date: 18 September, 2026 **We improve lives** -------------------- The IDB Group is a community of diverse, versatile, and passionate people who come together on a journey to improve lives in Latin America and the Caribbean. Our people find purpose and do what they love in an inclusive, collaborative, agile, and rewarding environment. **About this position** ----------------------- As a Senior Software Developer Consultant in the Technology and Transformation Department (TTD), you will play a key role in shaping, developing, and modernizing digital solutions that support Portfolio Management across the organization. You’ll provide technical leadership and work closely with cross\-functional teams—including product, business, UX, and development—to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and user\-centered solutions that strengthen portfolio management, monitoring, and decision\-making. You’ll bring strong technical expertise and a strategic mindset to guide architectural decisions, connect systems and data, and support the modernization and integration of Portfolio Management solutions. Your ability to translate complex business needs into robust technical solutions, establish development best practices, and guide teams through technical complexity will be essential to improving interoperability and performance, ensuring solution quality and scalability, and continuously evolving the product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * **Technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams:** Guide the product team—composed of developers, AI engineers, data scientists, and product design specialists (research, UX, UI)—by providing strategic vision, technical direction, and making key decisions to ensure product feasibility and success. * **Technical alignment with architecture and enabler teams:** Work closely with Architecture, Security, Data, and Integration teams to ensure all technical and product decisions are validated and aligned with institutional guidelines. * **Hands\-On Software engineering excellence and code quality:** Oversee the technical development process to ensure that solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure. Lead by example through hands\-on coding and code reviews, promote best practices in development, enforce technical standards, and support the implementation of automated testing and high code quality. * **Management of the product’s technical roadmap:** Define and maintain the technical planning in coordination with Product Leads, ensuring alignment with goals and deliverables. * **Technology stack evaluation and infrastructure alignment:** Analyze the compatibility of new functionalities with the existing technology infrastructure and identify necessary improvements to the stack. * **Scalability and performance:** Ensure the system can scale to meet increasing user and data volumes, monitoring key performance indicators to maintain optimal speed and responsiveness. * **Integration capabilities** : Verify that the product integrates smoothly with other systems and applications, using an API\-first approach to enable seamless data exchange and functional integration. * **Risk identification and mitigation:** Identify and resolve technical challenges, develop mitigation strategies, and ensure development remains on track with the necessary resources to address technological risks. * **Working with a product mindset** : Work with a product mindset in agile environments, leading technical planning, organizing team tasks, and ensuring smooth communication with development teams, internal clients, and other key areas—with a focus on continuous value delivery. **What you'll need** -------------------- * **Education:** Master’s degree or equivalent combination of education and experience in Computer Sciences, Information Technology, or related field. * **Experience:** Atleast 5 years of demonstrated expertise in software development, building and consuming APIs and web services (SOA, REST, XML, JSON, OData), with strong knowledge of authorization/authentication standards (SAML, OAuth, WebAuth, ADFS). Skilled in API tracing using SoapUI, ReadyAPI, and Fiddler, and documenting with Swagger/OpenAPI. Experienced developing applications on Microsoft Azure and AWS, with hands‑on use of cloud‑native integration services including Service Bus, Event Hub/Grid, Logic Apps, App Services (Web Apps \& Functions), API Management Service, and SignalR. * **Additional Knowledge:** 1\) Proficiency in AI and generative AI technologies and their applications; and 2\) Understanding of ethical considerations and the responsible use of AI. * **Languages:** You are proficient in English and in another Bank official language (Spanish, Portuguese, and/or French) **Required Expertise** * **Software development:** Proven hands\-on experience with C\# and the .NET stack, with strong programming skills and demonstrated proficiency in software design, design patterns, clean arc d understanding and practical experience with service\-oriented architecture (SOA) and microservices, including implementation using serverless and containerized infrastructure. * **Web technologies:** Experience with modern web development concepts and frameworks, including single\-page applications (SPAs), SPFx, Angular, and Dojo. Hands\-on front\-end development experience and proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript are highly desirable. * **DevOps and infrastructure:** Ability to implement CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. * **Data management:** Proficiency with relational and non\-relational databases. * **Quality assurance:** Knowledge of automated testing—including unit, integration, end\-to\-end, and contract testing—and frameworks such as xUnit and Playwright. A quality\-driven mindset is essential. * **Artificial intelligence:** Knowledge of LLM integration, prompt engineering, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. Familiarity with Python, machine learning, and deep learning is highly desirable. * **Development tools:** Proficiency with code\-versioning and issue\-tracking tools; familiarity with the Atlassian ecosystem is preferred. * **Leadership and collaboration:** Ability to lead agile, cross\-functional teams, strengthen team members’ capabilities, and promote effective collaboration in support of business and technology needs. * **Communication:** Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, including technical writing, documentation, and diagramming. **Requirements** ---------------- * Citizenship: You are a citizen of one of our 48\-member countries . We may offer assistance with relocation and visa applications for you and your eligible dependents). * Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to the fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab. **Type of contract and duration** --------------------------------- International consultant Full\-Time, 12 months (up to 48 months, subject to eligibility). **What we offer** ----------------- The IDB Group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee’s life. These benefits include: * A **competitive compensation** package. * **Leaves and vacations** : 2 days per month of contract \+ gender\-neutral parental leave. * **Health Insurance** : The IDB Group provides a monthly allowance to supplement the purchase of health insurance. * **Savings plan** : The IDB Group cares about your future, depending on the length of the contract, you will receive a monthly savings plan allowance. * We offer assistance with **relocation and visa applications** for you and your family when it applies. * ***On\-site position*** *with the occasional flexibility of teleworking.* * **Development support** : We offer learning opportunities to boost your professional profile, such as seminars, 1:1 professional counseling, and much more. * **Health and well\-being** : Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees. * **Other office amenities (as available):** Lactation Room, Daycare Center, Gym, Bike Racks, Parking, spouse career support, and others. **Our culture** --------------- At the **IDB Group** , we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Product Manager
jobs.description: Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences. Our AI Agent Fin is the highest\-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always\-on customer support across the customer journey – from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end\-to\-end across every channel, with minimal set\-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams. Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers. **What's the opportunity?** --------------------------- In AI, proximity to customer reality is the moat. Even the best model doesn't run itself: it takes someone who gets close enough to a customer's business to make it work, and that closeness doesn't happen on its own. That's where the **Forward Deployed Product Manager** comes in. You'll work directly with our biggest customers at the moments that matter most in their journey with Fin, whether that's proving out value in an evaluation, getting a deployment live, or expanding what's possible once it's working, and get them to real, measurable success with Fin faster than they'd get there on their own. What you learn with them feeds back into the product, so every customer after them gets there faster and better too. This is a very novel role in the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what great looks like at Fin: evolving the playbooks, and shaping how we win and deliver on our biggest, highest\-stakes deals. This is a high\-ownership, high\-visibility role for a PM who wants real time with customers and hands\-on time with the product, and who's comfortable making progress before every answer is known. **What will I be doing?** ------------------------- * **Own outcomes for a portfolio of strategic customers deploying Fin.** Understand their business, their support operation, and their technical environment well enough that the deployment plan you propose earns trust immediately. * **Run the full arc yourself.** Pitch and demo Fin, scope the solution, hands\-on configure it (including custom development if required), and unblock whatever gets in the way, whether that's a product gap, a technical integration, or a cross\-functional snag. * **Be the AI expert in the room.** Customers should leave every conversation with you knowing more about how to get outstanding results from Fin. * **Partner tightly with Sales, Success, and R\&D** so each deployment feels like one team to the customer, not a relay race. * **Turn what you learn in the field into product.** Bring specific, evidence\-backed input, not just feature requests, to shape the roadmap. * **Build the playbook as you go:** the deployment patterns, templates, and best practices that make the next ten deployments faster than the first. * **Help define what Forward Deployed PM means at Fin**. It's a very novel role across the industry, still being shaped, and you'll help sharpen what it looks like here. Success in this role looks like your customers thriving with Fin, and the product getting sharper because of what you learned from them. It's product management at its core, not solutions engineering, customer success, or professional services. **What skills do I need?** -------------------------- * **Experience:** No minimum years required. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: **Job Purpose** At Intercontinental Exchange (NYSE:ICE), we engineer technology, exchanges and clearing houses that connect companies around the world to global capital and derivative markets. With a leading\-edge approach to developing technology platforms, we have built market infrastructure in all major trading centers, offering customers the ability to manage risk and make informed decisions globally. By leveraging our core strengths in technology, we continue to identify new ways to serve our customers and transform global markets. We're looking for motivated, results\-oriented people to join our team. We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to bring 3\+ years of hands\-on experience to our SRE team, operating with significant autonomy to improve platform reliability, drive automation, and mentor junior engineers. The ideal candidate contributes meaningfully to platform release cycles, leads smaller projects, and actively shapes the team's approach to observability, incident response, and service design in ICE's 24x7 production environment. **Responsibilities** * Employ advanced troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis to improve availability, performance, and security of IMT and platform services * Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to plan and deploy product releases with operational rigor and quality gates * Work with Engineering leadership to build and evolve shared services meeting the requirements of platform and application teams * Design and implement proactive monitoring, alerting, trend analysis, and self\-healing automation * Resolve product and service defects, infrastructure issues, and operational changes with increasing independence * Implement automated tests, automated deployments, and operational tooling across the SRE toolchain * Ensure services are designed with 24x7 availability and operational readiness and rigor * Lead smaller projects and provide status updates to management and stakeholders * Mentor SRE I engineers and contribute actively to team training and knowledge\-sharing * Partner with application and platform teams to identify critical workflows and build automated health checks that run post\-deployment and during incidents to accelerate root\-cause identification * Design and build AI\-assisted automated diagnosis jobs that correlate signals across monitoring and alerting platforms to reduce Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) for production incidents * Build and maintain automation pipelines (e.g., Rundeck, Jenkins) that integrate with AI/LLM tooling to drive efficiency gains in observability, runbook execution, and incident triage * Develop and tune AWS CloudWatch metrics, alarms, and dashboards, instrument services using OpenTelemetry/Alloy, and build observability visualizations in Grafana; integrate alerting and event correlation workflows across PagerDuty, BigPanda, and Splunk to ensure timely, actionable incident notification **Knowledge and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience * 3\+ years of experience in a site reliability, production engineering, or software operations role * Proven technical skills with strong personal initiative and consistent delivery of important work * Excellent teamwork with active involvement in training and mentoring * Ability to prioritize and execute without direct management guidance * Strong understanding of ICE Core Competencies **Preferred Knowledge and Experience** * Experience in financial services technology, mortgage platforms, or exchange infrastructure * Familiarity with SRE principles including SLI, SLO, and error budget management * Exposure to Terraform, Chef, Ansible, or equivalent infrastructure automation frameworks * Hands\-on experience with AWS observability services, CloudWatch, Grafana, OpenTelemetry/Alloy, Splunk, BigPanda, PagerDuty, and job orchestration/automation platforms such as Rundeck and Jenkins * Practical experience integrating AI/LLM\-based tooling into operational workflows to automate diagnosis, reduce manual triage, and improve incident response efficiency \#LI\-JM1 \-: Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to legally protected characteristics.

This position outline is a general guideline and does not represent all encompassing details. jobs.title: Industrial Engineer
jobs.description: * Sunnyvale, CA, United States * Not Remote * Manufacturing \& Operations * JOB217645 ### **Company Description** It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic\-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here. ### **Job Description** **Primary Function of Position:** The Industrial Engineer 3 will lead efforts to improve the efficiency of physical and transactional processes throughout the organization. In this position, the IE 3 will take a leadership role in advocating for a continuous improvement culture, executing projects of moderate to large scope across manufacturing operations, and driving lean improvement across numerous processes. The IE 3 may mentor junior staff and will be considered a technical SME. The candidate should have a strong track record of continuous improvement results, experience with project management and good soft skills. **Roles \& Responsibilities:** * Participate and may lead Industrial Engineering projects and activities. Projects may include value stream mapping, design reviews, new product development and introduction, new line or facility start\-up, and facility design. * Run structured technical problem solving investigations and utilize data driven analysis to provide recommendations and solutions to achieve improvement. * Evaluate operations and identify improvement opportunities, utilizing data analysis and metrics to build a business case, and deliver on execution. Monitor operational metrics including labor hours, WIP levels, and productivity, analyze data for trends, and collaborate with process owners to improve. * Review and analyze work cell layout, process flow, material flow, etc. Assess best practices. Recommend cost\-effective solutions for improving the utilization and efficiency of personnel, equipment and/or physical space. Lead projects that will result in improved costs and/or enhanced quality. * Perform duties and train in the areas of time standards, line balancing, simulation modeling, cost estimation, manpower planning, and continuous improvement. * Support large building or multi\-cell layout changes. May lead layout changes of moderate size with minimal oversight. * Upon request, perform strategic analysis and communicate findings effectively to various levels of management. This may include assessing long\-range capacity forecasts from analysis to recommendations and justification for facilities, equipment, and/or manpower requirements for new or sustaining product ramp. * May propose and/or draft reports or dashboards to support data analysis. * May build simple reports or dashboards for analysis and deeper understanding. * May maintain existing reports or dashboards as required. ### **Qualifications** **Skills, Experience, Education, \& Training:** Base Requirements * Bachelor’s Degree required in Industrial Engineering or related discipline, and 4 years minimum of applicable, progressive work experience. * Strong verbal communication and group presentation skills required. * Proficient general software and data analysis skills required (e.g. Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.) * General project management skills. * Ability to lead small to moderately sized change management initiatives. * Proven ability to manage many projects concurrently and in a timely fashion. * Advocating for Lean Manufacturing programs within the manufacturing operation. * Understands implications of change and can work within Quality Systems. * Minimal travel required (\<10%). Preferred Requirements * Advanced data analysis skillset (e.g. Tableau, VBA, R, etc.) preferred. * Simulation modeling experience (e.g. Simul8, Arena, etc) preferred. * Experience working in medical device manufacturing and knowledge of industry regulations preferred. * Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification with project experience preferred. * New Product Development/Introduction experience preferred. * Facility design experienced preferred ( AutoCAD). ### **Additional Information** Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID\-19\. Details can vary by role. Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws. Mandatory Notices U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR §743\.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status. For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes. We provide market\-competitive compensation packages, inclusive of base pay, incentives, benefits, and equity. The target compensation ranges are listed. Accommodation \& Accessibility Notice: Intuitive is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you require assistance or an accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, please contact People Services at HRHelpNow@intusurg.com. **Base Compensation Range Region 1:** $113,200 USD \- $162,800 USD **Base Compensation Range Region 2:** $96,200 USD \- $138,400 USD **Shift:** Day **Workplace Type:** Onsite \- This job is fully onsite.

jobs.title: IT Technician II
jobs.description: We are expanding our IT Services presence in Central Pennsylvania and are seeking a Level 2 IT Support Technician to join our team. This is a hands\-on, client\-facing role for someone who can take ownership of complex issues, lead work in the field, and act as an escalation point for our Level 1 team. On\-site work is a regular part of this position, so you will often be the face of our company, and the ability to hold a friendly, professional conversation in person is essential. The right candidate is a strong problem solver who stays calm under pressure, thinks critically, and makes sound decisions quickly when a situation does not go according to plan. You will work across a wide variety of environments, including desktops, servers, networking equipment, and cloud platforms, and you will play a direct role in installing and standing up the systems our clients depend on. We will invest in helping you grow toward senior infrastructure and project leadership roles. ### **About Intulse, Ltd.** We know we’re biased but we love working here. We love the work we do, and the people we do it with. Come join us! ### **Description** **Character Requirements** ========================== * **Responsibility:** Innate desire to do more than what is expected * **Thoroughness:** Work with efficiency, completeness, and within reasonable timeframes * **Dependability:** Fulfillment of expectations without excessive oversight * **Determination:** Persistence to complete goals despite external influences * **Flexibility:** Willingness to adapt to the needs of multiple departments and respond to direction and vision of teammates * **Composure:** Ability to stay level\-headed, think on the fly, and make quick, sound decisions when problems surface in the field Intulse is a privately owned company with core beliefs founded in Christian faith and we hire individuals who share that faith and commitment to our core values. Please **carefully read** about our culture and core values to understand if you'll fit in our unique environment: https://intulse.com/church/about\-us **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Client Support \& Advanced Troubleshooting** ---------------------------------------------- * Serve as an escalation point for Level 1 technicians on complex desktop, server, network, and cloud issues * Diagnose and resolve problems across desktops, laptops, printers, servers, firewalls, switches, and wireless systems * Troubleshoot root causes rather than symptoms, and document the fix so the issue does not recur * Make quick, well\-reasoned decisions when a job does not go as planned, and adapt on the fly to keep work moving * Delight our clients with fast, respectful, and helpful service **Hands\-On Installation \& Field Work** ---------------------------------------- Installation and field work is part of this role, mainly during project phases. Day to day, the focus is on support, troubleshooting, and infrastructure work. * Install and configure hardware and networking equipment, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, servers, workstations, and peripherals * Ability to run, terminate, and test low voltage cabling when a project requires it * Mount, rack, and cable equipment cleanly and to our standards * Perform hardware adds, moves, and changes, including physical relocations * Support onsite deployments, migrations, and infrastructure rollouts from start to finish **Networking \& Infrastructure** -------------------------------- * Configure and support VLANs, switching, wireless, and basic routing and VPN connectivity * Administer Windows Server environments, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and file services * Support and manage endpoints and mobile devices, including iOS, through mobile device management (MDM) platforms * Support virtualization platforms (Hyper\-V, Proxmox, or similar) * Administer Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace environments * Support backup, recovery, and business continuity systems **Helpdesk \& Documentation Tools** ----------------------------------- * Use our ticketing system to track and resolve all work * Ensure tickets are updated promptly and not left “stale” * Split and categorize issues properly when multiple concerns are reported * Create and maintain client documentation, network diagrams, and SOPs in our IT documentation tool and other systems **Remote Monitoring \& Management (RMM)** ----------------------------------------- * Monitor dashboards and alerts and follow up with defined remediation steps * Execute regularly scheduled or automated tasks as outlined in procedures * Identify recurring patterns and recommend proactive fixes **Project Work** ---------------- * Lead or assist with project phases, including hardware installs, network refreshes, and migrations * Coordinate onsite work and support senior engineers on larger infrastructure rollouts * Help plan and sequence work so installations go smoothly the first time **Communication \& Repo ropriately to senior team members when needed * Submit accurate timesheets and expense reports * Flag risks or recurring issues to the Service Manager and project leads * Ability to use AI to multiply your skills and save time, without using it as a replacement for critical thinking or feeding it inappropriate data such as personally identifiable information **Team Collaboration \& Mentorship** ------------------------------------ * Follow weekly schedules and dispatch assignments * Support and mentor Level 1 technicians, sharing knowledge and helping them grow * Participate in process improvements and feedback loops * Support our team's security posture by adhering to SOPs and staying vigilant * Show initiative by suggesting improvements, raising flags, and helping us serve better **Physical \& Travel Requirements** =================================== * Must be able to perform physical installation work, including hardware, networking equipment, servers, computers, and occasional low voltage cabling * Must be able to lift and transport IT hardware (servers, UPS units, switches, and similar) up to 50 pounds * Must be comfortable working on lifts or ladders for access points, cabling, and mounted equipment * Must be able to bend, kneel, reach, and work in tight spaces such as server rooms and network closets * Regular travel across Central PA using your own vehicle (mileage reimbursed) * Valid PA driver's license and reliable transportation required **Schedule Requirements** ========================= * Standard hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM (eastern time), Monday through Friday * This role requires flexibility. There will be times when project or support work calls for starting earlier or staying later to see a job through to completion. * Many of our clients, including churches, operate outside of standard business hours. Occasional evening or weekend work is part of this role, such as supporting a Sunday service or performing after\-hours maintenance when it is least disruptive to the client. * Some projects are time sensitive and, once started, must be finished before the workday ends, to avoid leaving a client in a “half broken” state. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of getting the job done right. * We are only considering candidates local to our Lancaster, PA office. * We work in the office 2 days a week. **Required Skills \& Experience** ================================= **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * 4\+ years in an IT support, helpdesk, or field technician role * Strong Windows and Windows Server administration experience (Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, file services) * Apple/macOS and iOS device support experience * Experience with mobile device management (MDM) platforms (Intune, Jamf, or similar) * Solid networking skills: TCP/IP, VLANs, switching, wireless, and basic routing and VPN * Hands\-on experience installing and configuring firewalls, switches, and wireless access points * Familiarity with running and terminating low voltage cabling * Comfortable using ticketing, RMM, and remote support tools * Strong critical thinking skills and the ability to make quick, sound decisions in the field * Clear written and verbal communicator, comfortable and professional in face\-to\-face client interactions, with a self\-directed work ethic **Preferred (Not Required)** ---------------------------- * Prior experience in an MSP or multi\-client support environment * Experience supporting church or non\-profit organizations * Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace admin experience * Experience with virtualization (Hyper\-V, Proxmox, etc.) * Experience with Ubiquiti UniFi networking * Relevant certifications (CompTIA Network\+, Security\+, Microsoft, or similar) **Benefits** ============ * Profit sharing * Healthcare options * 401K retirement plan with generous company matching * Generous PTO * Weekly company provided lunches * Work from home flexibility #### **Salary** $72,000 \- $85,000 per year

jobs.title: Practice Innovation Attorney
jobs.description: Focused on employment and labor law since 1958, Jackson Lewis P.C.’s 1,000\+ attorneys located in major cities nationwide consistently identify and respond to new ways workplace law intersects business. We help employers develop proactive strategies, strong policies and business\-oriented solutions to cultivate high\-functioning workforces that are engaged and stable, and share our clients’ goals to emphasize belonging and respect for the contributions of every employee. The Firm is ranked in the First Tier nationally in the category of Labor and Employment Litigation, as well as in both Employment Law and Labor Law on behalf of Management, in the U.S. News \- Best Lawyers® “Best Law Firms”. **Job Summary** --------------- The Practice Innovation Attorney will play a pivotal role in advancing the firm’s broader innovation objectives by identifying high\-value opportunities to improve legal work, translating practice needs into practical technology\- and GenAI\-enabled solutions, and leading the adoption of new solutions by attorneys and legal professionals. The role will help shape how emerging technologies are evaluated, developed, and incorporated into legal practice in ways that are practical, scalable, responsible, and aligned with firm priorities. Reporting to the Manager of AI and Innovation, the Practice Innovation Attorney will advise and collaborate with practice group leadership, attorneys, knowledge management professionals, IT, legal engineers, and external vendors to identify opportunities, define requirements, develop and validate solutions, and drive adoption across the firm. The role requires a strong understanding of legal practice, particularly litigation with a preferred focus on Labor \& Employment, demonstrated familiarity with legal AI and GenAI tools (e.g., Harvey, Westlaw AI, Lexis\+ AI, CoCounsel, or similar platforms), and the ability to translate complex technology capabilities into practical applications for legal professionals. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** ----------------------------------------- **Practice Discovery and Use\-Case Strategy** --------------------------------------------- * Engage practice leaders, attorneys, and business professionals to identify recurring challenges, inefficiencies, and opportunities for innovation and AI\-enabled improvement. * Evaluate and prioritize opportunities based on practice value, feasibility, risk, scalability, and alignment with firm priorities. * Map current and future\-state legal workflows and define practical requirements for selected solutions. * Develop recommendations for how GenAI and other emerging technologies can improve legal workflows, client service, and the delivery of legal services. **Solution Design and Validation** ---------------------------------- * Translate legal and business requirements into clear use cases, workflows, and functional requirements. * Partner with legal engineers, knowledge management, IT, and vendors to develop, test, and refine solutions. * Design and conduct legal workflow testing, including output review, issue identification, and documentation of appropriate use and limitations. * Help develop safeguards, guidance, and escalation paths for responsible use of AI and other emerging technologies. **Adoption and Practice Engagement** ------------------------------------ * Lead adoption efforts for assigned tools and use cases, including demonstrations, targeted training, coaching, communications, and workflow integration. * Collaborate with HR Learning and Professional Development teams to integrate innovation and AI initiatives into onboarding, attorney development, and ongoing learning programs. * Serve as a trusted advisor to practice leaders and knowledge management on the responsible and effective use of firm\-approved AI and GenAI tools. * Develop practical playbooks, prompt guidance, examples, and quick\-reference resources to facilitate effective use and adoption. * Establish feedback channels and use adoption and user feedback data to improve solutions, workflows, and user experience. **Market Awareness and Continuous Improvement** ----------------------------------------------- * Monitor legal AI capabilities, developments in professional responsibility guidance, and relevant changes in legal service delivery. * Assess new platform features and recommend whether and how they should be introduced into firm workflows. * Share lessons learned and reusable approaches through the Innovation Center of Excellence and other appropriate firm forums. * Identify emerging opportunities and advise firm leadership on trends, capabilities, and potential applications that advance firmwide innovation objectives. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school. * Minimum of 5 years of legal practice experience or equivalent experience in legal technology, legal operations, or legal innovation roles. * Demonstrated experience with  guidance. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively across departments and practice groups, with strong judgment and project leadership skills. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Background in labor and employment law or litigation practice. * Experience with change management or technology adoption initiatives in a law firm or professional services environment. * Familiarity with eDiscovery platforms, document management systems, and legal research databases. * Prior experience working with legal innovation or practice technology teams. * Experience leading cross\-functional technology, process improvement, or AI adoption initiatives. **Competencies \& Skills** -------------------------- * Innovation \& Strategic Thinking: Ability to identify high\-value opportunities, assess emerging capabilities, and connect technology initiatives to firmwide priorities and legal practice needs. * Legal Technology \& GenAI Fluency: Deep familiarity with the legal AI ecosystem and an understanding of how GenAI and other technologies can be integrated into legal workflows and practice management systems. * Solution Design \& Execution: Ability to translate practice needs into clear use cases, requirements, workflows, and practical solutions, and to drive initiatives through validation and adoption. * Advisory \& Influence: Trusted advisor who can engage senior stakeholders, communicate recommendations clearly, and build alignment across practice groups and business functions. * Communication \& Presentation: Exceptional ability to communicate complex technology concepts in plain language and effectively demonstrate tools and use cases to legal professionals. * Judgment \& Risk Awareness: Strong judgment regarding responsible AI use, legal ethics, information governance, and appropriate safeguards and escalation paths. * Collaboration \& Relationship Building: Proven ability to work cross\-functionally with attorneys, IT, leadership, legal engineers, and vendors to achieve strategic goals. \#LI\-LM1 **Reporting Structure \& Work Arrangement** ------------------------------------------- This position reports under the AI and Innovation Group. The Practice Innovation Attorney will work closely with practice group leaders, knowledge management attorneys, IT, legal engineers, and firm leadership on a day\-to\-day basis. This role may require occasional travel to firm offices for in\-person demonstrations, targeted training, or other innovation initiatives and is eligible for a hybrid or remote work arrangement in accordance with firm policy. For NY City, San Francisco and Los Angeles metro area, the expected salary range for this position is between $165,500 and $193,250\. This position is also eligible for annual bonuses. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law. Jackson Lewis offers a competitive benefits package that includes: * medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Flexible Spending \& Health Savings Account * firm\-paid holidays, vacation, and sick time * Employee assistance program and other benefits For Illinois, the expected salary range for this position is between $151,750 and $177,000\. This position is also eligible for annual bonuses. The actual compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law. Jackson Lewis offers a competitive benefits package that includes: * medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance * 401(k) Retirement Plan * Flexible Spending \& Health Savings Account * firm\-paid holidays, vacation, and sick time * Employee assistance program and other benefits We are an equal employment opportunity employer. jobs.title: Site Engineer (Data Centers)
jobs.description: Location Corpus Christi, Texas, United States Capabilities Construction Office Setup Hybrid Job ID \#44573 Industry Advanced Manufacturing At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact This job opportunity is **field assignment with generous per diem provided** in either Texas or Louisiana and we intend to hire the "best" candidates. **Your impact** Jacobs is the \#1\-ranked design firm on ENR’s Top 500 Design Firms list — for the seventh consecutive year — and a global leader in program management. Our Data Center and Advanced Manufacturing practice delivers complex, mission\-critical facilities for hyperscale owners, colocation operators, and advanced manufacturing clients. As a **Site Structural Engineer**, you will support construction execution for advanced manufacturing and hyperscale data\-center projects, serving as the structural engineering presence in the field. You will monitor daily installation activities, coordinate contractors and subcontractors, verify work against approved drawings and specifications, resolve structural issues, and maintain clear communication among the site team, design engineers, Project Manager, Construction Manager, and client. This is a construction\-focused field role with technical engineering responsibility. **Key Responsibilities** **Site Execution \& Structural Coordination** * Monitor daily structural construction activities, installation progress, work sequencing, manpower, materials, and constraints; provide clear field reporting to the Construction Manager and Project Manager. * Coordinate structural contractors, subcontractors, inspectors, surveyors, testing agencies, vendors, and other trades to support safe and predictable execution. * Review structural drawings, specifications, approved submittals, method statements, RFIs, and field\-change documentation for constructability, clarity, and consistency with project requirements. * Conduct routine site walks, inspections, field checks, and line walkdowns for foundations, slabs, steel, precast, embeds, connections, equipment supports, roof systems, and other structural work as assigned. * Verify that installed work conforms to approved design documents, applicable codes, project specifications, quality requirements, and the engineer’s design intent; escalate nonconforming work and potential design impacts. * Coordinate with structural engineers and design teams to resolve field conditions, dimensional conflicts, constructability issues, and technical questions; track RFIs and actions through closure. **Construction Management, Schedule \& Quality** * Track structural work against the project schedule and look\-ahead plans; identify delays, access constraints, trade conflicts, and material or design issues that may affect critical\-path activities. * Support daily reports, progress measurement, quantity verification, schedule updates, issue logs, constraint logs, and short\-interval planning for structural scope. * Support quality\-control implementation, inspection and test plans, concrete and steel testing, survey verification, weld and bolt inspections, punch lists, deficiency tracking, and closeout documentation. * Confirm that current approved drawings, specifications, equipment data, and work packages are available to field personnel; identify superseded or conflicting information. * Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable records of inspections, photographs, redlines, RFIs, NCRs, test reports, daily reports, meeting minutes, and structural closeout information. **Safety, Commissioning \& Turnover** * Champion Jacobs BeyondZero® safety culture; participate in site safety observations, pre\-task planning, toolbox talks, and coordination of safe work practices with contractors and subcontractors. * Support construction readiness, structural completion, equipment installation readiness, commissioning interfaces, punch\-list resolution, turnover, and operational handover activities. * Participate in constructability reviews, coordination meetings, lessons learned, and continuous\-improvement initiatives focused on safe, high\-quality data\-center and advanced\-manufacturing delivery. * Promote Jacobs’ culture of safety, quality, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion in all interactions with project teams, contractors, clients, and partners Here's what you'll need **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, or related discipline (or equivalent experience) * Typically, 5\-10 years \+ of experience in site engineering, field engineering, structural construction, construction management, or technical project delivery for complex facilities. * Experience supporting structural construction on Data Center, Advanced Technology, Semiconductor, industrial, mission\-critical, or similarly complex facility projects; hyperscale experience is preferred. * Working knowledge of design\-build, EPCM, or owner’s\-engineer delivery models and the interfaces among engineering, construction, commissioning, and client teams. * Working knowledge of construction documents, structural drawings and specifications, RFIs, submittals, inspections, quality records, daily reports, schedule tracking, and document\-control practices. **Ideally, you'll have** * PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI certification preferred or in progress * Professional Engineer (PE), Structural Engineer (SE), Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT), or comparable credential preferred; PE/SE licensure is not required unless assigned project duties require it. * Master’s degree in engineering, Project Management, or Construction Management * Experience on hyperscale cloud (AWS, Azure, Google, Meta), advanced semiconductor, or advanced manufacturing programs. * LEED AP BD\+C, CEA, or DBIA credential — differentiates on sustainability\-driven and Design\-Build pursuits * Familiarity with structural codes and standards, including IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, ACI, AWS, OSHA, and client construction standards. **Why Jacobs** Jacobs’ Data Center \& Advanced Manufacturing practice is among the fastest\-growing practices in the firm, delivering programs for hyperscale cloud providers, colocation operators, and semiconductor fab owners across the US and globally. Project Managers at Jacobs lead programs that matter, with direct access to a deep technical bench, a culture of innovation, and a career path that scales with the market. Posted Salary Range: Minimum 69,500\.00 Posted Salary Range: Upper 95,500\.00 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to invest in you, and in the things you care about. Your health. Your well\-being. Your security. Your future. Employees have access to medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance, a 401(k) plan, and the ability to purchase company stock at a discount. Eligible employees may also enroll in a deferred compensation plan or the Executive Deferral Plan. Jacobs has an unlimited U.S. Personalized Paid Time Off (PPTO) policy for full\-time salaried/exempt employees, seven paid holidays, and caregiver leave. And certain roles may be eligible for additional rewards, including merit increases, performance discretionary bonus, and stock. The base salary range for this position is $69,500\.00 to $95,500\.00\. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Job posted on August 31, 2026\. This position will be open for at least 3 days. We value collaboration and believe that in\-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

jobs.title: Quality Control Inspector Trainee, Non-Destructive Testing (1st Shift)
jobs.description: **Company Overview** -------------------- Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. Since 2009, our team has worked steadily to make this dream a reality. We’ve designed and tested many generations of prototype aircraft capable of serving in a network of electric air taxis. We’re looking for talented, committed individuals to join our team as we push onward toward certifying the Joby aircraft, scaling our manufacturing, and launching our initial commercial service. **Overview** ------------ Joby Aviation is seeking a detail\-oriented Quality Control Inspector, Non\-Destructive Testing (NDT), 1st Shift to perform specialized inspections across our manufacturing, assembly, and component fabrication operations. Reporting to Quality Control leadership, this role is critical to evaluating structural integrity, material soundness, and engineering conformity across composite, metallic, and additively manufactured aircraft parts. **Please note:** * This single requisition serves as an overarching intake for NDT technical talent across four core inspection modalities: Ultrasonic Testing (UT), Computed Tomography (CT), Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT), and Eddy Current Testing (ET). * Candidates do not need to hold active certifications in all four modalities to apply. Applicants will be screened by Talent Acquisition and technical leads to determine appropriate functional placement and level alignment based on certification history, classroom training hours, and hands\-on experience. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Inspection Execution:** Perform non\-destructive evaluations on composite structures, metallic components, additive manufactured parts, and assemblies using one or more primary modalities: Ultrasonic (UT), Computed Tomography (CT), Liquid Penetrant (PT), or Eddy Current (ET) * **Equipment Setup \& Calibration:** Set up, calibrate, and standardize NDT equipment, sensors, transducers, probes, and X\-ray/CT scanning systems according to written techniques and standard operating procedures * **Data Interpretation:** Analyze scanning data, A/B/C\-scans, 3D CT reconstructions, signal responses, and surface indications against engineering drawings, acceptance criteria, and quality standards * **Defect Documentation:** Accurately document inspection findings, log results in MES/QMS databases, and generate nonconforming material reports (MRB tags) when discontinuities exceed allowable limits * **Method \& Technique Support:** Collaborate with NDT Engineers, Quality Engineers, and shop\-floor teams to assist with technique development, scan plan verification, and defect root\-cause investigations * **Quality Compliance:** Maintain strict compliance with FAA requirements, internal QMS procedures, NADCAP audit guidelines, and NAS 410 written practices **Required** ------------ * **Education \& Training:** High School Diploma or GED * **NDT Experience:** 0\-2 years practical inspection experience or formal classroom/military training equivalent to NAS 410 in at least one core modality: Ultrasonic (UT), Computed Tomography (CT), Liquid Penetrant (PT), or Eddy Current (ET) * **Blueprint \& Specs:** Demonstrated ability to read and interpret complex engineering drawings and material specifications * **Quality Standards:** Familiarity with industry NDT qualification standards (e.g., NAS 410, ASNT, ASTM) * **Computer Skills:** Proficiency using manufacturing software (ERP/MES), specialized digital NDT analysis tools and Microsoft 365 **Desired** ----------- * Technical diploma, military NDT training program, or Associate's degree preferred * Active or prior NAS 410 certifications (Level I, Level II, or Level III) in UT, CT, PT, or ET * Experience inspecting advanced composite structures (e.g., carbon fiber laminates, honeycomb core), precision aerospace welds, or additive manufacturing components * Hands\-on experience with Phased Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), automated CT reconstruction software, or high\-throughput penetrant lines * Familiarity with NADCAP audit processes and FAA Part 21/145 manufacturing environments Compensation at Joby is a combination of base pay and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). The target base pay for this position is $30 \- $39 per hour. The compensation package will be determined by job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Joby also offers a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan with a company match, an employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, and more. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.description: **Business Development Representative** Employment Type: Full\-time Location: Fully Remote \| Bay Area / Silicon Valley Required KIDZ AI (NASDAQ: KIDZ) **The Role** We are a Nasdaq\-listed company building a portfolio of early\-stage companies across AI, robotics, and emerging technology. We are looking for a Bay Area/Silicon Valley\-based BD representative who can get out into the market, find interesting companies before everyone else does, get in front of founders, and open doors. We want someone who already knows how to navigate it — someone who knows where founders are, who is building what, and how to get a meeting when there is no obvious introduction. Your job is simple: Find companies. Meet founders. Start conversations. Create opportunities. You are not expected to make the final investment or business decision. jobs.title: Director, Data Center Electrical Engineering
jobs.description: **Careers at Keel** Keel Infrastructure is a publicly traded energy and digital infrastructure company that develops and owns data centers and power assets across North America. At Keel, you're not just joining a company, you're helping build the infrastructure behind the future of compute. **Why Keel** We're at the intersection of energy and technology, two industries transforming in real time. The work is complex. The pace is fast. The impact is real. You'll be part of a team that values: * **Ownership —** we take responsibility and follow through * **Collaboration —** we work across teams, functions, and borders * **Curiosity —** we ask questions and keep learning * **Endurance —** we build for the long term **What It Feels Like to Work Here** * Fast\-moving, high\-growth, and hands\-on * Smart, driven people solving real challenges together * Work that directly supports AI and next\-generation infrastructure * Room to grow, stretch, and take on more **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, bonus and equity opportunities * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits * Retirement savings with company contribution * Employee referral program Interested? This is a great opportunity to work for a young and dynamic company! We are currently looking for a **Director, Data Center Electrical Engineering** to join our team! **Purpose of the Role** ----------------------- *The Director of Data Center Electrical Engineering is a senior leadership role responsible for defining, owning, and continuously advancing the company's electrical engineering standards across all data center development projects. This individual serves as the internal authority on power distribution architecture, backup power systems, medium\-voltage infrastructure, controls integration, and electrical system reliability — ensuring that every facility we develop is engineered to deliver the power capacity, redundancy, and efficiency our customers and business require.* *This role partners closely with mechanical engineering, commissioning, construction management, procurement, and utility relations teams to drive coordinated electrical design decisions from site selection and utility engagement through design, construction, and energization. The Director of Electrical Engineering sets the frameworks, specifications, and design standards that govern how our portfolio is powered — and ensures those standards are consistently applied and continuously improved as the company scales and as customer requirements evolve toward higher\-density, AI\-driven workloads.* **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ **Engineering Leadership \& Standards** * Develop and own the company's electrical engineering design standards, basis\-of\-design documentation, and technical specifications governing all electrical systems across new data center development. * Establish and enforce electrical design criteria for critical power path systems: utility service entrance, medium\-voltage switchgear, unit substation transformers, low\-voltage switchgear and switchboards, UPS systems, static transfer switches (STS), PDUs, and IT busway/whip distribution. * Define standards for backup power infrastructure including diesel generator plants, automatic transfer switches (ATS), and battery energy storage systems (BESS). * Drive continuous improvement of power usage effectiveness (PUE) through efficient electrical system design, transformer loss optimization, and power factor management. * Lead evaluation, selection, and standardization of electrical equipment and systems across the portfolio to maximize reliability, reduce spare parts complexity, and improve procurement leverage. **Project Execution** * Provide electrical engineering leadership and technical review across all project phases, from site feasibility and schematic design through design development, construction documents, and commissioning. * Review and approve electrical design packages from external engineers of record (EORs), ensuring compliance with company standards, NEC, NFPA 70/75/76, and jurisdictional requirements. * Oversee the development of single\-line diagrams, system architectures, and load schedules as living design documents throughout the project lifecycle. * Lead electrical value engineering efforts, balancing first cost, lifecycle cost, equipment lead times, reliability, and schedule across each project. * Support RFP development, bid evaluation, and contractor/vendor selection for electrical scopes of work; review electrical subcontractor qualifications and proposed means and methods. * Oversee electrical construction administration including submittal review, RFI responses, field design changes, and coordination with the commissioning team during startup and energization. **Team \& Stakeholder Management** * Build, mentor, and lead an internal electrical engineering team as the company's development pipeline grows. * Manage relationships with external electrical engineers of record, s bility for IST. * Present electrical design strategies, system architecture decisions, and capital investment recommendations to executive leadership and, where applicable, to customers and investors. **Innovation \& Technology Roadmap** * Evaluate and develop the company's strategy for high\-density power distribution to support AI/HPC workloads — including 415V busway, direct 480V rack\-level distribution, high\-ampacity overhead busway systems, and 800VDC integration. * Develop roadmap for integration of battery energy storage systems (BESS) to support grid resiliency, demand response, and sustainability goals. * Monitor and respond to evolving NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and utility interconnection requirements across key development markets; update company standards accordingly. * Participate in relevant industry organizations (7x24 Exchange, NFPA, IEEE, Uptime Institute) and contribute to thought leadership. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Experience \& Background** * 12\+ years of progressive electrical engineering experience. * Demonstrated experience leading electrical design on hyperscale, colocation, or enterprise data center projects. * Experience as a technical owner or discipline lead, not just a contributor, on large capital projects. * Prior experience managing or mentoring engineering staff and external consultants. ### **Technical Knowledge** * Deep knowledge of data center electrical distribution architectures. * Proficiency in medium\-voltage system design. * Strong knowledge of UPS systems, battery systems, and static and mechanical transfer switch technologies. * Experience with backup power systems including diesel generator sizing, fuel systems, and generator controls integration. * Experience with electrical system modeling, including arc flash hazard analysis (NFPA 70E), short circuit studies, load flow analysis, and power quality assessments. * Familiarity with SCADA, EPMS, and BMS integration requirements for electrical infrastructure monitoring and control. ### **Leadership \& Competencies** * Ability to translate complex electrical engineering concepts for non\-technical audiences including executives and investors. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities simultaneously. * Excellent written and verbal communication; experience authoring design standards and technical specifications. * Collaborative mindset with experience working cross\-functionally in fast\-paced development environments. ### **Educational Requirements** * Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred. * Professional certifications (CDCDP, PMP, ATD, LEED AP, DCEP, or similar) are a significant asset. **Key Success Metrics** ----------------------- Performance in this role will be evaluated against the following outcomes: * Standards Development — Publish company\-wide electrical design standards. * PUE Performance — Achieve or exceed target annualized PUE for new facilities. * Design Schedule Adherence — Electrical design packages issued on schedule, measured against approved project milestones. * Quality outcomes — Facility delivered to Keel's design specifications and critical infrastructure standards, with complete documentation and as\-builts at handover. * Commissioning readiness — Successful L0–L5 commissioning execution and timely system handover to operations teams. * Stakeholder confidence — Clear, consistent, and accurate reporting to the VP of Engineering and senior leadership; strong working relationships with the owner's rep, GC, engineering partners, and municipal stakeholders. * Risk management — Proactive identification and mitigation of project risks ahead of critical path impact. **Work Arrangement** -------------------- * Location: Remote * Schedule: On\-site (NYC HQ) a minimum of one week per month. * Travel: Occasional travel to other Keel sites or vendor/partner locations as required.
