jobs.description: Senior Technical Success Manager **Location:** Remote, Travel as Needed **Reporting to:** Technical Operations Manager At **STN**, we don't just adapt to the digital future, we engineer it. Our mission is to help organizations thrive in a rapidly evolving technology landscape through strategic insight, cutting\-edge solutions, and a security\-first mindset. We provide end\-to\-end services spanning cloud consulting, AI infrastructure, and enterprise security, enabling secure, scalable, and future\-ready transformation. As trusted advisors, we align IT investments with business outcomes that drive performance and growth, starting with deep strategic engagement and delivering tailored solutions built for long\-term impact. Our approach is innovation\-led and rooted in cybersecurity, with a focus on leveraging the right technologies to solve real\-world challenges. We invest in our people and foster a culture of growth, inclusion, and purpose because we believe empowered teams build transformative technology.**Overview** ============ The Technical Success Manager is responsible for the operational, technical, and lifecycle success of assigned managed\-services customers. The position serves as a primary relationship and coordination point between the customer and STN’s Service Desk and Managed Services Operations, Engineering, Project Management Office, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership teams. The Technical Success Manager develops and maintains an informed understanding of each customer’s business, stakeholders, technology environment, managed\-services agreement, support history, active initiatives, asset lifecycle, and upcoming contractual obligations. The role facilitates recurring customer meetings, monitors service performance and escalations, tracks commitments, coordinates ongoing initiatives, supports asset and technology lifecycle planning, and ensures that contract, licensing, warranty, and service renewals are identified and addressed in advance. This is a non\-commissioned role. The Technical Success Manager identifies customer needs and qualified improvement opportunities but transfers solution design, pricing, negotiation, forecasting, and closing responsibilities to the appropriate Sales, Solutions, or contract\-management resources.Key Responsibilities ==================== **Customer relationship and account knowledge** ----------------------------------------------- * Serve as a primary operational point of contact for assigned managed\-services customers. * Build relationships with customer executives, business leaders, technical contacts, department managers, and escalation stakeholders. * Understand each customer’s business operations, critical technology dependencies, supported locations, key vendors, communication preferences, and service expectations. * Maintain an accurate stakeholder map identifying decision\-makers, technical contacts, executive sponsors, renewal owners, and escalation contacts. * Maintain awareness of customer sentiment, organizational change, operational risks, business priorities, and upcoming initiatives. * Represent the customer’s interests internally while maintaining contractual, technical, and operational boundaries. **Customer meeting management** ------------------------------- * Coordinate and attend weekly, monthly, quarterly, and other scheduled customer meetings based on account requirements. * Prepare agendas using ticket activity, service performance, project status, lifecycle items, renewals, open decisions, risks, and upcoming initiatives. * Facilitate meetings or support the designated meeting owner. * Document decisions, owners, due dates, risks, dependencies, and follow\-up actions. * Distribute meeting notes and action summaries within the established service standard. * Track customer commitments through completion and escalate overdue or blocked actions. * Assist with monthly service reviews, quarterly business reviews, executive reviews, and technology\-planning discussions. **Support ticket and service oversight** ---------------------------------------- * Review open tickets, aging tickets, escalations, recurring incidents, reopened tickets, and customer\-impacting trends for assigned accounts. * Monitor high\-priority and customer\-sensitive issues to confirm ownership, communication cadence, and appropriate escalation. * Follow up on tickets and initiate with Managed Services Operations, who remain responsible for completing the work; keep informed and help move stalled tickets forward. * Help ensure customer\-facing updates are timely, accurate, understandable, and aligned with confirmed technical information. * Identify patterns that may require root\-cause analysis, problem management, technical remediation, training, lifecycle replacement, or project work. * Review relevant SLA performance, ticket volume, response trends, resolution trends, and backlog information. * Avoid bypassing established service ownership or directly  enewal, initiative, risk, and escalation records current. * Conduct recurring internal account reviews with Service Delivery, Managed Services Operations, Engineering, PMO, Sales, Procurement, Finance, and leadership as appropriate. * Provide leadership with visibility into account health, upcoming renewals, lifecycle exposure, open commitments, escalations, and commercial handoffs. * Use the STN One portal, Atlassian products (Jira and Confluence), the ticketing system, Salesforce, NetSuite, monitoring tools, and other approved platforms according to defined processes. * Support customer onboarding, transitions, offboarding, and material environment changes, and validate that onboarding (G.9\) and offboarding (G.11\) duties are complete. * Identify possible service\-scope misunderstandings or recurring out\-of\-scope requests and route them for review. Experience \& Qualifications ============================ **Required** ------------ * Four or more years of experience in an MSP, IT service\-delivery, technical account\-management, customer success, or comparable customer\-facing technical role. * At least two years managing customer relationships, escalations, recurring reviews, or an assigned account portfolio. * Operational working knowledge of networks, servers, cloud services, cybersecurity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. * Experience reviewing support tickets, service metrics, customer escalations, and recurring issue trends. * Experience coordinating technical projects, upgrades, remediation activities, or customer initiatives. * Experience using a PSA, CRM, ticketing system, documentation platform, project system, asset platform, or monitoring portal. * Ability to interpret service descriptions, contract dates, licensing quantities, warranties, and renewal requirements. * Strong written communication, meeting facilitation, organization, documentation, and follow\-through skills. * Ability to communicate credibly with customer executives, business contacts, and technical teams. * Sound judgment regarding when to involve Service Delivery, Engineering, Security, PMO, Sales, Finance, Procurement, Legal, or leadership. **Preferred** ------------- * Direct Managed Service Provider employment experience. * Experience leading monthly service reviews, QBRs, executive reviews, or technology\-planning meetings. * Experience with contract renewals, software licensing, hardware warranties, leases, or vendor services. * Experience developing asset or technology lifecycle plans. * Experience with Atlassian Jira and Confluence, a customer portal, PSA, CRM, RMM or monitoring tools, and IT documentation platforms. * ITIL 4 Foundation, Microsoft Fundamentals, CompTIA, CAPM, Project\+, or similar relevant certification. * Experience working with regulated or compliance\-sensitive customers. **Physical and work requirements** ---------------------------------- * Regular use of video conferencing, collaboration tools, ticketing systems, dashboards, and customer portals. * Ability to participate in meetings across supported customer time zones. * Periodic customer, company, or vendor travel as required by account needs. * Occasional participation in urgent customer escalations outside the normal meeting schedule. * Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law and company policy. Compensation ============ * Full\-Time, Exempt * $100,000\-$110,000/year, DOE Benefits ======== * Health Coverage – Medical, Dental \& Vision * FSA Health and Dependent Care available • 401(k) Plan * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Observed Holidays Paid * Cell Phone Allowance * Collaborative, growth\-driven culture Candidates must be U.S. Citizens or Permanent Residents. We are unable to provide sponsorship at this time. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check and reference verification. All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. K1KM6UirZo

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission. By combining comprehensive commerce\-enablement technology with high\-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator\-built software suite including OMS, Pre\- and Post\-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale. With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end\-to\-end commerce solutions combine best\-in\-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order. Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry\-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top\-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures. We are looking for a talented and driven Senior Software Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will be a key contributor to our technical efforts, designing and developing robust solutions, and providing technical guidance to other engineers. You'll have the opportunity to own features from start to finish, influencing specifications, building out backend services (Typescript), and interacting with the frontend (React). You will play a vital role in improving and scaling our software, directly impacting the third\-party logistics (3PL) industry. At Stord, we believe in product\-centered engineering \- engineers who don't just build what they're told, but actively shape the future of our products through technical innovation and customer\-focused thinking. You'll be expected to contribute meaningfully to product strategy, leveraging your technical expertise to identify new opportunities and guide product evolution. You will join a team within our new and strategic Commerce group, the division responsible for building the next generation of software products at Stord. You will help design and develop applications that transform the entire merchant\-to\-consumer journey, creating a seamless and branded experience that empowers our merchants' customers with proactive communication and greater control. Ultimately, your work will help our merchants build stronger brand loyalty and increase customer satisfaction. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Technical Contribution : Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reliable, and secure systems, focusing on simplicity and maintainability. * Problem\-Solving : Tackle complex technical challenges across the stack, driving innovation and delivering efficient solutions. * Mentorship : Provide guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of learning and professional development. * Collaboration : Work within a team of Engineers and partner with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to define and prioritize work, ensuring the successful delivery of high\-quality features. * Code Quality : Maintain high standards for code quality, testing, and software development practices. * Feature Ownership : Take ownership of entire features from ideation to deployment, influencing specs and building out backend services. * Cross\-Team Collaboration : Work with other teams to contribute to scaling processes, tools, and technologies. **What You'll Need** -------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on modern web development * Proven track record of architecting and implementing complex, distributed systems in production environments * Strong understanding of full\-stack development principles and scalable system design * Experience with fullstack Typescript products including Node.js and React * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably GCP * Experience building complex web applications and working with large datasets * Demonstrated ability to learn and adapt to new technologies * Experience with high\-performance, scalable web applications

jobs.title: Solution Architect (AWS)
jobs.description: Job Description: Will engage with end users and customer stakeholders to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues with Wickr services and identify needs to improve customer support. Primary responsibilities: * Assess the current messaging and collaboration service implementation. * Document the “as\-is” environment, and identify design improvements for scalability, reliability, and security. * Develop and document standard operating procedures (SOPs), runbooks, and knowledge articles for messaging and collaboration service operations and support. * Collaborate with security, networking, and collaboration/tooling teams on integration challenges (e.g., directory services, identity, logging, and monitoring platforms, etc.). * Monitor service health, usage, and capacity; implement alerting and reporting for key metrics. * Plan and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes, following change\-management processes. * Provide training and guidance to internal help desk and engineering teams on features, policies, and support processes. * Act as primary technical liaison when advanced troubleshooting or roadmap input is needed. Job Requirements * 7\-10 years overall IT experience. * 3\+ years working with AWS infrastructure in a sysadmin, devops, or cloud engineering role. * Experience in a senior support, consulting, or technical account manager role where you led discovery, documented customer environments, and recommended improvements. * Experience running workshops or interviews to understand user adoption, pain points, and training needs. * Hands\-on experience administering AWS Wickr and/or Wickr Enterprise (network admin, cluster admin, or similar role). * Ability to operate in ambiguous environments, perform discovery, and propose a structured plan to get from “unknown current state” to a well\-documented, managed Wickr service. * Experience performing initial setup and ongoing configuration of Wickr networks, user provisioning, security policies, retention, and compliance settings. * Experience integrating Wickr with identity providers (IdP) such as Active Directory, Azure AD, Okta, or other SAML/OIDC services. * Experience operating secure collaboration or messaging platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Slack Enterprise Grid, Signal/other E2EE tools) in regulated or high\-security environments. * Experience troubleshooting real\-time communication issues: connectivity, media quality, federation, client configuration, and endpoint problems. * Strong communication skills capable of communicating technical concepts to senior leadership and customer stakeholders. jobs.description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* Job Category Software Engineering Job Details **About Salesforce** Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. jobs.title: Sr AI/ML Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape. Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry\-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. **Job Description** In this AI/ML ASIC Performance Engineer position, you will develop AI Storage Solutions based advanced system architectures and AI/ML Accelerator ASIC architecture specifications for Sandisk’s next generation products. You will drive, initiate, and analyze frontend architecture of the AI/ML Accelerator product. As an AI/ML ASIC Architect you will help drive new architecture initiatives that leverage the state\-of\-the\-art frontend interfaces like UCIe, PCIe, CXL, etc that integrates AI Storage Solutions with xPU in a 3D package system. You will drive the AI Storage Solutions based architecture. You will exercise your technical expertise and excellent communication skills to collaborate with design and product planning with an eye towards delivering innovative and highly competitive adaptive accelerators solutions. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Front End (Customer Experience)
jobs.description: Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960\. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again. But Scout is more than just a brand, it's a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work. The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn't been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all\-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built\-in gas\-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range. At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go\-getter with unrivaled passion. Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now! #### **Overview** As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Customer Experience team, you will be a core contributor to the customer\-facing experiences that define how people buy a vehicle with us. You will build and maintain high\-quality frontend features across the purchase journey, working across trade\-in, vehicle configuration, finance and leasing, and delivery. You will work closely with product, design, and backend engineers to ship experiences that customers trust with high\-stakes decisions. You will take real ownership of features from design through delivery, contribute meaningfully to technical decisions within the team, and help raise the bar on frontend craft across the codebase. This role is ideal for an engineer who writes thoughtful, production\-quality frontend code, cares deeply about the customer experience, and wants to grow their skills in a complex, design\-rich, transactional product. #### **What you'll do** Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick\-up truck \& rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following: * Build and maintain polished, performant customer\-facing frontend features, writing clean, well\-tested code that your teammates can rely on and extend. * Implement UI components and application logic that are correct, accessible, and consistent with our design system, translating design intent into high\-fidelity, maintainable code. * Take end\-to\-end ownership of features from scoping and technical design through implementation, testing, and monitoring in production. * Integrate frontend experiences with backend APIs and third\-party services, handling loading states, error conditions, and edge cases thoughtfully. * Contribute to frontend performance work: improving Core Web Vitals, reducing bundle size, and ensuring the UI holds up under real\-world network and device conditions. * Participate actively in code and design reviews, sharing knowledge and helping maintain a high quality bar across the team. * Contribute to the shared component library and design system, helping keep it consistent, accessible, and easy for others to use. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to understand requirements and ship solutions that genuinely serve customers. * Treat accessibility as a core part of the job, building inclusive experiences by default rather than as a retrofit. * Use AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase velocity and share effective practices with the team. **Location \& Travel Expectations**: * This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in **Fremont, California.** * This role requires 1 day per week in the office, with regular in\-person meetings and events. * Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time. * Driver's License required for domestic travel. #### **What you'll bring** We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You'll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment. You'll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring: * Education/Certifications: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related technical field * 5\+ years of frontend engineering experience, with a track record of shipping production features end\-to\-end. * Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript, with a solid understanding of component patterns, state management, and application architecture. * Familiarity with modern frontend technologies including WebGL, GSAP, Framer Motion, and Astro is a strong plus. * Good eye for design and attention to detail, able to implement UIs that match design intent accurately and consistently. * Working knowledge of frontend performance fundamentals: Core Web Vitals, rendering strategies, and bundle optimization. * Practical understanding of web accessibility standards (WCAG) and experience building accessible components. * Experience integrating frontend applications with REST or GraphQL APIs, including handling errors, loading states, and edge cases. * Collaborative and communicative, comfortable asking questions, flagging blockers, and contributing to team discussions. #### **What you'll gain** The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up. This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation. In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights: * Competitive insurance including: + Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans * 401(k) program with: + An employer match and immediate vesting * Generous Paid Time Off including: + 20 days planned PTO, as accrued + 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually + Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders + Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave #### **Pay Transparency** This is a full\-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent. Initial base salary range \= $140,000\.00 \- $170,000\.00 Initial California base salary range\= $154,000 \- $187,000 Internal leveling code: IC9 **Notice to applicants:** * To be considered for career opportunities at Scout Motors, applicants must be 18 years of age or older. * Residing in **San Francisco**: *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* * Residing in **Los Angeles**: *Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.* * Residing in **New York City**: *This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.* **Equal Opportunity** Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

Preferred base knowledge of some of the following technologies: * Carrier transport circuit technologies such as Ethernet over Copper (EOC/EFM), ADSL, T1s, fiber services (DWDM), and Metro\-Ethernet * Network infrastructure, DNS, IP Subnetting * Dynamic Routing Protocols (BGP, OSPF, RIP and EIGRP) * Telephony based technologies (TDM, Converged, VOIP, SIP, etc.) **About Segra:** Segra owns and operates a wide and dense fiber\-optic infrastructure footprint that provides state\-of\-the\-art connectivity, cybersecurity, voice, cloud and colocation solutions, all backed by industry\-leading service and reliability. jobs.description: Washington Navy Yard, District of Columbia, US, 20374 Category: Navy Job ID: 34503 widget: Full\-Time Secret No \- Teleworking not available for this position $119574\.56\-$199290\.94 ### **Position Description \& Qualifications** If you seek a rewarding, high profile and challenging position supporting projects for the US Navy, Serco has a wonderful opportunity for you! As the Submarine Control System (SCS) Software and Certification Engineer, based in Washington, DC, you will be on a dynamic team providing technical and programmatic support to the VIRGINIA Class Submarine Program (PMS450\) and the U.S. Navy’s Team Submarine Program Offices and serve as the Software and Certification Manager for the VIRGINIA Ship Control System division as part of the Virginia Class Program Office (PMS 450\). Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors and contribute and influence the Navy's future, premier nuclear submarines. Team Submarine unites the Program Executive Officer, Undersea Warfare Systems (PEO UWS); the Deputy Commander, Undersea Technology (SEA 07\); Program Executive Officer, Attack Submarine (PEO SSN); Program Executive Officer, Strategic Subs (PEO SSBN) and the Submarine Maintenance Engineering, Planning, and Procurement (SUBMEPP) Activity, once diverse submarine\-related commands and activities, into a single "submarine\-centric" team. Conceived to increase efficiencies within the submarine acquisition, maintenance, and modernization communities, Team Submarine eliminates traditional "stovepipe" structures and processes that created impediments and inefficiencies in the submarine research, development, acquisition, and maintenance communities. Team Submarine provides improved communication among the various offices that contribute to the overall success of the United States Submarine Force. The Virginia Class Submarine Program (PMS450\) is responsible for the design, construction, certification, and delivery of Virginia Class Submarines. Virginia Class Submarines (VCS) are built to seek out and destroy enemy ships/submarines, working both independently and in concert with carrier strike groups/other ships, providing Joint Commanders with early, accurate knowledge of the battlefield; covert striking power against targets ashore; and the maritime strength to destroy enemy naval forces and interdict seaborne commerce. U.S. Navy submarines ARE the undersea advantage against our adversaries. jobs.title: Dream Chaser Flight Controller - Systems Engineer I
jobs.description: **Sierra Space Careers:** ========================= At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth. Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond. Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission\-ready throughout space. We are mission\-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team. **About the Role** ================== Within the Flight Operations organization, Flight Planning and Design is responsible for planning missions for the Dream Chaser program as well as supporting real\-time Dream Chaser mission operations. You will utilize custom flight design tools based in FreeFlyer and Matlab to design the spacecraft trajectory to meet mission needs. Additionally, you will work closely with hardware and software engineers, flight science analysts, and other flight control disciplines to integrate products in the form of timelines, procedures, trajectories, attitudes, etc. Additionally, you will complete training requirements and participate in training simulations on your path toward flight controller certification. Upon certification, you will provide real\-time mission support from our Mission Control Center (MCC) in Louisville, CO.**About You** ============= Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space\-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission. We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. **Minimum Qualifications:** --------------------------- * Minimum Qualifications: Requires Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree). * Typically entry\-level 0 \- 2 years of experience. * Highly organized and detail oriented * Strong background in orbital mechanics or spacecraft attitude dynamics. * Clear and concise communication skills (written and verbal) * Ability and willingness to learn new subjects and disciplines * Practical knowledge of engineering principles and practices * Self\-starter and problem\-solver who is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and often\-changing environment * Ability to work effectively under pressure as part of a team * The ability to pass the flight controller certification and physical may be a condition of continued employment * Position based in Louisville, CO. Some shiftwork will be required during mission operations. **Preferred Qualifications:** ----------------------------- * Preferred Qualifications: MATLAB * STK or Freeflyer * Microsoft Office Tools * Tool development including a GUI (In any coding language) * Technical writing: detailed process documentation * Strong foundation in Orbital Mechanics * Strong foundation in Spacecraft Attitudes * Some experience studying or working with Kalman Filters **Compensation****:** --------------------- Pay Range: $77,685\.00 \- $106,816\.50 Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case\-by\-case basis and may vary based on job\-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness. **Elevate Your Career** ======================= At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations. We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more. Sierra Space is an industry\-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission\-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space\-based assets and enable space exploration. *Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is* *identified.* ***Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.*** Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us. ### **About Us** **About Sierra Space** ====================== Headquartered in Colorado, Sierra Space is a mission\-proven Defense Tech company delivering satellite platforms, critical subsystems, reusable spaceplanes, hypersonic technologies, propulsion systems, and infrastructure for the nation’s most critical missions. With more than three decades of heritage and a record of flight\-proven success in space, Sierra Space is trusted by U.S. National Security, Civil customers, and global allies. Our technologies safeguard our nation, sustain human exploration in space, and ensure the freedom of operations beyond Earth. Sierra Space is defining the new era of Space Defense, strengthening deterrence today and preserving freedom of action for generations to come.

jobs.title: Head of Forward Deployed Engineering
jobs.description: **Build AI products people use—and lead the engineers who ship them** --------------------------------------------------------------------- Single Grain is hiring a technical player\-coach to lead six engineers, build alongside them, and turn customer problems into secure, reliable products that hit their engagement goals. You will report directly to Eric Siu. You should be deeply hands\-on with AI: we expect 95%\+ of your code to be written with AI, with you accountable for architecture, verification, useful reviews and production quality. You need to know what to build, what to prioritize and what to stop. **About Single Grain** ---------------------- Single Grain combines marketing services, software and AI to drive measurable customer results. This role connects engineering work to that larger vision. You will help the team turn useful discoveries into products clients adopt, maintain and expand. **What you will own** --------------------- * Manage six engineers. Set assignments, sequence work, manage capacity, coach people and make ownership clear. * Build alongside the team. Own technical standards, architecture, technical and PR reviews, and release readiness. * Talk to customers regularly. Discover the real problem, test assumptions, set success metrics and use adoption data to decide what to improve or kill. * Drive engagement within products. Own rollout, activation, repeat use and recovery when a product misses its goals. * Ship at pace with careful execution. Test failure paths, challenge weak assumptions and make PR feedback useful. Do not ship poor\-quality work simply to increase output. * Govern security and AI costs: access and data boundaries, tests/evals, token attribution, budgets, alerts, context and retry limits, monitoring and recovery. * Connect each project to the company vision and measurable customer value. Scope useful follow\-on work with clients and partner with account owners on expansion. * Build reusable components and delivery playbooks that engineers actually use. **What success looks like** --------------------------- * By day 30: agree the delivery priorities, the first four systems, product engagement targets and a clear operating rhythm with Eric and customer owners. * By day 60: put technical review, security, AI\-cost controls and release checks into regular use. * By day 90: deliver four distinct production systems used by real users, with acceptance, instrumentation, support ownership and recovery plans. Demos and artificially split features do not count. * Product success: hit agreed engagement targets within a measurement window suited to each product. Review misses and recovery actions weekly. * By day 120: all six engineers independently own bounded delivery from discovery through launch and measurement, with peer review and escalation intact. * Each month: produce one useful reusable component or playbook; reach 12 by day 365\. Unused documentation does not count. **Evidence we want to see** --------------------------- * Comparable experience managing engineers while staying technically credible and actively building. * Production systems you helped ship and operate, with measurable customer adoption or business outcomes and a clear account of your contribution. * A history of promotions and increasing responsibility, supported by sustained results. Equivalent growth in scope matters too. * Daily AI\-assisted engineering and management workflows. Be ready to explain how you create, test, review and maintain AI\-written code. * Strong organization, attention to detail, customer development, product judgment and clear communication. * Examples of decisions to focus, narrow scope or stop work, and how those decisions served a larger goal. **How the process works** ------------------------- Application and evidence review, our standard five\-question AI prescreen for selected candidates, a live discussion and proof exercise based on your own work, a small paid exercise where substantial work is required, and references. Ensure a culture of data trust, scalability, and continual improvement across the BI environment. * **What You’ll Need** * 5\+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, data analytics, or a related technical field. * Deep expertise in SQL — capable of building, optimizing, and mentoring on complex query logic and data modeling. * Proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and integration workflows. * Expert\-level skills in Tableau and Excel — capable of creating dynamic dashboards, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros, and interactive visualizations. * Proven experience in data modeling for analytics — star/snowflake schemas, semantic layers, and KPI standardization. * Strong experience working with business stakeholders to define KPIs, build requirements, and deliver insights that drive measurable outcomes. * Strong understanding of data architecture principles and how BI fits into the larger data ecosystem. * Curiosity and openness to AI and automation — an eagerness to apply emerging tools to make BI faster, smarter, and more scalable. * Experience with R or Shiny is a plus. * Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling business insights. * A leadership mindset that combines technical excellence with mentoring, collaboration, and the drive to raise team capability. **Why Join Us:** * Generous paid time off * Competitive medical, dental \& vision coverage * 401K with company match for US * Company\-paid life insurance * Company\-paid short\-term and long\-term disability * Access to mental health and wellness resources * Company\-paid volunteer time to do good in your community * Legal coverage and other supplemental options * A value\-based culture where gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Perform system bring\-up, initial debugging, and optimization of radio designs. Assist in troubleshooting and resolving complex RF issues, including desensitization, spurious emissions, and basic EMI, using RF test equipment (Spectrum analyzer, VNA , Load Pull and callbox). Conduct electromagnetic (EM) simulation of PCB layout\-related issues using full\-wave simulation solvers such as CST or HFSS. jobs.title: Cybersecurity Engineer I
jobs.description: The SouthState story is one of steady growth, deep community roots, and an unwavering commitment to helping our customers move forward. Since our beginnings in the 1930s to becoming a trusted financial partner across the South and beyond \- we are known for combining personal relationships with forward\-thinking solutions. We are committed to helping our team members find their success while maintaining the integrity of our values: building trust, fostering lasting relationships and pursuing excellence. At SouthState, individual contributions are recognized, potential is cultivated and team members are inspired to achieve their greater purpose. Your future begins here! SUMMARY/OBJECTIVES The Cybersecurity Engineer (CSE) performs two core functions for the enterprise. The first is the day\-to\-day operations of the in\-place security solutions while the second is the identification, investigation, and resolution of security related events detected by those systems. A Cybersecurity Engineer is expected to have a clear understanding of security best practice and understanding of the impacts of controls and the tuning thereof. The CSE I performs day\-to\-day operational tasks to ensure the efficient operation of cybersecurity controls and platforms. This generally takes the form of response to tickets that are generated either from the system itself or as part of the Cybersecurity Operations ticket queue. The CSE I position requires initiative, accountability and ownership of tasks presented, leveraging knowledge and utilizing technical resources and other team members to drive success. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Ensures compliance with all bank policies and procedures as well as state, federal, and regulatory requirements. Be fully aware of the enterprise’s security goals as established by its stated policies, procedures, and guidelines and to actively work towards upholding those goals. System Monitoring \& Threat Management Review logs and reports of all in\-place devices, whether they be under direct control (i.e. security tools) or not (i.e. workstations, servers, network devices, etc.) and interpret the implications of that activity to provide feedback to leadership. Participate in investigations into anomalous activity. Serve as a first responder and assist with initial investigations for potential security events or control impacts. Assist in the ticket queue rotation to ensure efficient handling of requests. Participate in the cybersecurity on\-call rotation. Operational Management Maintain operational configurations of all in\-place security solutions as per the established baselines and security best practice. Participate in the design and execution of vulnerability assessments, penetration tests and security audits. Provide on\-call support for end users and all in\-place security solutions. Monitor all in\-place security solutions for efficient and appropriate operations. Acquisition \& Deployment Maintain up\-to\-date detailed knowledge of the IT security industry including awareness of new or revised security solutions, improved security processes and the development of new attacks and threat vectors. Recommend and implement additional security solutions or enhancements to existing security solutions to improve overall enterprise security. Research, evaluate, and stay current on emerging tools, techniques, and technologies. Participate in projects or department initiatives. Assist in the development and implementation of internal security projects. Perform daily management of assigned security solutions. Incident Response Serve as a member of the incident response team as needed for response to cybersecurity incidents. Participate in incident response planning and testing exercises. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. COMPETENCIES Proven analytical and problem\-solving abilities. Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high\-pressure environment. Good written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills. Ability to conduct research into security issues and products as required. Ability to present ideas in business\-friendly and user\-friendly language. Highly self\-motivated and directed. Keen attention to detail. Team\-oriented and skilled in working within a collaborative environment. QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS **Education :** Associate Degree (or equivalent work experience) from a regionally accredited institution in Information Security, computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a closely related field. **Experience :** Two (2\) or more years of direct Cybersecurity experience preferably as a cybersecurity engineer or similar role maintaining cybersecurity safeguards at a financial institution. Direct experience maintaining and operating current security platforms is preferred. **Certifications/Specific Knowledge :** One or more of the following (or similar) certifications preferred: Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Certifications (e.g., GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED), GIAC Certified Detection Analyst (GCDA)) CompTIA Certifications (e.g., Security\+, CySA\+) A strong security mindset, understanding of financial sector regulatory requirements and security best practice. Other certificates and professional credentials with cybersecurity relevance will be considered. TRAINING REQUIREMENTS/CLASSES Annual Compliance Training New Employee Orientation PHYSICAL DEMANDS Must be able to effectively access and interpret information on computer screens, documents, reports, and cash denominations, and identify customers. This position requires a large amount of time in front of a computer. This can be done sitting or standing with use of the right desk WORK ENVIRONMENT Telecommuting roles, no matter if hybrid or 100% full time telecommuting, must have a secure home office environment that is free from background noise and distractions. They must also have a reliable private internet connection that is not supplied by use of cellular data (hot spot). Cable or fiber connections are preferred. Requirements are subject to change, as new systems and technology are delivered. TRAVEL Travel may be required to come to meetings as needed. Equal Opportunity Employer, including disabled/veterans.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer Co-op

engineering recommendations. * Participate in safety initiatives and ensure designs comply with applicable standards and company requirements. * Assist with vendor communication, equipment selection, and project execution activities. * Document project results and present findings to engineering and plant leadership teams. **Required Qualifications*** Currently pursuing a Bachelor of Science degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline. * Minimum sophomore standing with eligibility to participate in a co\-op or internship program. * Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in manufacturing and industrial systems. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Excellent verbal, written, organizational, and interpersonal skills. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a manufacturing environment. * Reliable transportation to and from work. **Preferred Qualifications*** Previous engineering co\-op, internship, or hands\-on manufacturing experience. * Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or other 2D/3D CAD software. * Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T). * Familiarity with reliability jobs.title: Social Media Specialist
jobs.description: Description: Build SDC's Voice on Social Media Steven Douglas Corp. (SDC) designs, engineers, and builds custom automation machines that solve complex manufacturing challenges. We're looking for a **Social Media Specialist** to take full ownership of SDC's social media presence—from strategy and content creation through publishing, engagement, and performance analysis. This is a hands\-on role. You won't simply manage a posting calendar or execute someone else's strategy. You'll help determine what we should be talking about, create the content, publish it, engage with our audience, and continuously improve our approach. You'll manage both SDC's company accounts and the individual social accounts of key SDC leaders, helping position our company and our people as thought leaders in automation and manufacturing. Our primary platforms include LinkedIn, Instagram, and YouTube, with an active but secondary presence on Facebook. **What You'll Own** **Social Media Strategy \& Planning** * Develop and manage SDC's social media strategy and content calendar using Canva and Sprout Social. * Build platform\-specific strategies for LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Reddit. * Identify topics, trends, conversations, and opportunities relevant to our target audiences. * Develop distinct social strategies for SDC and key individual thought\-leader accounts. * Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and keep the content pipeline moving. **Social Content Creation** Own social media content from idea through publication, including: * Writing posts, captions, hooks, and social copy * Creating branded graphics, carousels, and visual content * Taking and editing photos * Capturing video on our shop floor, at events, and with our team * Creating and editing Reels, Stories, and YouTube Shorts * Editing longer\-form social video * Adding captions, graphics, music, and other video elements * Repurposing content across platforms You'll work directly with SDC team members to find interesting stories and turn technical topics into engaging social content. **Thought Leadership** Work directly with key members of SDC's leadership team to build their individual social media presence. You'll help identify ideas, interview subject\-matter experts, write posts in their individual voices, create supporting visuals and videos, and build consistent thought\-leadership strategies. The goal is to establish both SDC and the people behind SDC as trusted voices in custom automation, engineering, manufacturing, and business. **Community \& Audience Growth** * Monitor and respond to comments, messages, mentions, and relevant conversations. * Identify opportunities for SDC and our leaders to participate in industry discussions. * Build relationships with manufacturers, engineers, automation professionals, customers, prospective employees, and industry partners. * Participate authentically in relevant Reddit and social communities without turning every interaction into a sales pitch. **Analytics \& Continuous Improvement** Track performance and use the data to improve our strategy, including: * Audience and follower growth * Reach and engagement * Video views and watch time * Top\-performing topics and formats * Website traffic and inquiries generated through social * Engagement from potential customers and other high\-value audiences * Ongoing research into evolving best practices and discoverability standards across platforms and AI/search answer engines (SEO, AEO, AIO, GEO, and similar) — applied consistently to keep our content competitive We're interested in growing our audience, but quality matters more than vanity metrics. Reaching the right manufacturing decision\-makers is more valuable than generating thousands of irrelevant views. Requirements: **What We're Looking For** * Experience managing professional social media accounts. * Working knowledge of Canva and Sprout Social or similar design, management and scheduling tools. * Strong understanding of LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Reddit. * Excellent writing and storytelling skills. * Strong short\-form video creation and editing capabilities. * Experience with graphic design and social media visuals. * Comfortable taking photos and capturing video independently. * Ability to adapt content and messaging for different platforms and individual voices. * Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts and content schedules. * Understanding of social media analytics and audience growth. * Confidence working directly with company leadership and technical subject\-matter experts. * Ability to take technical information and turn it into clear, interesting content. * Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, engineering, B2B marketing, or another technical industry is a plus, but not required. **What Makes Someone Successful at SDC** Our team moves at a fast but rewarding pace. We're a privately owned company with the agility to make decisions quickly, without the layers of corporate red tape found in larger organizations. We're looking for someone who: * Works as part of a team. Collaborates, communicates, and recognizes that the best results come from working together. * Takes ownership. Sees what needs to be done, follows through, and doesn't wait to be told every next step. We trust you to organize your own tasks, stay focused, and deliver high\-quality results. This level of autonomy is a big part of what makes SDC different, and it takes real self\-discipline to thrive in it. * Moves with urgency. Can prioritize, make decisions, and keep work moving in a fast\-paced environment. * Communicates directly and respectfully. Shares ideas, asks questions, accepts feedback, and keeps others informed. * Looks for a better way. Brings new ideas, experiments with new approaches, and continuously looks for ways to improve. * Focuses on results. Understands the purpose behind the work and takes pride in delivering high\-quality results. * Is comfortable being hands\-on. At SDC, good ideas don't need to pass through layers of approval. We expect people to help turn ideas into action. **What We Offer:** At SDC, we believe in taking care of our team both professionally and personally. We provide a comprehensive benefits package, including: * Competitive pay that reflects your expertise and contributions. * Employer\-paid medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options * Paid vacation, sick leave, and 10 company\-paid holidays to support work\-life balance. * A 4% employer match to a 401(k) plan each pay period. * Generous parental leave, and a company sponsored Employee Assistance Program. jobs.title: Estimator I
jobs.description: **BUILDER WANTED. Estimator I** =============================== **Not just an Estimator. A Builder.** ------------------------------------- You build the numbers behind exceptional metalwork. You turn architectural drawings, specifications, material requirements, and project information into accurate estimates that help our team understand what it will take to fabricate and install the work right. You’re detail\-oriented, analytical, eager to learn, and interested in building your knowledge of estimating, metal fabrication, and construction. At Stewart Iron Works, we’re looking for an Estimator I who can support our estimating team with accurate quantity takeoffs, material and labor pricing, bid preparation, and the organization and follow\-through needed to move opportunities from plans to production.**A Legacy of Building Careers** -------------------------------- At Stewart Iron Works, we are continuing a long tradition of artistry in metalwork and fabrication. We believe exceptional work begins with people who share our values and take pride in what they build. We recognize that our employees are more than professionals—they’re individuals with families, passions, and full lives outside of work. That’s why we emphasize working hard while living well. Our culture is built around celebrating shared victories, supporting each other’s growth, and leaving a positive mark on our clients and community. Together, we’re not just fabricating and installing metalwork—we’re building a legacy of quality, integrity, craftsmanship, and purpose.**What You’ll Build** --------------------- As an Estimator I, you’ll work alongside experienced estimators and project teams to develop accurate, competitive estimates for metal fabrication and installation projects. You’ll build your understanding of Division 5 Metals while learning how a project moves from drawings and specifications through estimating, fabrication, and field installation. You will:* Review architectural and structural drawings, specifications, addenda, and other project documents to identify the scope of metalwork. * Perform quantity takeoffs for materials, labor, equipment, and other project requirements. * Assist in developing estimates for fabricated and installed metalwork, including carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, architectural bronze, and related materials. * Gather and organize pricing from suppliers, vendors, subcontractors, and internal resources. * Assist with evaluating material pricing, labor requirements, fabrication considerations, installation requirements, and project lead times. * Work with senior estimators to develop detailed scopes of work, cost analyses, and competitive bid proposals. * Review vendor and subcontractor quotations for scope coverage, accuracy, and alignment with project requirements. * Identify discrepancies, missing information, and potential scope gaps within drawings and specifications and work with the estimating team to resolve questions. * Coordinate with project management, fabrication, and other internal teams to understand how estimating assumptions affect production and field installation. * Maintain organized estimate files, bid documentation, supplier information, and historical cost data. * Assist with pricing design changes, additional work, and other scope revisions as needed. * Develop an understanding of metal fabrication processes, constructability, installation methods, and the factors that influence project cost. * Help maintain accurate and confidential estimating and costing information. * Participate in bid reviews, project handoffs, and other meetings as needed. * Continuously improve estimating knowledge, processes, and tools while maintaining Stewart Iron Works standards for accuracy and quality. * Perform other duties as assigned. **What You Bring** ------------------ * Associate or bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Building Construction, Drafting Technology, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may also be considered. * 0–3 years of construction estimating, metal fabrication, construction management, drafting, or related experience. Relevant internship or co\-op experience is welcomed. * Ability to read and interpret architectural drawings, structural drawings, specifications, and other construction documents. * Strong mathematical and analytical skills with an emphasis on accuracy and attention to detail. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. * Ability and willingness to learn estimating, takeoff, and construction software. * Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * Clear written and verbal communication skills. * A collaborative mindset and willingness to ask questions, learn from experienced team members, and take ownership of assigned work. **Preferred, But Not Required** ------------------------------- * Familiarity with Division 5 Metals and commercial construction. * Previous exposure to metal fabrication or installation. * Familiarity with carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, architectural bronze, or similar materials. * Experience performing material or quantity takeoffs. * Familiarity with estimating or digital takeoff software. * Experience with AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Bluebeam, or similar construction and design software. * Basic understanding of fabrication processes, labor productivity, material pricing, and construction terminology. * Knowledge of building codes, industry standards, and requirements relevant to miscellaneous and architectural metals. * Experience working with general contractors, suppliers, subcontractors, architects, engineers, or fabrication teams. **The Bottom Line** ------------------- This is an opportunity to learn the business of estimating while building the work behind some of Stewart Iron Works’ most important projects. You’ll learn how architectural and structural plans become scopes, quantities, labor hours, material orders, fabricated pieces, and ultimately finished installations. You’ll work alongside people who understand metal fabrication and construction and who can help you develop the technical and commercial judgment required to become a strong estimator. We’re not looking for someone to simply plug numbers into a spreadsheet. We’re looking for someone who is curious about **how things are built**, pays attention to the details, asks good questions, protects the integrity of the estimate, and wants to develop expertise in the craft and business of metalwork. If that sounds like you, let’s build something that lasts.**Work Environment \& Physical Requirements** --------------------------------------------- This position primarily works in an office environment but may also require visits to fabrication facilities, jobsites, and other active construction environments. Employees must comply with Stewart Iron Works safety policies, procedures, and all applicable safety requirements. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.* Regularly: sit, stand, walk, communicate, and use a computer and other standard office equipment. * Occasionally: visit fabrication and construction environments where appropriate personal protective equipment may be required. * Occasionally: lift, carry, and/or move materials or objects associated with normal office, fabrication, or jobsite activities. **Huseman Group is an EOE/M/F/D/V \- Alcohol\- and Drug\-Free Workplace****Huseman Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains an Alcohol\- and Drug\-Free Workplace.** We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, or any other status protected by law.

jobs.description: Determined, imaginative, curious—if these are some of the ways you describe yourself, we want to learn more about you! **At TC Energy, we are proud to connect the world to the energy it needs.** Guided by our values of safety in every step, personal accountability, one team and active learning, we deliver the critical energy that North America and the world rely on while balancing reliability, affordability and sustainability. **The Opportunity** Our Network Operations team manages a large\-scale network spanning the United States, Canada, and Mexico, supporting data center, field, campus, and operational technology (OT) environments critical to safe and reliable pipeline operations. We are seeking a Network Engineer to serve as the primary on\-site network resource for TC Energy's Houston facilities. This role provides physical presence and hands\-on support across two data centers, one corporate office, and a Gas Control work recovery center. The successful candidate will perform day\-to\-day network engineering duties while developing into the team's subject matter expert for Versa SD\-WAN. This role combines traditional network engineering responsibilities with a strong site\-technician function — you are the hands and feet for Houston when remote resolution isn't possible. You will work closely with our Network Operations Center (NOC) in Canada, receiving escalations that require local physical intervention, while also contributing to network projects, maintenance, and SD\-WAN evolution across the broader enterprise. **What you'll do** * Serve as the primary on\-site resource for all Houston network facilities (two data centers, corporate office, and Gas Control work recovery center) * Respond to hardware failures, outages, and escalations requiring physical intervention * Perform rack\-and\-stack activities for network equipment installations and replacements * Execute cable management, patching, and physical layer troubleshooting * Process hardware RMA returns and coordinate replacements with vendors * Provide console access for device recovery when remote management is unavailable * Escort vendors and contractors requiring access to network infrastructure * Maintain accurate physical documentation of network environments (rack elevations, cable records, port mappings) * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco routers and switches across data center, campus, and WAN environments * Support and develop expertise in Versa SD\-WAN platform administration, configuration, and troubleshooting * Monitor network health and performance using SolarWinds Orion and respond to alerts * Maintain network documentation and asset records in Netbox * Support Sierra modem deployments and troubleshooting for remote connectivity * Participate in network change management activities including maintenance windows * Troubleshoot and resolve network incidents escalated from the NOC * Support OT/SCADA network infrastructure on an as\-needed basis when escalated * Work with the NOC team (Canada\-based) to receive and action escalations requiring Houston physical presence * Collaborate with corporate network teams, server/infrastructure teams, and facilities management * Coordinate with Gas Control operations staff regarding work recovery center network readiness * Develop deep expertise in Versa SD\-WAN with the goal of becoming the team's subject matter expert * Contribute to standard operating procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base documentation * Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to root cause analysis **Minimum Qualifications** * Minimum 4 years of experience in network engineering or network operations * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or related field * A combination of education, certifications and experience may be considered **Preferred Qualifications** * Strong hands\-on experience with Cisco routing and switching (campus, data center, and WAN) * Solid understanding of network fundamentals: TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, VLANs, spanning tree, QoS * Experience with network monitoring and management platforms (e.g., SolarWinds) * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex network issues across L1–L3 * Experience performing physical network tasks: rack\-and\-stack, cabling, hardware replacement * Familiarity with SD\-WAN concepts and architectures * Strong documentation habits and attention to detail * Ability to work independently with minimal supervision at remote sites * Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) or equivalent * Versa SD\-WAN experience or certification (VNSP or similar) * Experience with Netbox or similar IPAM/DCIM tools * Exposure to OT/SCADA network environments * Experience supporting data center network infrastructure * Experience with cellular/modem\-based connectivity (Sierra Wireless or similar) * Familiarity with ITIL processes (incident, change, problem management) * Experience with network automation or scripting (Python, Ansible) * Prior experience in energy, utilities, or pipeline operations environments ***This position requires candidates to:*** * Participate in rotating on\-call schedule for after\-hours network support * Occasional after\-hours or weekend work for critical infrastructure events outside the regular on\-call rotation (infrequent; estimated 1–2 occurrences per year) * Lift and carry network equipment weighing up to 50 lbs * Stand, walk, bend, and kneel for extended periods during physical site work * Work at heights using ladders for overhead cabling and equipment installation * Work in data center environments with controlled temperature, elevated noise levels, and confined spaces * Perform repetitive tasks such as terminating cables and mounting equipment in racks To remain competitive, support our high\-performance jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Job Summary : The Data Engineer is a hands \- on technical role at the delivery core of TDIndustries' data platform build \- out. This is not a support or maintenance role \- it is an engineering role with direct accountability for building the data pipelines, lakehouse architecture, and data products that the business depends on for decisions, analytics, and AI capabilities. The right candidate brings deep, practical expertise in Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, and dbt, and applies that expertise to design and deliver pipelines and data products that are performant, well \- governed, and built to last. They understand how to translate architecture from blueprint to production, write code that others can maintain, and build frameworks and standards that make the team faster over time. They are curious about where data engineering is heading \- particularly the intersection of data pipelines and AI \- driven workloads \- and bring that curiosity back to the team in practical ways. This is a Mid \- Senior Individual Contributor (Hands \- On) role that works closely with the Sr. Solution Architect and Data Product Managers, contributing meaningfully to architectural decisions while owning engineering execution. It is the right role for someone who wants to grow into a technical lead and eventually take ownership of the data engineering capability as the DAI function scales. Essential Duties: Data Pipeline Engineering \& Delivery * Design, build, and maintain production \- grade data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data across the medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold) on Snowflake and Microsoft Fabric. * Implement ELT/ETL patterns using dbt as the primary transformation layer, writing modular, tested, well \- documented models that serve as the foundation for data products. * Develop and maintain data pipelines supporting batch, micro \- batch, and streaming ingestion across enterprise source systems \- including Dynamics 365, Procore, Workday, IoT, and field operations platforms. * Translate solution architectures designed by the Sr. Solution Architect into engineered, production \- ready implementations \- bridging the gap between architecture intent and delivery reality. * Own pipeline reliability \- monitor, alert on, and remediate data pipeline failures proactively, ensuring data products meet their SLAs. Lakehouse Architecture \& Data Modeling * Build and maintain data models within the lakehouse platform, applying Kimball dimensional modeling, Data Vault, or OBT patterns as appropriate for the use case and consumption layer. * Implement and enforce medallion architecture standards across the data platform, ensuring Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers are clearly defined, properly governed, and fit \- for \- purpose. * Develop reusable data assets \- conformed dimensions, shared fact tables, and domain \- specific data products \- that serve multiple analytics and AI consumers without duplication. * Contribute to data product design, providing engineering input on schema, SLAs, lineage, and consumption interfaces alongside Data Product Managers and the Solution Architect. Standards, Frameworks \& Engineering Excellence * Build and maintain reusable engineering frameworks, templates, and patterns \- for pipeline design, dbt project structure, testing strategy, and deployment \- that bring standardization and speed to the team's delivery cadence. * Define and enforce data engineering best practices: code review standards, branching strategies, testing requirements, documentation expectations, and deployment patterns. * Establish and maintain data quality tests within dbt and the broader pipeline stack, ensuring data products are validated before they reach analytics and AI consumers. * Contribute to architecture decision records (ADRs) and technical documentation that build institutional knowledge and enable the team to scale without key \- person dependency. Data \- Driven AI Pipeline Support * Build and maintain data pipelines that support AI and ML workloads \- including feature engineering pipelines, embedding generation pipelines, and data feeds for RAG architectures on Snowflake Cortex. * Stay current with the evolving intersection of data engineering and AI \- driven platforms \- Snowflake Cortex, Microsoft Fabric's AI capabilities, dbt Semantic Layer \- and bring grounded, practical recommendations to the team. * Evaluate emerging tools and patterns as the data \- driven AI landscape evolves, recommending best \- in \- class options based on fit with TD's platform and requirements rather than novelty. Team Capability \& Mentorship * Guide and upskill team members on Snowflake \- based data engineering \- sharing knowledge on performance optimization, data modeling patterns, cost management, and pipeline design. * Actively participate in design and code reviews, providing constructive, evidence \- based feedback that raises the technical quality of the team's output. * Contribute to  eering experience, with demonstrated depth in Snowflake and modern ELT/ETL practices \- this is a firm floor;
