jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer II (Data Pipelines)
jobs.description: **The Role** As a Senior Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the development, optimization, and automation of our data pipelines. You will lead complex data projects, architect technical initiatives, and ensure the scalability and performance of our data solutions. Your role will involve strategic planning, collaboration with senior management, and mentoring other engineers. You will be responsible for pushing the delivery speed and quality of our data ELT, leading the implementation of innovative tooling and architecture patterns, and fostering a culture of data engineering excellence. At Wpromote, we're developing something special called Polaris, a modern data and marketing intelligence platform that gives our clients a serious edge over their competition. Polaris enables and empowers our marketing teams to work together seamlessly, using a comprehensive marketing data foundation with apps that deliver new insights and performance gains for our clients. Polaris also gives Wpromote an operational edge, doubling as our company CRM and integrated source of truth for operations data, making our lives easier and our decisions smarter. We offer: * Unlimited PTO * Extended Holiday break (Winter) * 100% paid parental leave * 401(k) matching * Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance * Sponsored life insurance * Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance * Annual Class Pass credits and more! The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $155,000 \- $180,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third\-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits (listed above). This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions \*\*While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles, Chicago, and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person! \*\*\*This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship *Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams* Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity. \#LI\-SD \#LI\-Remote ### **You Will Be** * Acting as a technical leader and Subject Matter Expert (SME) in data pipeline automation and workflow orchestration. * Designing, implementing, and maintaining complex, reliable, data solutions with a focus on automation using Airflow, dbt, and Google Cloud data products. * Managing a large portfolio of dbt models, leveraging macros and DRY patterns. * Advocating for test\-driven development and assisting QA in developing a robust and reliable process for continuous integration and delivery. * Monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimizing the performance of data pipelines and workflows. * Architecting solutions and reusable patterns that scale with business needs. * Providing implementation, configuration, and deployment documentation. * Proactively addressing issues and problems, generating and implementing innovative solutions. * Participating in all agile ceremonies, including daily standups and regular sprint planning. * Mentoring other engineers and fostering a culture of technical excellence. * Staying up\-to\-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to drive continuous improvement and innovation in data engineering practices. * Ensuring data security, governance, and compliance with relevant standards and privacy restrictions. ### **You Must Have** * Minimum 7\+ years of experience in software development, with extensive experience in Python, SQL, and data pipelines. * Expertise in building and automating ETL/ELT pipelines using Airflow and DAG\-based workflow management software. Airbyte for data ingestion is a plus, but not required. * Deep experience managing dbt models using macros and dbt tests. Mastery of Python or comparable scripting language, API integrations, and software architecture. * Deep experience with databases like PostgreSQL and BigQuery, including query optimization for performance and cost. * Good understanding of business intelligence tools like Looker or comparable alternatives. Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, and managing infrastructure as code using Terraform. * Proficiency with advanced data formats (Parquet, Avro, Hive, JSONL) and data integration techniques. * Experience with monitoring and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus. * Familiarity with version control systems and CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions. * Strong command of agile methodologies, continuous integration, and test\-driven development. * Exceptional problem\-solving skills and technical leadership. * Ability to influence and guide cross\-functional teams and projects. jobs.title: Principal Software Development Engineer, Full Stack
jobs.description: **About the team** ------------------ The Data Engineering \& Enterprise Tools team powers Zillow Rentals by delivering mission\-critical analytics tools, AI enablement solutions, and high fidelity data products. We partner closely with Product, Senior Leadership, Data Science, Sales, Operations, and other business groups to turn complex workflows and data into scalable, intuitive, and reliable capabilities. Our work connects the systems and experiences that enable teams across Zillow Rentals to make effective daily decisions. We are evolving a durable internal\-tooling ecosystem: reducing fragmentation, strengthening shared foundations, and enabling new business capabilities through thoughtful architecture and technical leadership. **About the role** ------------------ As a Principal Software Development Engineer, you will be the technical leader for a critical area of Zillow Rentals' internal tooling and data\-product ecosystem. You will deliver high\-impact business value by identifying and solving complex problems that span teams, systems, and stakeholder groups. This is a leadership\-first individual contributor role. You will set technical direction, shape cross\-team architecture, and influence how teams build, operate, and evolve internal products. You will partner with engineering and business leaders to translate ambiguous opportunities into durable strategies, foundational capabilities, and sequenced investments that advance Zillow Rentals' longer\-term goals through world class internal tools. **You will get to** ------------------- * Architect and drive the end\-to\-end design of complex, high\-scale web applications and services, spanning modern user interfaces, APIs, data stores, and cloud infrastructure. * Lead technical direction and decision\-making for multi\-team initiatives, establishing engineering standards and best practices for full\-stack development, testing, and operations. * Collaborate with product management, UX, and cross\-functional partners to translate business objectives into actionable engineering plans and technical roadmaps. * Mentor and coach senior and staff engineers, fostering a culture of learning, inclusion, and technical excellence across teams. * Guide technical reviews and design forums, providing clear feedback on architecture, implementation approaches, and risk mitigation for critical projects. * Anticipate and resolve systemic technical challenges, making high\-impact decisions on service boundaries, data models, and integration strategies. * Champion engineering excellence in code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and incident response. * Evaluate and introduce new technologies, frameworks, and architectures that improve developer experience, scalability, and operational excellence. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.\&\#xa;\&\#xa;In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $181,800\.00 \- $290,400\.00 annually. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together. *Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.* *Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.* *Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. workflows across multiple systems and services. * Experience with automation frameworks (e.g., Python, Playwright, Selenium, or similar). * Ability to debug issues by analyzing logs, database states, and API responses. * Experience testing data pipelines, integrations, and service orchestration. * Experience working within Agile development environments. **Your Background** ------------------- * jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Maps Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Zipline** Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products. Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations. Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe. We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real\-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds. ### **Why this role matters** We're building the mapping infrastructure that powers every Zipline flight. Maps Platform engineers build the backbone that serves geographic data, features, and map\-driven services to Zipline's products and operators. You'll make map data fast, accurate, and reliable for both human workflows (map editors, operator dashboards, regulatory UIs) and autonomous systems (routing, onboard systems). This role mixes backend, data, platform engineering and user interface design with pragmatic production ownership. ### **Why this role is unique** * Own the foundation of flight intelligence. The systems you build directly power how aircraft understand and navigate the world. Massive data challenges. You'll design pipelines that process and serve large\-scale geospatial datasets with strict requirements for accuracy, consistency, and availability. * End\-to\-end ownership. From raw data ingestion to production services, you'll build systems that are critical to real\-world operations. * Cross\-functional impact. Your work will be used across autonomy, routing, simulation, and operations. * * AI\-accelerated engineering. We leverage modern AI and agentic workflows to increase engineering velocity while maintaining strong system rigor. ### **What you'll bring** We care far more about how you approach problems than experience with any specific technology. Strong candidates typically have: Experience building and operating large\-scale data pipelines * A track record shipping reliable services and APIs * Extreme ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects end\-to\-end * Experience working with large datasets and designing reliable data processing logic * Familiarity with data modeling, data quality, and validation in production systems * Comfort working with cross\-functional teams and integrating systems across domains * * Strong backend or distributed systems engineering fundamentals Experience with geospatial systems, mapping technologies, or GIS tooling is a plus, but not required. Our current stack includes technologies such as Go, Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS, Kafka, and AWS, but we value engineers who can learn quickly and focus on solving the right problems. We also lean heavily into AI\-assisted engineering workflows and expect engineers to use modern tools to amplify productivity while maintaining high standards for system design and data quality. **What Else You Need To Know** ------------------------------ The starting cash ranges for this role is $160,000 \- $250,000\. Please note that this is a target, starting cash range for a candidate who meets the minimum qualifications for this role. The final cash pay for this role will depend on a variety of factors, including a specific candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, working location, and projected impact. The total compensation package for this role may also include: equity compensation; discretionary annual or performance bonuses; sales incentives; benefits such as medical, dental and vision insurance; paid time off; and more. This position may be hired at one of three levels based on the candidate's experience, skills, and demonstrated scope: * Software Engineer II: $160,000 \- $190,000 * Senior Software Engineer: $190,000 \- $220,000 * Staff Software Engineer: $220,000 \- $250,000 Zipline is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws or our own sensibilities. We value diversity at Zipline and welcome applications from those who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. If you like the sound of this position but are not sure if you are the perfect fit, please apply! ### **Voluntary Self\-Identification** For government reporting purposes, we ask candidates to respond to the below self\-identification survey. Completion of the form is entirely voluntary. Whatever your decision, it will not be considered in the hiring process or thereafter. Any information that you do provide will be recorded and maintained in a confidential file. As set forth in Zipline 's Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

Every year, our platform helps optimize hundreds of millions of customer journeys, ensuring businesses can confidently deliver exceptional experiences at scale. As enterprises race to deploy agentic AI, the defining question is no longer whether AI can handle customer interactions, it’s whether those interactions can be trusted. Cyara is the confidence layer that answers that question, testing AI agents with AI agents to detect hallucinations, validate decisions, and ensure compliance before failures ever reach your customers. Joining Cyara means helping shape the future of customer experience, partnering with some of the world’s biggest brands, and working alongside passionate, talented people who are committed to making every customer interaction better.### **The Role** Cyara is the assurance layer that makes enterprise AI investment defensible. Our customers are deploying AI agents into contact centers that handle millions of conversations, and they need proof those agents behave the way they promised the board they would. AI Trust and the Cyara Agentic Platform are how they get it. You own the marketing for a specific set of product lines. Bring back what buyers say, not what we wish they said. * **Competitive positioning.** Track the vendors showing up in our deals — pure\-play AI evaluation tools, CCaaS\-native testing, and manual QA teams — and give sellers a straight answer on where Cyara wins and where it does not. * **Sales enablement.** Build the pitch, the discovery questions, the objection handling, and the demo narrative. Sit in on calls and fix what is not landing. * **Content that carries technical weight.** Solution briefs, analyst submissions, webinars, launch blogs, and conference sessions on agentic AI assurance, LLM risk, and AI governance in CX. * **Cross\-functional partnership.** Work daily with Product, Sales, Demand Gen, and Customer Success. Product marketing at Cyara is the connective tissue between what engineering builds and what a seller says on a call. * This will be an individual contributor (IC) role to start with and grow into leading a team as we scale. ### **What we are looking for** **Required** * 10\+ years in B2B SaaS and AI product marketing, with at least 2 years at senior or lead level owning a product portfolio independently. * A track record of shipping launches that moved pipeline and bookings, with the numbers to show it. * Writing and presentations that stands on its own. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Gravitee** is a **2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader**, on a mission to **govern the world’s intelligence**. We deliver the industry’s most advanced platform for **Any API, Any Event, and Any AI Agent**, trusted by global leaders like Michelin, Roche, and Blue Yonder. **Why join us?** * **The Mission**: We are the first to bridge traditional API Management with the new frontier of **AI Agent Security** * **The Momentum**: A high\-growth Leader \- combining market credibility with startup speed * **The DNA**: We hire people who *Hold Nothing Back* \- passionate builders who want to redefine digital infrastructure *Don’t just watch the AI revolution. Build the infrastructure that controls and secures it.* ### **The Role** We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build product experiences and the APIs behind them. You will turn operational data into clear visualizations and help customers configure and govern APIs and AI agents. As Gravitee expands its AI Agent Management capabilities, you will help build interfaces for configuring AI Gateways, governing MCP and agent\-to\-agent interactions, discovering tools and agents, and monitoring how agentic systems behave in production. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role for an engineer who is comfortable moving between frontend experiences, backend APIs, data models, and technical design. **What You Will Be Doing** ========================== **In this role, you will:** * Design and deliver features end to end, from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, release, and iteration. * Build clear, responsive interfaces and data visualizations using TypeScript and Angular. * Design and develop Java\-based APIs and services that support those product experiences. * Contribute where needed to Gravitee's core gateway runtime, applying asynchronous and non\-blocking design patterns to performance\-sensitive code. * Help customers configure and observe Gravitee’s AI\-related capabilities, including AI Gateways, MCP tools and servers, agent identity, and agent\-to\-agent interactions. * Model and transform operational data so that complex platform behavior becomes understandable and actionable. * Contribute to both Gravitee’s open\-source platform and Enterprise Edition. * Use LLMs and AI\-assisted development tools thoughtfully for prototyping, implementation, testing, debugging, and exploration. * Apply sound engineering judgment to validate AI\-generated work and maintain high standards for correctness, security, maintainability, and performance. * Write meaningful automated tests and contribute to reliable delivery practices. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, and technical leaders to discover effective solutions and improve them through code and design reviews. * Share what you learn and help the team make practical choices as technologies and protocols evolve. **Essential Skills** ==================== We are looking for evidence that you can succeed in the role, whether gained through employment, open\-source work, or equivalent practical experience: * Significant experience building and operating full\-stack applications in a production environment; typically five or more years for this level. * Strong Java experience and experience designing maintainable REST APIs and backend services. * Strong TypeScript and modern frontend development experience using a component\-based framework. * Experience building data\-rich user interfaces and visualizations, including transforming complex data into clear customer\-facing insights. * A solid understanding of API design, data modeling, distributed systems, and asynchronous workflows. * Experience with automated testing, Git\-based development, code review, and iterative product delivery. * Experience working with persistent data stores such as MongoDB or relational databases, and with search or analytics technologies such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs or AI coding assistants as part of an engineering workflow, combined with the judgment to review and improve their output. * Clear communication, collaborative problem\-solving, and the ability to take an ambiguous problem through to production. **Desired Skills** ================== You do not need to match every item. We would be especially interested in experience with: * Angular or another modern component\-based frontend framework. * Asynchronous and non\-blocking Java development using Vert.x, RxJava, Netty, or comparable reactive technologies. * Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native application delivery. * API management, API gateways, OpenAPI, or event\-streaming platforms such as Kafka. * API security and identity standards such as OAuth 2\.0 and OpenID Connect. * Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agent2Agent (A2A), tool calling, LLM proxies, or other emerging AI protocols and standards. Prior production experience is not required. * Building or operating LLM\-powered applications, RAG systems, or agentic workflows \- especially their security, governance, and observability needs. * Open\-source software or enterprise developer platforms. **Who Thrives at Gravitee** =========================== Our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, professionalism to how they work, and a commitment to doing things well. You will thrive here if you: * Bring energy and a constructive attitude to the team. * Adapt quickly and enjoy learning unfamiliar technologies and domains. * Take ownership, communicate clearly, and follow through with urgency. * Balance delivery speed with thoughtful engineering judgment. * Start with the customer problem and care about the quality of the experience you create. * Enjoy working in a fast\-moving, collaborative, international environment. **Life at Gravitee** ==================== At Gravitee, we invest in humans, not just roles. You’ll get: * Salary of $160,000 * Competitive medical coverage. * Pension / 401(k) program options. * Stock options \- you build it, you own it. * 25 days of holiday plus in\-country national holidays. * Three mental health days and a wellness allowance. * Your birthday off. * A professional development budget to support your growth. * A hybrid work culture with hubs across regions. * Quarterly team events and an annual company offsite. * A collaborative, international company culture. * Opportunities to grow your scope and career as Gravitee grows. At Gravitee, we believe diverse perspectives make better products and stronger teams. No employee or applicant will be treated less favorably on the grounds of sex, marital status, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy or maternity, marital or civil partner status, religion, or belief. By applying, you consent to Gravitee storing and processing the personal information you submit as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Platforms
jobs.description: Core team $200K \- $280K/yr compensation **Required Skills** ------------------- Python Typescript Coding Agents React Outcome\-driven Approach ### **About micro1** micro1 is the leading AI data lab for training frontier models and evaluating AI agents. Experts contribute their diverse subject matter knowledge across domains such as finance, healthcare, STEM engineering, and more. micro1 transforms that real\-world expertise into high\-quality training data, evaluations, and feedback loops that improve how AI systems learn, reason, and perform. Our platform identifies and vets top talent through an AI recruiter, enabling high\-quality expert contributions at scale. We aim to enable 1 billion people to do meaningful work by applying their expertise to AI. As our global expert network grows, micro1 is building the human intelligence layer for frontier AI. **Job Title:** Software Engineer, Data Platforms **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location**: Remote **The Role** This is an AI\-native fullstack engineering role building micro1's human data platforms. You'll own features end\-to\-end, from backend services and data pipelines to the frontends our experts use every day. The role sits between traditional fullstack and research engineering. Coding agents are your primary development workflow, and you'll work closely with research engineers, operations, and product to turn requirements into reliable production systems. **What You'll Own** * Design and ship fullstack features across backend APIs, data pipelines, and React frontends. * Own client\-facing data delivery and platform infrastructure, including exports, access control, and reliability. * Scope work around outcomes, direct coding agents—often in parallel—review changes at the architecture level, and iterate until shipped. * Build and maintain services in Python (FastAPI) and TypeScript. * Contribute to data modeling, schema design, and query performance across relational and document databases. * Partner with research engineering, operations, and product to translate platform needs into production\-ready systems. * Improve the frameworks, checks, and evals that make agent\-driven development faster without sacrificing quality. * Troubleshoot production issues and build resilient, observable systems. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 0–5 years of software engineering experience, or strong shipped projects as a recent graduate. * Strong fundamentals in Python and TypeScript, with experience building CRUD applications using frameworks such as FastAPI/Flask and React. * Working knowledge of databases such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or SQLite and core data modeling principles. * Experience deploying services on a major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure). * Coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex are your default development workflow, and you can clearly explain how you use them. * Ability to turn outcomes into plans, direct agents, verify results, and identify architectural issues agents may miss. * Understanding of agent loops, MCP, tool/data integrations, permissions, and security. * Familiarity with context management, RAG, and evals for testing agent workflows. **Preferred** * Exposure to RL concepts or environments, including tasks, actions, and rewards. * Experience with coding data pipelines or task\-authoring platforms. * Familiarity with CI/CD, deployment pipelines, and DevOps fundamentals. * Experience contributing to team projects, open\-source software, or startups. The national pay range for this full\-time position is a base salary of $120,000 \- $160,000 per year. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance\-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health\-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high\-performing, remote\-first workforce. micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Principal Client Engineer (US)
jobs.description: **Principal Client Engineer (US)** ---------------------------------- ### **Join nPlan — build the cities of the future** **We’re nPlan, a Series B startup backed by leading investors, including GV (formerly Google Ventures) and DeepMind’s founder, Sir Demis Hassabis. Our technology helps the world’s biggest construction projects make faster, more confident, data\-driven decisions.** **By combining one of the world’s largest datasets of project plans with advanced machine learning, we forecast project outcomes and reduce risk — reshaping how infrastructure gets built.** ### **The Role** **We are looking for a Principal Client Engineer with deep expertise in project controls, risk analysis and complex construction schedules of major projects to join and help shape our growing client team. You'll be one of the most senior technical voices our clients interact with, and a go\-to point of judgement for the team's toughest schedule and risk problems. You will also have (personal or professional) exposure to generative AI, and have a strong interest in this space.** **In this role, you'll use your expertise to help our clients maximise the value they get from nPlan, help develop the people around you, and be part of the change to revolutionise the industry. If you've ever been frustrated by the limitations of QSRA workshops, poor forecasting data, or limited time for analysis, this could be the job for you.** **You'll have autonomy, ownership, and trust from day one, and you'll be working with talented people who care deeply about our mission.** **While you work remotely, you will also attend monthly client visits and team meetings in our London office as well as have the opportunity to visit our international clients.** **About The Role** **You'll work cross\-functionally across multiple areas, using your domain expertise and seniority to have a real, tangible impact:** **Client engagement** * **Acting as the senior trusted advisor to our most strategically important clients, including at senior stakeholder level, on how they maximise the value they get from nPlan.** * **Owning and growing our most complex or highest\-value client relationships, and acting as an escalation point across the wider client portfolio when things get technically or politically tricky.** * **Defining how the product should be configured to bring maximum value for our most complex clients, and setting the standard other client engineers follow.** **Product deployment** * **Owning strategic projects end\-to\-end that improve how we embed our products within client organisations, including projects that span multiple clients or accounts.** * **Setting the approach for how clients adopt our advanced features (e.g. LLM\-based features), and mentoring clients directly on the most complex use cases.** **Commercial** * **Partnering with Commercial leadership to shape strategy for engagement, retention, and expansion, not just executing on it.** **Product** * **Acting as a senior domain\-expert voice with Product Managers and AI Engineers, shaping prototyping direction rather than just contributing to it.** * **Owning the domain\-expert function within our LLM evaluation cycle, setting the standard for what "reliable and accurate" means and improving the process itself.** **What We're Looking For** **We're excited to hear from people who bring expertise, authority, and curiosity.** **To succeed in this role, you'll bring:** * **7\+ years of experience in a planning, risk, PMO, or project management role on major construction projects, including a track record of owning the trickiest schedule risk problems end\-to\-end.** * **Deep understanding of large construction schedules (P6\), how they are built, and how to analyse them.** * **Demonstrable experience leading and delivering strategic projects that significantly improve an important outcome for an organisation, with the credibility to influence senior client stakeholders directly.** * **Experience mentoring or upskilling other planning, risk or project controls professionals.** * **Passion for implementing technology to improve the construction industry.** * **Attention to detail \- please mention the word 'crane' in your application form.** * **Excellent relationship\-building skills: You care deeply about delighting customers.** **Nice to haves:** * **Experience working in a software company or on the implementation of software in the construction context** * **Experience working with LLM applications** * **Experience shaping how a team's methodology or ways of working evolve, or feeding client insight back into product direction** ### **Why You’ll Love Working Here** * **Competitive salary between $110k \- $140k \+ generous equity — when nPlan succeeds, so do you.** * **Flexible hours, remote\-friendly, with a Shoreditch office HQ.** * **Uncapped holiday, private medical insurance, personal learning and development budget, enhanced family and sick leave, and more.** * **Room to grow — we’re just over 50 people and scaling fast.** * **Guided by our values: Learn from Everything. Be Radically Truthful. Aim High, Run Fast.** * **Listen to interviews with our team** **here****, to hear how they found the move from construction to tech** ### **Our Culture** **We’re a curious, diverse, and mission\-driven team united by a belief that better data can change how the world builds.** **We value openness, honesty, and diversity of thought — and believe the best ideas win, no matter where they come from.** **Expect openness, collaboration, and balance — plus plenty of socials!** ### **Application Process** * **Once you’ve applied, you will hear from us within a week.** * **Interview stages typically include:** + **A 30\-minute intro chat** + **A role\-specific interview or assignment** + **An interview focusing on our culture and values** + **A final stage to test collaboration with our team (on\-site or remote)** * **We aim to complete the process within 3–4 weeks, but can move faster if necessary (just let us know).** **We want every candidate to have a positive experience — and we’ll keep you informed every step of the way.** ### **Accessibility \& Inclusion** **We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds.** **If you need adjustments during the hiring process, please let us know.**

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer, Ads
jobs.description: Reddit is a community of communities. It's built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000\+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet's largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com. **Team Description** The Brand Ad Formats team drives the development of ad formats that help advertisers maximize reach and brand impact. They focus on high\-visibility, awareness\-driven solutions that create memorable experiences for Reddit users. By delivering guaranteed placements and engaging ad interactions, they support major brand initiatives and help advertisers achieve measurable outcomes. The team is building fully customizable interactive formats and AI\-driven ads that incorporate User\-Generated Content (UGC). Moving forward, we will be doubling down on Video Ads, with the goal of turning Reddit into an industry leader and a 'must buy' for advertisers to promote video content. **Role Description** The Brand Ad Formats team is seeking a skilled Frontend engineer with a product\-focused mindset to join the team. **Responsibilities:** * Build Ad experiences and create patterns for Reddit's web app that enhance our ads' performance and functionality. * Collaborate across product, design, and engineering teams to innovate and implement sophisticated solutions for complex challenges. * Engage in the full development cycle: design, develop, QA, experiment, analyze, and deploy. **Required Qualifications:** * 3\+ years of experience in Web Engineering * Proficient in Typescript and Javascript * A willingness to tackle the challenges of creating data\-intensive, highly responsive, and fault\-tolerant apps * Experience with automated testing best practices, code quality / design patterns, observability, etc. * Skilled at performing insightful code reviews, and receiving feedback themself * Experience leveraging GenAI tools to increase software engineering productivity * Excellent communication skills: able to collaborate with teams in a fully remote environment, and discuss complex topics with technical and non\-technical audiences **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience working on ad tech * Experience working on consumer facing sites (high production value at scale) **Technologies used on the team include:** * Languages: Typescript, HTML, CSS, Go * Frameworks: React, Thrift, gRPC * Tools: Kubernetes, Docker, Codex, Cursor In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment\-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors. *Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.*

jobs.title: Head of Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote: United States **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- FinanceFinanceBusiness Operations **Compensation** ---------------- * $222K – $272K • Offers Equity *Our openings span more than one career level. The provided salary depends on many factors, such as work experience and transferable skills, business needs and impact, location, and market demands.* At Render, we’re building the modern cloud platform for developers creating AI\-native, full\-stack, multi\-service applications. Our mission is to eliminate the tradeoff between the power of hyperscalers and the simplicity of developer\-friendly platforms—so teams can ship fast, scale reliably, and focus on their product, not infrastructure. Unlike complex hyperscalers or ephemeral edge/serverless solutions, Render offers a developer\-first experience with persistent compute, dynamic autoscaling, built\-in orchestration, and observability, allowing teams to launch, scale, and manage real\-world applications without writing infrastructure code or managing servers. Whether you're building LLM\-powered applications, scalable SaaS products, or async processing pipelines, Render empowers teams to move fast and scale confidently from MVP to millions of users. Our platform is trusted by over 7 million developers worldwide and continues to grow rapidly. In February 2026, we raised an additional $100M in Series C financing, bringing our total funding to $260M, to accelerate our vision of making cloud infrastructure both powerful and intuitive—designed for the speed of modern AI development. We’re a diverse and talented team that values craft, velocity, and user experience. If you’re excited to help shape the future of the intelligent cloud and empower developers everywhere, we’d love to hear from you. **Applying to Render** ---------------------- We're seeking candidates who possess high integrity, humility, and an insatiable drive to learn. Through reasoned discussions and continuous feedback, we strive to improve both individually and collectively. We foster an environment of mutual trust and respect, empowering effective debate to achieve the best outcomes for our customers and team. We especially encourage members of underrepresented groups in the tech community to apply and understand that not all successful candidates will meet each requirement listed. Our interview process is unique to each role, and we value the candidate experience just as much as our customer experience. We hope your conversations with us reflect a thoughtful process that is illuminative, enjoyable, and respectful of your time. **About the Role** ------------------ The Head of Strategic Partnerships \& Ecosystem will manage and grow Render's most critical technology partner relationships. This role involves building and executing a comprehensive partnerships strategy — spanning AI ecosystem integrations, hyperscalers and early bets on emerging platforms — that drives meaningful distribution and growth for Render. These partnerships touch nearly every part of Render — Product, Engineering, DevRel, and Business Development — and often involve senior stakeholders at some of the largest and fastest\-moving companies in AI, so doing this well means coordinating closely across those internal teams and keeping Render's leadership regularly informed. The ideal candidate brings real technical depth in AI and developer tooling, paired with a proven background in partner management, strong relationship\-building instincts, and the executive presence to engage with partner leadership at the highest levels. You should have a deep understanding of how to build and scale product\-centric partnerships — from ecosystem integrations to platform\-level bets — in a fast\-moving, technical market. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Map Render's technology partnership landscape across AI labs, hyperscalers, and emerging developer products, and build the strategy for where Render has the strongest right to win. * Own outcomes for the partnerships portfolio — set clear milestones, timelines, and success metrics (e.g., ecosystem integration, developer adoption, joint launches, revenue impact) and hold yourself accountable to them. * Drive day\-to\-day partnership strategy and execution, taking deals from evaluation through negotiation, launch, and renewal, including commercial terms. * Partner closely with Product, DevRel, and Product Marketing to secure roadmap and staffing commitments, drive integration execution, and run co\-marketing — and work with Finance and Legal to structure and manage commercial agreements. * Scope and lead our thinking on building out a Render Marketplace — including the value proposition to customers and key partners, product and engineering requirements, and commercial and financial terms. * Own ongoing relationship management for key partners — acting as their primar siness reviews and planning sessions, driving expansion and renewal over time, and serving as their internal advocate at Render. * Bring operating rigor to the program: track and report on partnership performance, maintain clear documentation, and keep leadership updated on progress and upcoming launches. * Build out a team of partner managers as we scale. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 6–10\+ years of experience in strategic or technical partnerships, business development, or product\-facing roles at technology companies — ideally where partnerships were critical during a period of hypergrowth. * A highly technical background is strongly preferred — former PM, forward\-deployed engineer, or engineering experience, particularly within AI — so you can go deep with partner engineering and product teams on integration architecture, connectors, and protocols. * Demonstrated success managing and growing complex, high\-impact partnerships across AI, cloud, or developer platform ecosystems. * Strong cross\-functional operating skills, with experience working alongside Product, Engineering, DevRel, Legal, and Finance to execute complex initiatives. * Exceptional analytical skills, with the ability to use data to drive strategic decisions. * Outstanding communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills, with the ability to engage at the executive level. * Strong bias for action — comfortable operating both independently and as part of cross\-functional teams, in a fast\-moving environment with evolving priorities. **Nice\-to\-Haves** ------------------- * Hands\-on experience with MCP, plugins, connectors, or app/marketplace ecosystems specifically. * Deep familiarity with the developer tools and infrastructure landscape, and a point of view on how emerging AI\-native companies find distribution. jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern (Backend / AI)
jobs.description: **Supero is an agent\-native application development platform. You describe a system; the platform generates the schema, APIs, access control and a deployed multi\-tenant app. We're small, the product is the platform itself, and the parts of it that are missing are genuinely missing.** Most internships hand you a sandbox. We don't have one to hand you. In the last six months, intern\-scoped work here has included a connector cost guard, a field\-level access test suite, and the tooling that catches when a generated app silently ships without seed data. You won't be shadowing. You'll own something small, real, and in production. **What you'll do** * Pick a track: **Platform** (Python services, connectors, access control), **AI** (generation pipeline, prompts, evals, MCP tools), or **Applications** (build real apps on Supero and break them on purpose). * Ship to production in your first three weeks — something small, entirely yours. * Write the design note before the code, and the RCA after the incident. You'll be taught how; nobody expects you to arrive knowing. * Sit in the reviews where we argue about whether a claim is actually true. **What we look for** * Real code in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or Go — enough that a 400\-line pull request doesn't scare you. * You've built something and put it in front of someone. A side project, a college system people actually used, a tool for your lab. What it is matters less than that it left your laptop. * Curiosity about AI systems. You've used LLMs to build and have at least one strong opinion about where they fall over. You do not need to know what MCP is — you'll learn it here. * You ask "how do I know that's true?" about your own work. You don't need a recognisable logo on your CV, and you don't need to have interned before. **How you apply: something you built is the first round** For interns and new graduates this replaces our screening call and our take\-home entirely. Two routes, scored identically: * **Build a small system on Supero** — ideally driven over our MCP server from Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot. Three to five entities, two roles, one thing that can go wrong. Send a screenshot of the landing page, the live URL, and a few paragraphs: what you were modelling, one decision you'd reverse, and two things about Supero itself — what you liked most and what you'd improve. Aim for 90 minutes; four hours is a hard cap. Free account, no credit card. * **Send something you already built** — any stack, any age, any domain — plus one page on the data model and the decision you'd now reverse. Nothing about this route is a lesser option. We know an unpaid evening isn't equally available to everyone. What we score: not visual polish. Whether the data model survives a second tenant, whether you handled the state with no happy path, and whether you noticed something wrong with our platform and said so. A three\-entity app with a defensible model and a sharp bug report beats a twenty\-screen app that only works if you click in the right order. Don't submit anything that isn't yours to submit — no employer's proprietary code, no real personal data. Invent your test data. You keep full IP in what you build; we get a limited licence to review it, and we delete our copy within 90 days of a final decision. Pay: From $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote
